fdroid:com.mendhak.gpslogger.name: GPSLogger
fdroid:com.mendhak.gpslogger.summary: A lightweight GPS logger, battery efficient, GPX/KML, add notes, share, upload.
fdroid:com.mendhak.gpslogger.description:
A lightweight, battery efficient GPS Logger. The purpose of this app is to log your GPS coordinates at specified intervals to a file on your SD card. This app runs in the background so that you can on a long walk, hike, flight ride or photo session or even go buy some milk and have this running as long as possible. Once you're back at your computer, you can then use the files to geotag photos, upload to travel sites, view in Google Earth and so on.
For more information, see https://gpslogger.app 
 Note : Please remember to Allow all the time for this app in your OS settings, to allow it to log locations in the background.
 Features 
 Can log to GPX, KML, CSV, NMEA and CSV formats. Can also log to a custom URL or just the screen.
 Logs GPX points as tracks and track segments
 Also logs speed, direction and altitude if available
 Add a description to a point using the annotate menu, gets added as a waypoint
 Configure time intervals between points
 Configure a minimum distance filter between points or an accuracy filter
 Notification icon with coordinates and quick actions
 Uses cell towers for location when GPS is disabled
 Selectively choose network, gps and passive location providers
 Automatically upload or email the file at set intervals to destinations such as Email, FTP, Dropbox, OpenStreetMap, Google Drive, Custom URL.
 Share location or log files via SMS/Email (and other apps such as Facebook or Twitter depending on what you've got installed)
 Start logging on phone bootup
 Invoke operations from Tasker or other automation apps.
 You can give it a preset file with your own values for distribution
 Multiple profiles with different settings are possible
Bugs, feature requests, questions - please submit them to github.com/mendhak/gpslogger (issue tracker).
 Notes 
A data connection is used by this app only if you use auto send features or Custom URL features
Although the app allows 0 second frequencies, it is not recommended as the recording and logging is happening very fast; this could cause instability/hangs. Try 1-3 seconds instead.
 Explanation of permissions 
Storage - reading and writing files to the GPSLogger folder on your SD card
Network communication - used when uploading the files (Dropbox, Openstreetmap) or sending emails or authorizing you with Dropbox, Openstreetmap
Your location - used to determine your GPS or tower based location
System tools (automatically start at boot) - used if you choose to start GPSLogger on bootup
Shared storage permissions - in Android 11, used to allow writing files to custom file paths

fdroid:com.reecedunn.espeak.name: eSpeak
fdroid:com.reecedunn.espeak.summary: Text-to-speech engine for Android. Based on the eSpeak engine.
fdroid:com.reecedunn.espeak.description:
The eSpeak NG is a compact open source software text-to-speech synthesizer for Linux, Windows, Android and other operating systems. It supports more than 100 languages and accents . It is based on the eSpeak engine created by Jonathan Duddington.
 eSpeak NG uses a "formant synthesis" method. This allows many languages to be provided in a small size. The speech is clear, and can be used at high speeds, but is not as natural or smooth as larger synthesizers which are based on human speech recordings. It also supports Klatt formant synthesis, and the ability to use MBROLA as backend speech synthesizer.
 Features:
 Includes different Voices, whose characteristics can be altered.
 Can produce speech output as a WAV file.
 SSML (Speech Synthesis Markup Language) is supported (not complete),
 and also HTML.
 Compact size. The program and its data, including many languages,
 totals about few Mbytes.
 Can be used as a front-end to MBROLA diphone voices .
 eSpeak NG converts text to phonemes with pitch and length information.
 Can translate text into phoneme codes, so it could be adapted as a
 front end for another speech synthesis engine.
 Potential for other languages. Several are included in varying stages
 of progress. Help from native speakers for these or other languages is
 welcome.

fdroid:com.yugahashimoto.andcode.name: AndCode
fdroid:com.yugahashimoto.andcode.summary: Run AI coding agents on Android through a native GUI, no terminal needed
fdroid:com.yugahashimoto.andcode.description:
AndCode is a native Android GUI for AI coding agents. Chat with OpenCode, Claude Code and Google Antigravity through a touch-first interface, with no terminal, no SSH and no PC required for on-device use.
The agents run on your own device inside a Linux environment set up through PRoot, or you can connect to an OpenCode server on your PC, Mac or Linux machine.
Features
• Native GUI for coding agents, no CLI needed for day-to-day use
• On-device runtime with Alpine Linux, Git, bash, curl and ripgrep
• Open git repositories, browse the file tree and view files with syntax highlighting
• Review diffs before accepting changes
• Approve or reject dangerous tool operations
• Create, resume, rename and delete sessions
• Scheduled tasks: run prompts once or on a cron schedule, with run history
• Live models, providers and agents from your connected agent
• Real-time streaming with collapsible reasoning, tool calls and command output
• Voice input with wake word detection, and text-to-speech
• Digital assistant and home screen widget
• Remote OpenCode over LAN or Tailscale, with mDNS and QR code discovery
• Connection credentials encrypted with the Android Keystore
• Localized in English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Russian, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil) and Arabic
Supported architectures: arm64-v8a and x86_64.
AndCode is an independent open-source project. It does not provide the underlying AI services, subscriptions or model access, and it is not affiliated with OpenCode, Anthropic or Google. Authentication and inference are handled by the official CLI or the provider you configure.

Firefox is a private web browser designed to protect your data, block trackers and make browsing fast, secure and simple. Whether you’re looking for an incognito browser, a private search experience, or a reliable browser for everyday use, Firefox puts you first.
Why people choose Firefox:
More privacy, less tracking – Firefox automatically blocks social media trackers, cross-site cookies, crypto miners and fingerprinting scripts.
Private browsing that protects you – Open private tabs that don’t save your history, searches, or cookies. Lock them with your device security for extra protection.
Fewer ads, less clutter – Turn on built-in ad blocking to cut down on distracting ads, leaving more room for what you actually came to see.

Passwords made simple – Generate, store and autofill passwords securely.
Search your way – Use your preferred private search engine or switch easily from the search bar.
Control your experience – Add extensions like ad blockers, customize settings and choose how you browse.
AI on your terms – Turn AI completely off or customize it feature by feature.
Sync across devices – Access your bookmarks, tabs and passwords anywhere you use Firefox.
Make it yours – Customize your home screen, layout and shortcuts for a more personal browsing experience.
Private by default.
Firefox is built to protect you. Enhanced Tracking Protection automatically blocks common trackers, and you can also turn on the built-in ad blocker for more control over your browsing and fewer distracting ads. When you need more privacy, private browsing mode ensures your history, searches and cookies aren’t saved.
Your browser. Your rules.
Firefox puts you in charge of your internet. Add privacy or productivity extensions, including ad blockers, move your search bar, choose your default search engine and tailor your browser to how you use the web. Sync your data across devices for a seamless, consistent experience.
Focus with Firefox. Fast, secure and built around you.
Firefox is designed to help you stay focused with faster, more secure browsing. Reader Mode removes clutter from articles, Picture-in-Picture keeps videos accessible while you multitask and Tracker Blocking helps pages load faster. Built-in password management and private browsing keep everyday browsing simple and protected.
Built for people, not profit.
Firefox was created in 2004 by Mozilla as a faster, more private and customizable browser designed to put people first. Today, Mozilla remains a nonprofit working to make the internet — and the time you spend on it — better.

• Set a progression rule per exercise and Liftin' adjusts the weights from your results: linear progression, 5/3/1 training max cycles, double progression, deloads.
• Start from a built-in program: StrongLifts 5x5, Wendlers 5/3/1, nSuns, GZCLP, Push Pull Legs, Upper/Lower, PHUL and Full Body. Or build your own from scratch.
• Charts for every exercise, estimated one rep max, volume, body measurements and progress photos, plus a calendar of your training.
AI THAT KNOWS YOUR TRAINING
• Describe the workout or program you want in your own words and Liftin' generates it with Apple Intelligence.
• Liftin' in ChatGPT and Claude: ask how your bench press is progressing, add 2.5 kg to every deadlift set next week, or have a 3-day strength program built, from the assistant you already use. Works with any MCP client.
APPLE WATCH
• Track a whole workout from the watch alone, or mirror the workout running on your iPhone live on your wrist.
• Heart rate and workouts go to Apple Health and fill your rings.
INTEGRATIONS
• Apple Health and Strava: your strength workouts land where the rest of your training lives.
• Import your history from Hevy. Export everything as CSV whenever you want.
• iCloud sync keeps iPhone, iPad and Mac on the same page.
LIFTIN' UNLIMITED
Liftin' is free for up to five workouts a month. Liftin' Unlimited removes the limit and unlocks all progress charts and progress photos, as a yearly or monthly subscription with a free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Current prices are shown in the app.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before that period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Terms of use: https://liftinapp.co/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://liftinapp.co/privacy/
Liftin' is made by one person in Stockholm. Questions and ideas are welcome at feedback@liftinapp.co. Good luck with your Liftin'!

apple-macos:6670792878.name: POOLS™
apple-macos:6670792878.description:
Explore, admire and listen. That’s it.
Uncanny. Relaxing. Unnerving. Eerie. Immersive.
POOLS isn’t a traditional game. it’s slow, reflective, and intentionally uneventful, perhaps a bit like virtual museum.
So take your time. Breathe. POOLS unfolds slowly, rewarding patience and quiet attention.
No monsters chasing you or jumping at your screen. Yet it can feel oppressive at times by invoking quiet fears of getting lost, the dark, tight spaces and the strange beauty of liminal space architecture.
There's no typical story. But as you explore and advance further, you start to notice that the game's world changes around you, deeper you go… Rooms look and feel… different.
Base game features six chapters, each lasting 10-30 minutes.
Inspired by the internet phenomena Liminal spaces, Found footage and The Backrooms, especially the Poolrooms concept. One of the original artists behind the Poolrooms concept is Jared Pike.

apple-macos:6760750971.name: The Life Calendar Wallpaper
apple-macos:6760750971.description:
Life Calendar turns your weeks, goals, habits, tasks, and countdowns into a clear visual timeline you can keep on your Lock Screen, Home Screen, and wallpaper.
MADE FOR iPHONE DUO
Keep your calendar close on the outer display. Unfold for more room to view your calendar and today’s tasks side by side in landscape. Portrait and landscape layouts adapt as you fold, unfold and rotate.
TIME ON YOUR WRIST
The Apple Watch companion shows your day, week, month and year as visual progress. Open the iPhone app to transfer your birthday and countdowns for personal calendars on your wrist.
Use it when you want time to feel visible instead of abstract: see the year at a glance, track routines, remember important dates, and keep today connected to the bigger picture.
LIFE IN WEEKS
Visualize your life as a grid of weeks based on your birthday and life expectancy. It is a calm, direct reminder to focus on what matters now.
YEAR AND MONTH VIEWS
Zoom out to understand where you are in the year, then return to the days and weeks that shape your actual routine.
COUNTDOWNS FOR IMPORTANT MOMENTS
Create countdowns for birthdays, anniversaries, trips, deadlines, launches, exams, and personal milestones.
HABIT TRACKING
Check in on daily habits and build a visual record of consistency, streaks, and progress.
TASKS FOR TODAY
Capture tasks, keep your day organized, and connect action items with the goals they support.
LOCK SCREEN AND HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Keep your life calendar, habits, tasks, and countdowns visible with widgets designed for quick glances.
WALLPAPER EXPERIENCE
Turn your calendar into a meaningful wallpaper so every unlock brings your time perspective back into view.
Life Calendar is designed for reflection, motivation, planning, and gentle accountability. Whether you are building routines, waiting for a milestone, or simply trying to spend your weeks better, it helps make each week count.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Privacy Policy: https://lifecalendar.mimos.ai/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:6823792348.name: SuperCal: Shared Calendar
apple-macos:6823792348.description:
SuperCal is a beautifully designed calendar built for sharing your life with the people in it.
SHARE EASILY
• Find friends in Settings, then send event invitations
• Send event details or a calendar file to anyone, even without SuperCal
• Share whole calendars with friends
• Add events to several of your calendars at once
SEE YOUR WEEK YOUR WAY
• Day, week and month views, as a grid or as a clean list
• Connect your Google Calendar, and see Apple Calendar, iCloud and Exchange events too, alongside your own (read-only)
• Repeating events: daily, weekly (pick weekdays), monthly, yearly, with "this event" or "all events" editing
• Drag to reschedule; touch, mouse and trackpad all supported
• Press and hold any event for quick actions: edit, duplicate, invite, delete
MAKE IT YOURS
• A glowing glass design with built-in themes
• Create your own themes with live preview, then copy and share them
• Control blur, glow, corner radius, week start, 12/24-hour time, snapping and more
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, synced in real time
• Sign in with Apple or Google
• Delete your account and data any time from Settings
Your calendars are private. Nothing is shared unless you share it.
SUPERCAL PLUS
Adding friends, sharing calendars, themes and customization require SuperCal Plus. Basic external event sharing is free. U.S. pricing is $1.99/month or $11.99/year. Eligible new subscribers receive a 7-day free trial. Prices and eligibility are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Apple Account Settings.

Feel every keystroke.
Tacque brings the deeply satisfying sound of a premium mechanical keyboard to any Mac. Choose from six hand-tuned sound styles, from soft tactile to typewriter, and switch instantly to match your mood.
It lives quietly in your menu bar, adds spatial audio that follows your fingers, and never logs what you type. Keystrokes are detected only to play a sound; nothing is recorded, stored, or sent anywhere. Lightweight, private, and ready at login.

flathub:com.hannes_campidell.MelodicMix.description:
Melodic Mix is a powerful yet simple tool, for applying effects and mixing instruments and vocals in live performances, many effects like a bass enhancer or reverb can be used.
 It is a fork of Easy Effects, but it's not meant to replace it, but to be used for a entierly different purpose.

flathub:dev.lapce.lapce.name: Lapce
flathub:dev.lapce.lapce.summary: Lightning-fast and powerful code editor written in Rust
flathub:dev.lapce.lapce.description:
Lapce is an open source code editor written in Rust. By utilising native GUI and GPU rendering, and with the performance Rust provides, Lapce is one of the fastest code editors out there.
 Features:
 Modal Editing (Vim like) support as first class citizen (can be turned off as well)
 Built-in LSP (Language Server Protocol) support to give you code intelligence like code completion, diagnostics and code actions etc.
 Built-in remote development support (inspired by VSCode Remote Development) for a seamless "local" experience, benefiting from the full power of the remote system.
 Plugins can be written in programming languages that can compile to the WASI format (C, Rust, AssemblyScript)
 Built-in terminal, so you can execute commands in your workspace, without leaving Lapce.

flathub:dev.lizardbyte.app.Sunshine.name: Sunshine
flathub:dev.lizardbyte.app.Sunshine.description:
Offering low latency, cloud gaming server capabilities with support for AMD, Intel, and Nvidia GPUs for hardware encoding. Software encoding is also available. You can connect to Sunshine from any Moonlight client on a variety of devices. A web UI is provided to allow configuration, and client pairing, from your favorite web browser. Pair from the local server or any mobile device.
 NOTE: Sunshine requires additional installation steps on Flatpak.
 Run flatpak run --command=additional-install.sh dev.lizardbyte.app.Sunshine 
 NOTE: Sunshine uses a self-signed certificate. The web browser will report it as not secure, but it is safe.

flathub:io.github.PinedaMB.VarLens.name: Varlens
flathub:io.github.PinedaMB.VarLens.description:
Varlens is a fast, native Linux developer desktop application built with Rust, GTK4, and Libadwaita.
 It empowers developers to inspect, format, explore, and diff structured data efficiently:
 High-performance JSON and XML formatting with configurable indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces,
 tabs) and minification.
 Interactive JSON Tree Explorer with collapsible nodes, live query search, and instant access
 path copying.
 Robust Pest PEG parser for PHP var_dump() and print_r() Array raw outputs into structured
 JSON.
 Visual Side-by-Side Diff comparator with Myers and Patience algorithms, and token-level change
 highlights.
 Zero-lag non-blocking asynchronous processing for large payloads.
 Full internationalization (i18n) with live runtime switching between English and Spanish.

flathub:io.github.shiftey.Desktop.name: GitHub Desktop
flathub:io.github.shiftey.Desktop.description:
Focus on what matters instead of fighting with Git. Whether you're new to Git or a seasoned
 user, GitHub Desktop simplifies your development workflow.
 Attribute commits with collaborators easily. Quickly add co-authors to your commit. Great for
 pairing and excellent for sending a little love/credit to that special someone who helped fix
 that gnarly bug of yours. See the attribution on the history page, undo an accidental
 attribution, and see the co-authors on github.com
 Checkout branches with pull requests and view CI statuses. See all open pull requests for your
 repositories and check them out as if they were a local branch, even if they're from upstream
 branches or forks. See which pull requests pass commit status checks, too!]
 Syntax highlighted diffs. The new GitHub Desktop supports syntax highlighting when viewing
 diffs for a variety of different languages.
 Expanded image diff support. Easily compare changed images. See the before and after, swipe or
 fade between the two, or look at just the changed parts.
 Extensive editor & shell integrations. Open your favorite editor or shell from the app, or
 jump back to GitHub Desktop from your shell. GitHub Desktop is your springboard for work.
 Community supported. GitHub Desktop is open source now! Check out our roadmap, contribute, and
 help us make collaboration even easier.
 This version of GitHub Desktop is a fork that adds support for Linux.

fedora-packages:dogtag-pki/dogtag-pki-tk.name: dogtag-pki-tks
fedora-packages:dogtag-pki/dogtag-pki-tk.description: Dogtag PKI Token Key Service (TKS) is an optional subsystem that manages the master key(s) and the transport key(s) required to generate and distribute keys for hardware tokens. TKS provides the security between tokens and an instance of Token Processing System (TPS), where the security relies upon the relationship between the master key and the token keys. A TPS communicates with a TKS over SSL using client authentication. TKS helps establish a secure channel (signed and encrypted) between the token and the TPS, provides proof of presence of the security token during enrollment, and supports key changeover when the master key changes on the TKS. Tokens with older keys will get new token keys. Because of the sensitivity of the data that TKS manages, TKS should be set up behind the firewall with restricted access.

firefox-addons:2641778.summary: This extension works like a web clipper, but it downloads articles in a markdown format. Turndown and Readability.js are used as core libraries. It is not guaranteed to work with all websites.
firefox-addons:2641778.description:
This is an extension to clip websites and download them into a readable markdown file. Please keep in mind that it is not guaranteed to work on all websites.
To use this add-on, simply click the add-on icon while you are browsing the page you want to save offline. A popup will show the rendered markdown so you can make minor edits or copy the text, or you can click the download button to download an .md file.
Selecting text will allow you to download just the selected text
Context Menus
You can also right-click on pages, images, links and selections to copy or download snippets of Markdown.
You can also download all tabs in a window as Markdown files
Obsidian Integration
For integration with obsidian, you need to install and enable community plugins named "Advanced Obsidian URI". This plugin help us to bypass character limitation in URL. Because it's using clipboard as the source for creating new file.
More information: https://vinzent03.github.io/obsidian-advanced-uri/ 
External Libraries
It uses the following libraries:
- Readability.js by Mozilla in version from commit by Mozilla version 0.5.0. This library is also used for the Firefox Reader View and it simplifies the page so that only the important parts are clipped. (Licensed under Apache License Version 2.0)
- Turndown by Dom Christie in version 7.1.3 is used to convert the simplified HTML (from Readability.js) into markdown. (Licensed under MIT License)
- Moment.js version 2.29.4 used to format dates in template variables
Permissions
- Data on all sites: used to enable "Download All Tabs" functionality - no other data is captured or sent online
- Access tabs: used to access the website content when the icon in the browser bar is clicked.
- Manage Downloads: necessary to be able to download the markdown file.
- Storage: used to save extension options
- Clipboard: used to copy Markdown to clipboard
Pricing
Huh? This is an open-source extension I made for fun. It's completely free. However, if you absolutely have to send me money because you like it that much, feel free to throw some coins in my hat via the following:
- https://github.com/sponsors/deathau 
- https://paypal.me/deathau 
The Common Mark icon courtesy of https://github.com/dcurtis/markdown-mark

bluejetty:00120802:ios.name: radio.net - AM FM Radio Tuner
bluejetty:00120802:ios.summary: Get all radio stations and podcasts in a single app – completely free of charge. Listen to WFAN, WCBS 880 or La Rancherita del Aire – whenever and wherever you want – and never miss an episode of the Smartless, The Ben Shapiro Show or This
bluejetty:00120802:ios.description:
Get all radio stations and podcasts in a single app – completely free of charge. Listen to WFAN, WCBS 880 or La Rancherita del Aire – whenever and wherever you want – and never miss an episode of the Smartless, The Ben Shapiro Show or This American Life podcasts.
RADIO FEATURES
• More than 60,000 radio stations
• Listen to your favorite local and global radio stations
• Save your favorites
• Quick access to your most recently listened to radio stations
• Missed a broadcast? Then simply catch up!
• Receive recommendations for new radio stations from our editorial team
• Clear search for stations
• Top categorization by genre, theme, city and country
PODCAST FEATURES• Subscribe and listen to over 2.2 million podcasts
• Stream or download episodes
• Discover lots of new podcasts thanks to our clear categorization
• Auto-delete option frees up storage space
• Variable playback speed
• Get notifications as soon as new episodes are available
• Decide whether new episodes should only be downloaded over Wi-Fi
• Simple search for podcast name, episode, theme and content
YOUR BENEFITS WITH PRIME
With a Prime subscription, you can listen to radio.net without any distractions. You can enjoy an ad-free listening experience — no video or banner ads and completely free of ad tracking. This means you can enjoy your favorite radio stations and podcasts with complete privacy and without interruptions.
EVEN MORE FLEXIBILITY WITH A USER ACCOUNT
If you create a free user account in addition to your Prime subscription, you can use your Prime subscription on all devices (smartphone, tablet, or on the web). In addition, your favorites are automatically synchronized, so you can take your favorite stations and podcasts with you wherever you go.
OUR PODCAST AND RADIO SEARCH
We find the content you’re looking for. Use our straightforward search for radio stations, podcasts and episodes. With the episode search, you can find interesting guests and specific topics.
FAVORITES SCREEN
Thanks to the favorite screen, you have now a faster access to your saved content. Your favorite stations are all in one place, and, in addition, you now have an even better overview of the podcast world: all your favorite podcasts, saved episodes, and your memory list can now be accessed even more quickly.
DISCOVER
The Discover area features the most popular stations and podcasts in clear categories. Editorial recommendations provide exciting inspiration and give you a quick overview of the wide range of content available. So, your new favorite stations and fascinating podcasts are always just a tap away.
LISTEN TO YOUR PODCASTS, EVEN OFFLINE
Download episodes and listen to them whenever and wherever you want – even when you’re offline. Enable the auto-delete option to free up storage space on your smartphone or tablet. For example, episodes you’ve finished listening to can be automatically removed.
APPLE CARPLAY
The perfect daily companion for every ride - now with Apple CarPlay. Listen to all your favorite stations and podcasts in your car with the smart and intuitive user interface of the radio.net app.
AIRPLAY AND CHROMECAST
Conveniently use the app on external speakers and anywhere in your Smart Home with the help of Airplay and Chromecast, bringing the best stations and podcasts directly into your home.
SLEEP TIMER
Sleep timer lets you gently fall asleep listening to your favorite channel or podcast and then stops playing after the specified time.

bluejetty:00140295:ios.summary:
出門前，看看預報，也看看現場的天空。
天氣即時影像將天氣預報與附近攝影機整合在一起，讓你從溫度、體感到現場影像，一次掌握出門前想知道的資訊。無論日常通勤、週末出遊，或想看看目的地有沒有下雨，都能先了解狀況，再安排下一步。
【看看附近的天空】
依目前位置或搜尋地點，查看附近攝影機。點開影像預覽，觀察現場天空、降雨與路況，搭配天氣預報作為出行參考。
【溫度之外，也關心體感】
查看目前溫度與體感溫度，搭配降雨機率、濕度、風速、紫外線及空氣品質等資訊，了解當下天氣。
【從接下
bluejetty:00140295:ios.description:
出門前，看看預報，也看看現場的天空。
天氣即時影像將天氣預報與附近攝影機整合在一起，讓你從溫度、體感到現場影像，一次掌握出門前想知道的資訊。無論日常通勤、週末出遊，或想看看目的地有沒有下雨，都能先了解狀況，再安排下一步。
【看看附近的天空】
依目前位置或搜尋地點，查看附近攝影機。點開影像預覽，觀察現場天空、降雨與路況，搭配天氣預報作為出行參考。
【溫度之外，也關心體感】
查看目前溫度與體感溫度，搭配降雨機率、濕度、風速、紫外線及空氣品質等資訊，了解當下天氣。
【從接下來幾小時，到未來 10 天】
24 小時預報幫你掌握天氣變化；10 日預報提供每日高低溫與降雨機率，方便安排通勤、行程與穿著。
【收藏常用地點與攝影機】
把常去的地點與關心的攝影機加入收藏，從底部分頁快速切換，下次開啟就能方便查看。
【明亮與深色外觀】
全新介面搭配動態天氣圖示，支援明亮與深色外觀，讓每天看天氣多一點輕鬆與樂趣。
【搜尋目的地，不只看所在地】
透過定位查看附近天氣，也可以搜尋其他地點，提前了解目的地的天氣與可用影像。
【資料與使用提醒】
攝影機影像整合交通部 TDX 平台與其他公開攝影機來源，涵蓋範圍以台灣為主，其他地區依來源供應情況而定。天氣資訊與攝影機影像由不同來源提供，更新時間可能不同；部分影像可能延遲、維護或暫時無法播放。影像用於輔助觀察現場狀況，不取代天氣預報、官方警報或交通安全資訊。各地可用的天氣項目與攝影機數量可能不同。

bluejetty:00021555:ios.name: Leica DISTO Plan
bluejetty:00021555:ios.summary: The Leica DISTO™ Plan app assists you with the vital task of documenting and visualizing your measurements. Fingers can be used to sketch a floor plan on a smartphone or tablet and corresponding measurements are easily assigned to each line
bluejetty:00021555:ios.description:
The Leica DISTO™ Plan app assists you with the vital task of documenting and visualizing your measurements. Fingers can be used to sketch a floor plan on a smartphone or tablet and corresponding measurements are easily assigned to each line of the plan. This way you can easily plan the next steps of your project.
Sketch Plan — create a scale drawing 
Simply use your fingers to create a sketch on your smartphone or tablet. Then take corresponding measurements and assign them to the relevant lines of your sketch. The app’s ‘Auto-Scale’ function automatically adjusts the length of the lines, producing a scaled drawing showing the surface area and circumference. You can now improve the accuracy even further with the Diagonals feature. Producing a CAD-ready floor plan is that easy.
Smart Room — plan while you are measuring 
Smart Room makes it possible to create accurate floor plans simply by taking clockwise or counterclockwise measurements of a room. Once all measurements are taken, the app automatically generates the plan. The diagonals feature will further enhance accuracy. 
Sketch on Photo — dimension objects in pictures 
Leica DISTO™ Bluetooth® technology allows you to assign distance measurements to the appropriate part of a picture taken with your tablet or smartphone. This way you can document all your measurement results and easily process them later in the office. 
Measure Plan — create as-build plans for CAD 
The Leica DISTO™ app supports P2P technology which makes it possible to create detailed floor or wall plans, including doors and windows. Once complete, simply export your plans as a DXF or DWG file into your preferred CAD solution. 
Measure Façade – create detailed wall layouts 
Easily generate intricate wall layouts using P2P technology. This feature is designed for measuring 2D plans on vertical surfaces. You define a vertical plane, and the function will automatically project all measured points onto this plane for precision and clarity in your wall layouts. Then simply export your plans as a DXF or DWG file into your preferred CAD program. 
Earthworks – determine exact excavation volumes 
Thanks to P2P technology you can calculate precise excavation volumes, making it ideal for purposes such as billing and transport cost estimation. Simply measure the outline of the desired excavation and set the depth either by entering a value or by measuring it directly by your DISTO. Function also allows you to define angles for the slope. 
Measure 3D – draw precise 3D plans 
Generate accurate 3D plans and seamlessly integrate data into CAD. Leverage the power of P2P technology for real-time 3D measurement visualization directly at the project site. Measurements can be then exported as a DXF or DWG file. Alternatively, you can choose the PDF Pro export with all the detailed information and measurement workflow. 
Relocation – add new dimensions to your measurements 
Empower your project flexibility with the Relocation function, enabling you to effortlessly shift your setup to a new location while seamlessly integrating essential data into your existing drawing. This feature is invaluable in situations where acquiring all necessary measurements from a single setup isn't feasible. 
Exports in standard formats — seamless integration 
All measurements and floor plans can be exported as a CAD drawing, JPG or in a PDF format. CAD exports are possible as DXF or DWG format, which allows to seamlessly integrate the measurement data with digitized construction. PDF export detailed reports include all created measurements in easy to read and understandable structure. 
The following Leica DISTO™ devices are supported: 
Leica DISTO™ D1 
Leica DISTO™ X1 
Leica DISTO™ D2 
Leica DISTO™ D2-2 
Leica DISTO™ D2G 
Leica DISTO™ D110/E7110i
Leica DISTO™ X3 
Leica DISTO™ X4 
Leica DISTO™ D510/E7500i 
Leica DISTO™ D810 touch 
Leica DISTO™ S910 
Leica DISTO™ D5 
Leica DISTO™ X6

bluejetty:00041093:ios.description:
Play puzzles and brain teasers in one of the best hidden object adventure games! In this one of the top search & find objects investigation games, your goal is to hide & seek things needed to become a hero!
No one ever said being royalty was easy, and that’s certainly the case for your goddaughter. When Princess Sofia is put under a spell at her engagement party, only her fairy godmother can come to her rescue! It’s up to you to use your magical prowess and stellar detective skills to find who’s to blame. But working with the fairy tale residents of Taleville won’t be an easy task, and when magic’s involved, things are rarely as they seem! Do you have what it takes? Find out in this bewitching Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!
· YOU’RE POISONED WITH A RARE POTION BY A LOVESICK WITCH, AND TIME IS RUNNING OUT TO FIND THE ANTIDOTE!
Never know what to expect from the magic world and witches. Be careful, find the object that helps you to survive!
· PLAY AND REPLAY HOPS, MOVIES, AND MINI-GAMES - AND EARN ALL THE ACHIEVEMENTS!
This unique Collector’s Edition provides a lot of extra materials like concept-arts, wallpapers, replayable detective games and puzzles, as well as a full-length captivating Bonus Chapter!
· COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTIONS OF WEDDING FAVORS AND MORPHING WITCH'S GEAR, AND EXCHANGE GEMS TO EQUIP YOUR MAGIC WORKSHOP!
Gather collections of beautiful statuettes, collect magical seeds and butterflies and play finding objects game!
· THE HELPFUL STRATEGY GUIDE WILL KEEP YOU ON TRACK IN TALEVILLE!
Be always sure of your next move while enjoying these finding games! A handy Strategy Guide will always help you if you ever get stuck.
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00019265:ios.description:
My Little Farmies Mobile – Found your own Medieval Village
Dive into the colorful world of My Little Farmies Mobile. Experience day-to-day life in a medieval village as you tend to a rustic family farm run by the lovable Amos. Your tasks will include growing crops and feeding animals, serving customers and helping out the many virtual friends you will make in this quirky and entertaining farm game.
Fantastic Farm Game Fun
My Little Farmies Mobile lets you shape the idyllic life in your own village; determine what crops the Farmies will tend to on their family farm, and which artisans and craftsmen buildings will grace your streets. Individual products can be combined in a myriad of production chains, making anything from delectable delicacies to homemade clothes. Refine your goods and sell them to earn money for the upkeep and expansion of your village. My Little Farmies Mobile is chock-full of amazing features for your gaming pleasure:
• Tantalizing tycoon game features that allow you to build workshops and streets in your medieval village, manufacture high-quality goods, keep animals, harvest cereals, vegetables and fruit and complete exciting quests
• Daily booster rewards for logging in
• Amazing social gaming features – become friends with other players and help them on their farms
• A charming farm game setting with intuitive game controls
• Lovingly detailed graphics
• Long-lasting fun through level-up rewards, unique challenges, seasonal events and more!
Your own Personal Village 
Let yourself be enchanted by the beautiful world of My Little Farmies mobile. Run a family farm and grow all sorts of plants. Nurture them with tender, loving care, and harvest your very own farm-fresh produce. Mill your wheat into flour, and use your flour to bake mouthwateringly delicious loaves of bread for your farm game customers. Game developer upjers will whisk you away to the Middle Ages with MyLittleFarmies Mobile, a tycoon game without equal.
Download Now
Now you can download My Little Farmies Mobile in the store. My Little Farmies Mobile is a standalone game; linking an account to the eponymous cult browser game “My Little Farmies” is not possible. Come play now! All you need is a mobile device and a stable internet connection!

bluejetty:00043652:ios.name: Mineral - Gratitude Journal
bluejetty:00043652:ios.summary:
In a time where our mind is often on overdrive being mindful of the best things in life can spark ease and clarity to focus on the positive.
Mineral supports you by making it easy to savour the best moments of the day big or small allowing
bluejetty:00043652:ios.description:
In a time where our mind is often on overdrive being mindful of the best things in life can spark ease and clarity to focus on the positive.
Mineral supports you by making it easy to savour the best moments of the day big or small allowing for a boost in positive energy. 
Why? 
Building a rhythm that allows for giving space to dwell on everyday treasures allows for you to retract from a world of big data and consumerism to a space of your own. In this space what you value increasingly becomes more apparent to you and may guide you to choose what to do more and what to do less to increase your level of happiness. 
It’s not easy to create new habits which is why Mineral is created to support you on this path. Mineral will make sure you get notified every day at a time convenient for you.
Repetition is key to make this work. By tracking each day you will hopefully see an increase in happiness and feel better the more you use mineral.
Our minds has a tendency to not focus on the best moments on life. Mineral is here to train your mind to allow focus on the positive, not only of the practical, complex and the difficult.
Benefits:
- Data is stored locally on your phone via Apple.
- You don't need to create a user, everything is automatically synchronized with your iCloud.
- Enable Face ID and make sure no one can access your notes without your permission.
- Switch between a range of different app icons.
Essentially, Mineral is your personal positivity Journal. You can use it to write down things that makes you happy and things that you are grateful for. But you can also use it to look back in time to be reminded about all the good things in your life. We hope this helps you and we would love to hear if there is something we can improve.
Mineral is free and safe to use. All your data is stored locally on your iPhone and iCloud, which means that we never store any of your data. By enabling Face ID, you can ensure that only you can access your private notes.

bluejetty:00163172:ios.description:
Welcome to Good Morning, Afternoon & Night, your warmest way to share kind words every day. 
Discover a library of greeting images, animated gifs, and charming stickers to say good morning, wish a peaceful afternoon, or send a serene good night. From tender love notes and blessings to thoughtful encouragement, you’ll find the right message to make someone feel truly seen.
••• WHAT IS GOOD MORNING, AFTERNOON & NIGHT
Good Morning, Afternoon & Night is a greeting cards app designed to help you express care and positivity in seconds. 
Explore thousands of visuals and uplifting phrases organized by mood, occasion, and time of day.
Pick a design, add a heartfelt note if you wish, and share it instantly with the people who matter most.
Looking for good morning images to start the day with light? Prefer calm, soothing good night images before bedtime? 
Or maybe bright afternoon hellos with morning gifs and free gifs that add a gentle sparkle? Our collections focus on affection, not jokes or memes, so you can send messages of love, gratitude, faith, and encouragement with confidence. 
New images and phrases are added frequently to keep your daily messages fresh and meaningful.
Main Features:
► Daily message collections for every moment: bright “good morning” sets, gentle afternoon wishes, and calm “good night” selections.
► Beautiful images and animated gifs created exclusively for the app by our team, ensuring originality and respect for copyright.
► Themed categories: love messages, blessings and prayers, motivation, happy Sunday and weekend, good week, birthdays, anniversaries, and more.
► Quick sharing to your favorite apps, including WhatsApp, Messages, Facebook, and others. No watermarks, no hassle. We also include stickers for WhatsApp so you can add a sweet touch to any conversation.
► Save favorites and build your own inspiration gallery to revisit the messages you love most.
► Lightweight, fast, and easy to use. find the perfect greeting in just a few taps.
Our image gallery is crafted to inspire: peaceful morning skies, cozy evening scenes, soft typography, and elegant compositions that make every message feel special. Whether you are sending a good morning note across the distance, a quiet good night after a long day, or a blessing to lift someone’s spirits, the right image is always at hand.
••• FOR WHOM IS GOOD MORNING, AFTERNOON & NIGHT
This app is for anyone who values emotional connection with friends and family. 
If you enjoy brightening someone’s day with a kind word, celebrating milestones, or offering support in difficult moments, you’ll feel at home here. It’s perfect for parents, grandparents, couples, and close friends who want to share affection without scrolling endlessly.
Choose from gentle blessings and love messages, motivational phrases for a fresh start, or elegant designs for special dates. 
You can also keep a simple habit of sending a morning hello, an afternoon check-in, or a warm good night to stay present in the lives of the people you love.
We regularly update our collections so you always have something new to share: happy Sunday sets, good week notes, seasonal images, and themed galleries for holidays and celebrations. 
Trustworthy and respectful by design: our visuals are produced in-house or via licensed creators, so you can share with peace of mind. We avoid loud watermarks and intrusive branding, and we never post humor or meme content that might feel out of place in a caring message. 
The app is lightweight and privacy-minded, focusing on a smooth browsing experience and straightforward sharing so your greetings reach loved ones without friction.
Download Good Morning, Afternoon & Night now and make everyday greetings feel personal, thoughtful, and beautifully made.

bluejetty:00153901:ios.description:
Got a trade offer and not sure about it? Put the pets in the calculator and you will know in a second: WIN, FAIR or LOSE.
Adopt Me Values is your trading buddy for Adopt Me. Check pet values, find new trades, collect pet cards and play mini games, all in one app.
TRADE CALCULATOR
• Add up to 18 pets and items on each side, just like in the game.
• Neon, Mega Neon, Fly and Ride each have their own value.
• See who wins the trade, and by how much.
• Get a heads-up before you give away a pet that lots of players want.
PET VALUES
• Up-to-date values for pets, eggs, vehicles, toys, pet wear, food, strollers and gifts.
• Search by name, filter by rarity and sort by value.
• Tap a pet to see how its value went up or down.
• Pick your value list: Elvebredd or GG. Switch it right on the calculator.
FIND TRADES
• See trade offers from real players and post your own.
• Look for one pet, filter by Neon, Mega, Fly and Ride, and message the trader.
• Trade Match: pick your dream pet and see who has it.
• Trade Notifier: get a ping when someone posts a pet you want.
PET CARDS (NEW)
• Open a free card pack every day and fill up your album.
• Fuse 4 of the same card into a Neon, then 4 Neons into a Mega Neon.
• Make your own phone and computer wallpapers from your cards.
MORE FUN
• 7 mini games, like Pet Quiz, Memory Match and live 2-player battles.
• Grab your daily stars and hatch Mystery Eggs.
• My Stuff: see what all your pets are worth, set dream pet goals and keep a list of your trades.
• Squad: invite your friends and earn free Pro together.
• See which pets are hot, and the most wanted and most offered pets of the week.
CHAT WITH PLAYERS
• Public chat rooms in 12 languages, private messages and group chats.
• Posts, trader reviews, a leaderboard and badges.
The app speaks English, Spanish, French, German, Russian and Arabic.
Pro takes away all the ads and gives you extra trade boosts, unlimited chat translation and the full market stats.
Please note
Adopt Me Values is a fan-made app for Adopt Me players. It is not made by, sponsored by or connected to Roblox Corporation, Uplift Games or DreamCraft. The app does not give, sell or transfer any in-game items: every trade happens inside Adopt Me, between players. Elvebredd and GG are independent community value projects that are not connected to this app and do not endorse it; their names only show which value list you have selected. All trademarks belong to their owners.
Website: https://adoptmevalues.app/
Privacy Policy: https://www.adoptmevalues.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Tudo que você precisa fazer é:
1. Baixe o app e cadastre-se em nossa comunidade, seu cadastro estará completo.

Não inventamos a roda, apenas premiamos quem a usa da melhor forma.
Descubra quem faz a mágica acontecer através do nosso site:
https://ecomilhas.app

bluejetty:00015421:ios.description:
Your success is our success.
Created by the same Harvard Law School alumni behind BarMax, LSATMax is the pioneer in comprehensive LSAT prep on mobile — and now it comes with Solomon, your personal AI LSAT tutor.
Join over 500,000 students who have trusted LSATMax to prepare for the LSAT, raise your LSAT score and gain admission into the law school of your dreams.
LSATMax is free to download and comes with a ton of free content, including detailed explanations for PrepTest 140 and PrepTest 141, video lessons, Live Class replays and free Solomon tokens to get you started. If you're preparing for the LSAT, this app is a must-have.
But LSATMax is much more than a supplement. It's a comprehensive LSAT prep course built to replace traditional options, with expert instruction, an AI tutor and 1-on-1 tutoring all in one app.
LSATMax is designed to be used with LawHub and/or the official LSAT PrepTest books.
Features include:
SOLOMON, YOUR AI LSAT TUTOR
Meet Solomon, the AI tutor built on 15 years of LSATMax teaching. Unlike general-purpose AI that makes up an answer on the spot, Solomon is grounded in our proprietary content: our lessons, our explanations and our class transcripts. Just tell him what you picked — "I picked (B) on PrepTest 118, Section 2, Question 20. Why was I wrong?" — and he'll diagnose the reasoning that led you there, the way a 99th percentile tutor would. Solomon covers Logical Reasoning and Reading Comprehension and is available 24/7. Free to start.
1-ON-1 TUTORING
Want a human in your corner? Schedule private 1-on-1 sessions with our 99th percentile LSAT tutors directly in the app.
LIVE CLASS REPLAYS
Watch our full library of Live Class replays on demand, taught exclusively by 99th percentile instructors. Filter by topic and by difficulty to find exactly the lesson you need, right when you need it.
PROVEN STRATEGIES
Our 99th percentile instructors break down every question type and concept with proven strategies guaranteed to raise your score.
REAL LSAT EXPLANATIONS
Gain experience by studying with 9,000+ detailed explanations for real questions from previous LSATs.
DETAILED ANALYTICS
In-app analytics track your progress and highlight your weaknesses, so you can make the most of your precious study time — unlike typical LSAT prep courses.
ONLINE ACCESS
LSATMax comes with online access, so you can use all of our materials, including our free content, from your computer as well.
Actual testimonials from real students (with full names, unlike our competitors):
"I went from a 152 to a 174. Now I have an actual shot at Harvard . . . pretty cool."
Chris Dinkel, Oral Roberts University
"LSATMax is my hero! My starting score was around a 155-158, and I scored a 170 on the June LSAT."
Austin Sheehy, University of Central Oklahoma
"I scored below a 150 on my first practice LSAT . . . In June 2016 I took the LSAT and scored a 170. I couldn't have done it without LSATMax."
Kyle Ryman, Texas A&M
"In case you're wondering, my score went up about 12 points! Highly recommend it!"
Odessa Stevens, University of Washington
"Amazing app and amazing staff. Improved 23 points because of LSATMax! BarMax . . . see you in a few months!"
D'Angelo Loyd, University of Louisville
"There is no other app that offers such extensive and comprehensive preparation as LSATMax. This is an incredible app . . . Best investment I have made in my life."
Pablo Calzada, Oakland University
Raise your score with LSATMax. Guaranteed.
It could be the difference between a safety school and your dream school — or between law school loans and scholarships.
More Questions?
Contact us on social media @LSATMax, email us at info@testmaxprep.com or call us directly at 855.931.0802 Monday-Friday from 9am-6pm PT.

bluejetty:00028323:android.description:
Logging Truck Driving is a popular and exciting game of the Truck Simulator Game genre that provides players with the opportunity to experience the thrill of driving a big rig. With the increasing popularity of truck games, there has been a growing demand for more realistic and immersive experiences. Logging Truck driving games cater to this demand by offering players the chance to drive various types of trucks in a variety of settings. Truck driving games come in many different forms, from truck simulator games that allow players to drive a virtual truck, to driving simulator games that aim to recreate the experience of driving a real truck. These Track Simulator Games often feature realistic physics, detailed graphics, and a wide range of vehicles to choose from. In Truck Driver: Truck Simulator Game, players can drive through city streets, across off-road terrain, or on the open road, delivering loads to their destination.
For players who are looking for a unique oil tanker truck driving experience, logging truck games provide the perfect opportunity. Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.

Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts

View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you

bluejetty:00183383:ios.name: Eat This Much - Meal Planner
bluejetty:00183383:ios.summary: Put your diet on autopilot with Eat This Much. Tell us your diet goals, the foods you like, your budget, and what your schedule looks like, and we'll automatically generate a complete meal plan to meet your targets. It's like having a perso
bluejetty:00183383:ios.description:
Put your diet on autopilot with Eat This Much. Tell us your diet goals, the foods you like, your budget, and what your schedule looks like, and we'll automatically generate a complete meal plan to meet your targets. It's like having a personal diet assistant.
We offer both free accounts and premium accounts. As a free user, you can create a day's meal plan and completely customize it however you want. Each meal can have different preferences, and your nutrition targets can be whatever you like.
As a premium user, we'll automatically generate a week of meal plans and send them to you with a grocery list via email. As you follow the plans, you can track what you did or didn't eat, and if you deviate from the plans, we make it easy to readjust your targets for the next week to stay on track. Try out the free account to see if our meal plans appeal to you, and upgrade when you're ready.
- Follow any eating style or create your own (works for keto, paleo, vegetarian, vegan, and more)
- Hit your macros and calorie targets every day
- Empower yourself with automatic control over your diet
- Take the anxiety out of picking what to eat
- Personalize any of our recipes and they'll replace the original
- Reduce food waste
- Don't like our suggestions? Easily swap them out or configure the generator to only use foods you like
- Manage your virtual pantry (with a premium account)
Normal calorie trackers force you to add foods into your diary one by one. And by the end of the day, there's no guarantee that you'll be anywhere near the nutrition targets you're trying to reach. With our automatic planner, there's nothing to track because everything is already entered for you, and all you have to do is follow the plan.
Subscription options:
- You can download the app for free and create/customize as many unique meal plans as you want, and save one to your account.
- To unlock the features of Eat This Much Premium, you can subscribe for either the monthly or yearly description.
Auto-renew details:
- The price to subscribe in your currency will be shown in the app before confirming the subscription.
- After the free trial has ended, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account.
- Your subscription will auto-renew unless cancelled 24 hours before the end of the current period (the auto-renew will continue with the same frequency that you select, either the monthly price for the monthly subscription or yearly price for the yearly subscription).
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price you initially paid.
- Auto-renew can be turned off at any time from your iTunes Account Settings.
- If you cancel your subscription or turn off auto renew in the middle of a billing cycle your account will remain premium until the end of that cycle.
Apple health integration:
Apple health syncing can be enabled in Settings -> Apple Health -> Enable Apple Health syncing for Premium users.
When Apple Health is enabled:
- your weight will automatically import and export when you login and when you view your user profile
- nutrition information will automatically export for meals marked "I ate this" when they are first viewed in the app and as you edit them
Privacy policy: https://www.eatthismuch.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of use: https://www.eatthismuch.com/terms/

PLEASE NOTE: Due to RAM restrictions on older devices, you may experience game crashes on: Standard model iPhone 12 and 13, iPhone XS, XR, iPhone SE 2nd gen, iPad 7th, 8th and 9th generations and iPad mini 5th gen. All iPhone Pro versions and iPad Pro versions are supported in full. 
Adventure. Battle. Transform.
Collect awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles in this open-world RPG. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!
Welcome to New Wirral, a remote island inhabited by strange creatures you’ve only dreamed of, nightmares you hopefully haven’t, and a cast of brave folks who use cassette tapes to transform for battle. To find a way home you’ll need to explore every inch of the island, and record monsters to your trusty cassette tapes to gain their abilities!
Transform into monsters...using retro cassette tapes?!
Faced with the constant threat of monster attacks, the residents of Harbourtown, New Wirral choose to fight fire with fire. Record a monster to tape, then play it back to take on its form for battle!
Fuse monster forms!
Getting close to your companion has benefits–while transformed you can combine your strengths to gain the upper hand in battle! Any two monster forms can be fused to produce unique, fully-animated new fusion forms.
Explore a rich open world
Certain monster abilities can be used in human form. You’ll need these to help you get around, solve puzzles, and locate dungeons. Glide, fly, swim, climb, dash, or turn magnetic!
Travel alongside a diverse cast of human companions
Never fight alone! Form bonds, spend time together, and help your selected partner complete personal goals to become a better team. The strength of your relationship determines how well you’re able to fuse!
Master a deep battle system
Take advantage of elemental chemistry to apply extra buffs or debuffs alongside your attack, or even alter your opponent’s elemental type!

bluejetty:00186762:ios.description:

- Comprehensive, beautifully designed DBT Diary tracking which lets you control what you want to track, how much detail (context) you want to provide. Additional context lets you to see advanced analytics - your patterns, progress, risk and provides recommendations.

- Complete DBT Skills Library Master Mindfulness, Emotion Regulation, Distress Tolerance, and Interpersonal Effectiveness.

bluejetty:00086595:ios.description:
lifebox - Backup & Storage
The best thing that can happen to your phone is lifebox! If you don't like the ‘storage full’ warning, lifebox is just for you. Here's what you can do with lifebox:
Automatic backup of the memories : With the auto-sync feature, your memories are backed up in lifebox instantly with cellular data or WiFi. All memories are safely stored automatically.
Back Up Your Contacts: You can back up your contacts in lifebox and store them safely. Thus, if something happens to your phone, you can access them immediately.
Group Your Photos with Face and Image Recognition: Lifebox recognizes people, objects and places in your photos with face&image recognition and groups them for you. So you don't have to worry about searching for a photo.
Free up space: You can delete the memories you backed up on lifebox from your phone with a single button, so you can make room for new memories in your phone memory. 
Automatic Stories: You can create fun stories and share them easily with your loved ones. Lifebox also creates automatic stories, collages and videos, crowning the most beautiful memories of you!
We did not forget your photos in social media: You can archive photos you share on Facebook and Instagram to lifebox.
Smart and Secure Login: Depending on the model of your phone, you can use touch id, face id, or password to make it more secure.
Photo Editing: With photo editing feature, you can make your photos more attractive with special filters, effects and frames, and you can add entertainment with caps and stickers.
Reach your lifebox from anywhere!: All the photos, videos and files you have stored in your lifebox can be accessed quickly from your smartphone, tablet, Apple TV, TV + and PC.
If you have a Lifebox Premium account, you can benefit from the additional features of Premium, and you will have the best lifebox experience!
Delete Duplicated Contacts: Lifebox saves you the trouble of deleting recurring contacts one by one! You can find the copied contacts in the phone book and delete the repeats with a single button, and you can find a solution to the chaos in your contact list.
Face and Object Recognition: With Premium membership, you can use Face&Image Recognition feature in all of your photos unlimited.
Original Quality Storage: If you have a lifebox Premium membership, all the photos and videos you upload will be kept in original quality.

bluejetty:00019233:ios.description:
Looking for an app that will get your kids excited about brushing their teeth? Look no further than Mimizaur. This app cleverly combines fun and dental education, teaching children how to properly brush their teeth. Mimizaur turns oral hygiene into an enjoyable adventure, capturing kids' interest and making teeth brushing something they look forward to.
With short cartoon clips played mid-brushing, your kids will clean their teeth longer and more thoroughly. This app keeps children interested for several weeks, which is long enough for morning and evening brushing to become a habit.
Mimizaur is most suitable for children ages 3-6 years old, but according to reviews, even older children, teenagers, and some adults enjoy using this application too! With the ability to create separate accounts for each user, you can set the timer for 1-to-2 minute brushing sessions, ensuring adequate brushing time while maintaining an element of parent control and enabling parental supervision.
Follow Mimizaur, the cute and curious character, on their interesting adventures while enjoying motivating cartoons - a new one in the middle of each brushing. The app features funny music like "Zyumba-Kakazyumba" specifically for brushing your teeth, and each completed brushing is awarded with super-achievements.
All you need is a toothbrush and toothpaste, and your kids will be running to fetch their toothbrushes themselves every morning and evening. Mimizaur is an educational, kid-friendly application for brushing your teeth, with games for both girls and boys ages 3-6.
Say goodbye to demanding toothbrushing sessions and hello to a fun and hassle-free oral care routine with Mimizaur. By teaching kids the importance of regular brushing, Mimizaur not only helps in maintaining sparkling white teeth - the most natural form of whitening, but also promotes healthier teeth, which could mean fewer visits to the dentist. So what are you waiting for? Download Mimizaur today and make brushing teeth fun and rewarding for the whole family.

bluejetty:00035563:android.description:
Booty Slam Launcher Plus brings the world of the Booty Slam game to your device’s home screen. Built for users who enjoy casual play with custom gestures, this launcher offers personalized visuals, smart tools, and integrated access to games content — all organized into a simple layout.
The Booty Slam game is a fast-paced runner game! It runs through a world full of challenges and dramatic decisions, where a single decision can flip your fate.
After installation, follow the simple guide to set Booty Slam as your default launcher and explore all available features.
Notes:
Installing this launcher may rearrange your home screen layout, but no data or apps will be removed.
The launcher is ad-supported to allow full feature access at no cost.
Utility Features (Ad-supported features):
App Tracer
Track how often and how long you use apps by clicks or usage. View stats per app or as a widget on your home screen. Long press on any app icon → Tap the pie chart icon
App Companion
Get helpful tips and tricks related to your apps. View insights per app or as a widget on your home screen. Long press on any app icon → Tap the lightbulb icon
Info Screen
Swipe right on your home screen to view news updates, including general and gaming-related content.
Customization
Icon Customizer
Apply Booty Slam - inspired icon packs to personalize your device. Long press → Home Settings → Icon Customizer
Animated Wallpapers
Static or animated, every wallpaper matches the game’s theme. Shuffle to keep it dynamic. Long press → Home Settings → Home Screen → Animated Wallpapers
Gestures
Assign swipe and tap gestures to open the game, change wallpapers, or launch other tools. Long press → Home Settings → Gestures
Quick Menu
Long press any empty space to open the launcher’s shortcut menu. From there, access Animated Wallpapers, Icon Customizer, PlayDeck, and more.
Game Integration
Game Access
Access Booty Slam directly from the launcher, no additional setup required. Start the game from your home screen or using gesture shortcuts.
PlayDeck
Central access to all entertainment features:
The Booty Slam game
Insta games (Booty Slam music, Slide Puzzle)
Games. Io - Web-based games portal
InstaGames
Add widget-based games like Slide Puzzle or Booty Slam music to your home screen. Long press → Widgets → PlayDeck → InstaGames
Support Center
Find answers to common questions, setup steps, reset options, and troubleshooting tools. Home Settings → About → Support Center
Terms & Policies
By installing Booty Slam Launcher, you agree to:
Privacy Policy: https://www.tri-angular.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.tri-angular.com/terms

bluejetty:00178130:ios.description:
Protect your online privacy with Passepartout, a smart VPN client seamlessly integrated with iOS, macOS, iPadOS, and tvOS.

Passepartout includes basic import and connection features. Additional features require an in-app purchase.

- Support for OpenVPN and WireGuard protocols.

bluejetty:00039886:ios.name: Keep It Mobile
bluejetty:00039886:ios.summary:
Keep It for iPad and iPhone is a powerful notebook and document organizer that can be used on its own or in conjunction with Keep It for Mac, available separately. 
Keep It can create and edit notes, rich text, plain text and Markdown file
bluejetty:00039886:ios.description:
Keep It for iPad and iPhone is a powerful notebook and document organizer that can be used on its own or in conjunction with Keep It for Mac, available separately. 
Keep It can create and edit notes, rich text, plain text and Markdown files, scan documents, edit PDFs, archive emails, save web links in a variety of formats, preview and search just about any kind of file, and organize these in a variety of ways. All the files, folders and tags you store in Keep It are available in the Files app, can be opened and edited in other applications, and shared with other Keep It users via iCloud.
Notes, Documents and Everything Else
• Create notes with styles, checklists and attachments that look good and read well on all your devices
• Create and edit rich text, plain text and Markdown files
• Adjustable display margins and word count available in all Keep It’s text editors
• Scan documents, add photos or videos, and save any kind of file to Keep It’s library
• Edit PDFs, play movies, and preview everything else with Quick Look
• Save web links for offline viewing as PDFs or web archives
• Create templates or empty files in any format using stationery
• View and work with mail messages and their attachments
• Merge multiple items into a single note
Organize
• Use folders to organize things hierarchically
• Swipe right on a folder to focus the sidebar on it and its children
• Add tags to items and filter items with one touch using the Tag Filter
• Use color-coded labels to quickly identify items
• Use bundles to collect items together and see them in more than one place
• See favorite items, and add lists to the Favorites Bar
• All lists can have their own sort settings and colors
Works With Other Apps
• Add text, links, and files to Keep It using its share extension
• Access and manage all the files, folders and tags you add to Keep It in the Files app
• Open files for editing in other apps from within Keep It or their document browser
• Share items in Keep It to other apps using the Share sheet
• Drag text, images, links, files and mail messages to Keep It
• Automate Keep It with Shortcuts
Search
• Search for items by their names, kind, content, dates, tags and more
• Combine suggestions to create complex queries with ease
• Step through found text in notes, editable text documents, web pages, and PDFs
• Save searches to the sidebar for reuse 
Keep It on iPad
• Use Quick File to file items quickly using a keyboard-friendly interface
• Use Quick Open to quickly navigate to any list or item by typing its name
• Constrain the width when editing notes or text files in full screen mode
• Annotate PDFs and images and add sketches to notes with Apple Pencil
And More…
• Use the Recents list to see things you’ve added or viewed lately
• Share folders and items with other Keep It users via iCloud
• Encrypt any file with a password
• Copy clickable links to items and lists in Keep It
• See items that link to the current item and navigate between them
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Use of Keep It Mobile requires a paid subscription that you can purchase in the app. 
A choice of monthly and yearly subscriptions is available, and these include a free trial.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account following the free trial, unless you cancel the subscription at least 24-hours before the end of the trial period.
The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of Use:
https://reinventedsoftware.com/keepit/ios/terms.html

bluejetty:00175830:ios.description:
متجر البناء المثالي هو خيارك الأمثل لشراء أجهزتك المنزلية المفضلة لتصلك حتى باب بيتك.
تسوق الآن أحدث المنتجات ومن أفضل العلامات التجارية سامسونج، وكاندي عبر تطبيق متجر المثالي. قم بتحميل التطبيق لتصفح أحدث العروض للوصول إلى كافة المنتجات كالغسالات، المواقد، الأفران، التلفزيونات وغيرها من الأجهزة الكهرومنزلية مع خدمة التوصيل داخل ليبيا ووسائل دفع متعددة.
هنا نذكر لك بعض المزايا التي سوف تجعلك تتفاعل مع التطبيق الجديد وستجده يلبي لك تجربة التسوق بسهولة :
• يقدم أفضل وأحدث موديلات الأجهزة المنزلية وبضمان يصل إلى 3 سنوات.
• توفير الوقت أثناء الدخول للتطبيق واختيار المنتج المفضل لديك وطلبه بنقرة زر. 
• يمكنك طلب المنتجات لتصلك إلى باب بيتك أو استلامها من أحد نقاط البيع وبوسائل دفع متعددة وآمنة. 
• الوصول لأحدث العروض والتخفيضات للمنتجات المختلفة بشكل سريع. 
• تصميم أنيق وبسيط لمتجر الكتروني متكامل الخدمات يلبى جميع احتياجاتك لخوض تجربة شراء سلسة وممتعة.
• يأتي بواجهة استخدام باللغة العربية سهل الاستخدام يجعلك قادر على عرض مئات والالاف من المنتجات.
• قم بالتسجيل لتصلك الاشعارات بالعروض والمسابقات، وكن أحد الرابحين في مسابقات ومواسم عديدة.
أينما كنت، تطبيق المثالي يعرض لك أفضل الأجهزة الكهربائية لمنزلك. قم بتثبيت التطبيق الآن وتمتع بالتجربة!

bluejetty:00095777:ios.developer: Loop Games Oyun Teknolojileri Anonim Sirketi
bluejetty:00095777:ios.summary:

That's the original wind-to
bluejetty:00095777:ios.description:
Tap a box. Nine spools of yarn burst out, hit the spinning loop, and start circling. The moment a spool passes its color in the knitting below, it grabs the thread and winds itself away — stitch by stitch, gone.
That's the original wind-to-clear mechanic at the heart of Drop N Knit — not about dropping things into containers, but about reading a moving loop and finishing a piece of knitting one clean color at a time.
The catch? The loop never stops and only holds thirty spools. Every box you open is a promise of nine. Plan your opening, watch what the knitting asks for next, and keep the yarn flowing — or watch it all tangle.
As you go, the boards get cleverer: linked boxes that pop as a pair, mystery boxes hiding their color, crates that keep spitting out new boxes, and secret rows in the knitting that reveal themselves mid-game. Handmade levels, every one.
No WiFi needed. No waiting. Open a box and see where the yarn takes you.

bluejetty:00030980:ios.description:
Ambition has no passport.
You're building a life here and holding one together back home. LemFi puts both in one app: send money home, buy eSIM data, and in the UK, save and access credit (subject to eligibility).
Send. Save. Grow.
SEND MONEY ABROAD
Send to 30+ countries across Africa, Asia, Europe, and Latin America, with zero transfer fees on supported corridors.
Most transfers arrive in minutes, paid into a bank account, a mobile wallet, or a mobile money account, depending on where you're sending. No branch visit, no paperwork, no waiting days for a bank wire to clear.
You see the exact rate and fee before you confirm. No hidden fees, nothing taken off on arrival. Then follow every transfer from the moment you send to the moment it lands, so you're not left wondering, and neither is your family.
SAVINGS (UK)
LemFi Instant Access Savings, Powered by ClearBank. Open an account from £1 and put money aside for emergencies, for goals, for the things that matter. Withdraw any time, with no penalty. Interest is calculated daily and paid monthly.
The LemFi Instant Access Savings Account currently pays a boosted 5% AER for the first six months from account opening; it then reverts to 3.04% AER (tracker), tracking the Bank of England base rate.
LemFi is not a bank. Savings accounts are provided by ClearBank Ltd (PRA-authorised, FCA and PRA regulated). Eligible deposits are FSCS protected up to £120,000 per person, shared across all deposits you hold with ClearBank.
CREDIT (UK)
LemFi Credit is a revolving credit line, subject to eligibility. We look at your full history, including your history with LemFi, so a thin UK credit file isn't the whole story. Choose how you repay each month: the full balance, the minimum, or a fixed amount that suits you.
With Credit Monitor, eligible customers can see their Equifax credit score in the app, and what moves it.
Credit is offered subject to status and affordability. Questions about credit? Our support team is in the app.
The LemFi Credit account is provided by Pillar Labs Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales (Company No. 13637649). Registered Office: Jellicoe, 5 Beaconsfield St, London, England, N1C 4EW. Pillar Labs Ltd is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority under Firm Reference Number: 996727.
eSIM DATA
Buy eSIM data for 150+ countries in the app, before you fly. Land connected when you go home or travel anywhere else, with no roaming bill and no queue for a local SIM.
WHY OVER 2 MILLION PEOPLE STAY
• Alerts the moment your money arrives
• 24/7 customer support in multiple languages
• Refer a friend and you both get the same amount of LemFi Cash to use on your transfers. LemFi Cash can't be withdrawn as cash.
LICENSED AND REGULATED
In the UK, LemFi is a trading name of RightCard Payment Services Limited, authorised by the Financial Conduct Authority to issue electronic money under the Electronic Money Regulations 2011 (FRN 900424). Your LemFi account is an e-money account, not a bank account, and is not FSCS protected. We also hold licenses, registrations, and approvals in Australia, Canada, Ireland, the US, and key corridors across Africa and Asia.
Send money and more.
Questions? Contact us in the app or at support@lemfi.com.
Facebook: @uselemfi | X: @uselemfi | Instagram: @uselemfi

The
bluejetty:00065258:ios.description:
BA Financial Calculator Plus combines a professional financial calculator with modern, guided finance calculators. Use it for quick calculations, deeper analysis, and as a handy reference for financial concepts, formulas, and examples.
The app includes a classic financial calculator for TVM, cash flow analysis, amortization, storage and recall, math expressions, and calculation history. Guided calculators provide clear inputs, results, charts, descriptions, formulas, and examples for common finance problems.
On Mac, BA Financial Calculator Plus offers a more desktop-friendly experience with keyboard input, shortcuts, sidebar navigation, toolbar controls, resizable layouts, and report workflows.
Key Features:
- Guided calculators with descriptions, formulas, and examples
- Professional financial calculator with scientific notation
- TVM, cash flow, NPV, IRR, AMORT, storage, recall, and history
- Charts and data visualization
- AI-powered explanations for supported calculations
- Save, organize, and share calculation reports
- App Shortcuts for quickly opening calculators
Calculators:
- Time Value of Money (Future Value, Present Value, Interest Rate, Period, Payment)
- Net Present Value and Internal Rate of Return
- Return on Investment (Gain or Loss, ROI, Annualized ROI)
- Compound Interest (Balance, Total Principal, Interest Amount, APY)
- Mortgage (Loan Summary, Payment Breakdown, Amortization Schedule)
- DCF Valuation (Enterprise Value, Equity Value, Intrinsic Value per Share)
- Bond Valuation (Bond Price, Macaulay Duration, Modified Duration, Convexity)
- Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM)
- Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
- Stock Valuation (Constant Growth, Nonconstant Growth)
- Expected Return and Standard Deviation
- Holding Period Return (HPR)
- Black-Scholes Option Pricing (Call/Put Price, Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Rho)
- Tip Calculator
Financial Calculator:
- Solve Time Value of Money equations (FV, PV, PMT, I/Y, N)
- Cash flow analysis with CF, NPV, and IRR
- Amortization with balance, principal, and interest
- Evaluate math expressions, including trigonometric and logarithmic functions
- Store and recall numerical values
- Use keyboard input and shortcuts on Mac
- Follow built-in help and step-by-step instructions
- Review calculation history
Calculation Reports:
- Save calculation reports
- Organize previous reports
- Share reports
BA Financial Calculator Plus Subscription:
Unlock all Pro features with an annual BA Financial Calculator Plus subscription, including advanced calculators, AI explanations, and reports.

Privacy policy: https://rayinformatics.com/privacy
Contact: https://rayinformatics.com/contact
