bluejetty:00092950:ios.description:
Create and show app prototype just on your mobile phone by Xpage.
Key Features
 ● Create & demonstrate app prototypes directly on iPhone/iPad. 
 ● Data-driven and event driven instead of draw-driven.
 ● Real interaction with real world.
 ● Animate with objects beyond imaging. 
 ● Customize native components, even create your own.
 ● Publish &. share.
Design
 ● make your designs by easy drop and drag.
 ● portrait and landscape orientation pages
 ● reusable styles, components and templates.
 ● group/ungroup.
 ● auto-alignment and auto-spacing. 
 ● auto snap to objects, magnetic-lines, bounds, or shapes.
 ● re-use elements cross pages even projects.
 ● hundreds of icons and images in stock.
 ● Design with dynamic system color and adapt to dark mode automatically.
 ● linear gradient fill and radial gradient fill.
Prototyping
 ● Screen Transitions
 ○ add touches, gestures, shakings, timers, data-monitors, AV events, or other triggers for mobile prototyping. 
 ○ create the flow of your app with screen transitions.
 ○ customize the start page for preview.
 ● Animation
 ○ animate with moving, rotating, morphing, colorizing and fading.
 ○ animation curve.
 ○ integrated with events.
 ● Event-Driven
 ○ page events and actions.
 ○ stateful object event.
 ○ linkage for each item of tabBar, event-driven QR-code recognizers and switches, etc.
 ● Data-Driven:
 ○ flexible data binding.
 ○ input, scan or calculate real data in real world. 
 ○ display, modify or clean the value in variable.
 ○ make a phone call by the numbers in the buffer.
 ○ visit the URL from QR-code.
 ● Data-Driven TableViews and CollectionViews:
 ○ table views are data-driving, so do collection views.
 ○ multi-sections support. 
 ○ design styles for each section, then provide data.
 ○ work with real world data by user’s own Web-Service API.
 ● interactive native UI assets.
 ○ play back musics, sounds, videos. 
 ○ interact with layers.
 ○ interact with action-sheets or alerts.
 ○ interact with albums, camera, map and location.
 ○ visit WEB site.
Preview
 ● Add prototype to Home Screen.
 ● preview designs in a variety of screen sizes.
 ● backup & sync between devices via iCloud.
 ● share via e-mail.
 ● publish to community, share to everyone.
Features in Pro version:
 $ landscape orientation pages
 $ unlimited projects and pages
 $ clone pages
 $ share & backup/restore
 $ paste from clipboard
 $ premium components
 $ manage fonts
PS: 
Xpage is a free-to-try app with In-App-Purchase because I want to ensure the continued development and support of a product we and others enjoy so much.
Thanks to everyone who sent in feedback for Xpage and have helped shape the future direction of new features and improvements. If you have any comments about Xpage, please feel free to let us know. We will reply every feedback email.
If you enjoy using Xpage, we would really appreciate if you could take a moment to leave a review in the App Store. Thank you.

bluejetty:00015306:ios.description:
"Trucks building" is colorful game about different types of construction machinery those are constructing huge buildings using their skills. If your kids are fond of cars and trucks or anything connected with building thematic they will be crazy of this cool game! Go through all 18 engrossing levels of game and get your house done in the finish of one of the best building game for toddlers!
CONSTRUCT and RIDE your very own construction transport is fairly easy right now! Build cool vehicles with just a few touches. First above you have to build your own transport, then fill it with gas on the gas station, and go to the building site where you can build your dream house! After it you will have to wash your transport in the carwash Move from level to level and soon your dream house will be done!
Here you can find many types of different vehicles for your child to build and play with! Here is short list of them: digging machine, tipper, crane, drilling machine, pile driver, concrete mixer and much more! Teach your child basics of cars mechanics! All the transport in the game is just like in real life!
-CAR WASH!
Your truck got dirty after hours of building of the house? No problem! Soap it with bubbles, roll a car through soft brushes, clean it with water and dry it off so your car will be shine clean! Its really fun for kids to play in carwash!
-GAS STATION!
Fuel of your truck is low? Never mind because you can fuel your transport on the gas station. At first find where to connect fueling nose! It trains children's attentiveness. Press the button and watch your car`s fuel level rising up!
If you`re an adult and busy, you can simply give your baby smartphone or tablet with this game installed, your toddler will be busy with it for hours of having fun! But your baby will not only be passionate about game, but also will learn some things!
Other features we would like you to know about:
Music was specially composed for this game, here you can find many cool rhythmical music themes. Voice-over: 10 different professionally recorded voice-overs, including languages like: English, Deutsch, Espanola, Russian, Turkish, Portuguese, Chinese, Arabian, and Hindi! Graphics is brilliant and colorful, our designers worked hard! We`ve also cared about security, so it won’t be so easy for your child to buy something in game, while you are not looking for him.
This game will be perfect for your child, if he likes tractor games, car sounds, house building games, car puzzles, and construcion games. 
Also we recommend you to view some others games those we created, they are fun not less than that one! :)

bluejetty:00098410:ios.name: Solitaire FishStory
bluejetty:00098410:ios.summary: Solitaire FishStory by Hijoy: Dive into the Underwater World and Play Classic Solitaire! If you love Solitaire – whether you know it as Patience or Klondike – this is your ultimate choice for unwinding in a tranquil sea and sharpening your
bluejetty:00098410:ios.description:
Solitaire FishStory by Hijoy: Dive into the Underwater World and Play Classic Solitaire! If you love Solitaire – whether you know it as Patience or Klondike – this is your ultimate choice for unwinding in a tranquil sea and sharpening your mind.
Welcome to one of the world's most popular classic card games, now featuring fantastic underwater aquariums! The addictive Solitaire games, which you've played for years, now plunge underwater with you. Our Solitaire blends pure fun with captivating ocean adventure, offering beautiful cards, smooth 3D animations, and free offline play. Get ready for a unique Solitaire journey with coral reefs and fish in your very own underwater kingdom!
== How to Play==
Tap or drag cards to arrange them in descending order with alternating colors. When you can, move cards up to the four foundation piles at the top, sorting all of the suits from Ace to King. You can draw one card at a time for a more relaxing Solitaire game, or draw three for a challenge to train your brain, as nimble as a fish darting through currents!
==Features of Our Solitaire==
- Creative & Classic Fusion
Beyond the classic Solitaire (also known as Patience or Klondike) gameplay, we've meticulously crafted a creative aquarium world where you'll collect dozens of adorable sea creatures, from vibrant clownfish to elegant bannerfish. Catch more rare fish and build your unique underwater aquarium, making every Solitaire challenge burst with ocean surprises!
- Immersive 3D Undersea World
While enjoying classic Solitaire games, immerse yourself in an amazing unique aquarium world with delicate undersea environments and vivid 3D fish animations. Solitaire FishStory brings you the most lively and vibrant underwater visual feast.
- Daily Challenges with Thousands of Levels
Earn medals and crowns by solving daily challenges. New Solitaire puzzles await every day, training your brain while delving into the ocean's unknown depths. Plus, there are Star Chests and a Lucky Spin, with generous rewards after each successful deal, like discovering underwater treasures.
- Rich Customizations
Freely change your aquarium, decorations, and wonder creatures to shape your exclusive ocean-themed Solitaire game. Earn points every time you play Solitaire to level up and achieve new titles, becoming an underwater Solitaire master. Change background, card backs, and animations for a personalized Solitaire experience.
- Flexible Settings
Play right or left-handed, in portrait or landscape mode, with multiple scoring styles (Standard or Vegas Casino), and adjust hands to draw-1 or draw-3 for varying difficulty, adapting to any preference in the ocean's depths.
- Offline Play
No Wi-Fi required! Enjoy underwater Solitaire whenever and wherever you like.
- Compete & Track
See how you stack up on the leaderboards, or beat your own high score, becoming an underwater Solitaire legend. Detailed player statistics help you monitor your progress in the aquarium world.
==What is Solitaire==
Solitaire is a classic Klondike card game. Solitaire is so interesting and so popular, people all over the world like playing solitaire to relax themselves. When people say ""Solitaire"", it is generally referred to as the Klondike solitaire. Klondike solitaire is most popular and most classic solitaire card game, compared to the other solitaire card games, like Spider Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Pyramid Solitaire, and TriPeaks Solitaire.
==Solitaire FishStory==
If you enjoy playing Patience or Klondike Solitaire card games on laptops or the web, and you love sea creatures, then this is definitely the best classic Solitaire game for you on mobile devices! It can train your brain and improve problem-solving skills, bringing you back to the addictive card puzzle and timeless Solitaire fun, all while immersing yourself in a beautiful underwater aquarium.
Download now and enjoy the most popular Solitaire card game, dancing with the fish!

Experience a new era of puzzle solving in Ring Clash! This isn't just another simple match game; it’s a tactical experience that rewards smart strategy to clear the board. Are you ready to dive into the most vibrant logic puzzle on the store?
Master the Art of the Clash
In Ring Clash, every move is a test of your skills. Slide colorful rings across the grid and watch them clash in a satisfying burst of color. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or want an engaging brain-teaser to sharpen your mind, every level offers a fresh way to play.
Unblock Your Way to Victory
The fun evolves as you encounter intricate ring clusters and hidden layers. Every stage is a clever puzzle where careful planning is key. When these colorful links create a tactical jam, it’s up to you to find the right sequence of moves to untangle the board and keep the momentum going.
Why You'll Love Ring Clash:
Dynamic Mechanics: A perfect blend of strategy and high-speed action.
Clever Obstacles: Navigate layers, ice, and directional arrows in every stage.
Satisfying Visuals: Enjoy a clean, vibrant aesthetic where every clash feels rewarding.
Flexible Play: Relax with casual levels or push your limits with our "Very Hard" stages.
The ultimate goal is just a tap away. Start your journey in Ring Clash, master the mechanics, and prove your skills in this uniquely addictive experience!

bluejetty:00133199:ios.description:
MyKeyboard is a flexible custom keyboard for iPhone that makes everyday typing faster, more useful, and more personal. Add helpful keys and ready-made rows, keep your favorite tools close, and switch between languages and layouts without leaving the keyboard.
Whether you want quick access to numbers and emojis, a better way to manage copied text, or a keyboard that matches your style, MyKeyboard puts practical customization at your fingertips.
KEY FEATURES
Add Useful Keys & Rows
Expand your keyboard with extra keys for a variety of useful actions. You can also add pre-designed rows, including a number row and a recent emoji row, so the things you use most are always easy to reach.
Emoji, Symbols, GIFs & Stickers
Find the right reaction without interrupting your conversation. Browse emojis and symbols, search for GIFs, and use stickers directly from your keyboard.
Clipboard History
Keep recently copied text close at hand. Open your clipboard history from the keyboard and quickly reuse content without repeatedly switching between apps.
AI Proofreading
Polish your writing with AI proofreading. Check text for mistakes and improve it before you send—right from your typing workflow.
Multilingual Typing
Use multiple languages and keyboard layouts in one setup. Switch between them from the space key whenever you need a different language or layout.
Themes & Personalization
Choose from a wide range of themes to give your keyboard a new look. Want something more personal? Use the simple theme creator and editor to make it your own.
Experimental Swipe Typing
Prefer typing with a gesture? Enable experimental swipe typing in Settings and enter words by sliding across the keys.
Made for Everyday Typing
MyKeyboard brings useful tools together in one approachable keyboard. Personalize what is available, keep frequently used features within reach, and spend less time jumping between apps.
Why MyKeyboard?
You do not need to rebuild an entire keyboard to make it work better for you. Add the keys and rows you need, choose your languages and theme, and turn the keyboard you already know into one that fits the way you type.
Download MyKeyboard and make every tap more useful.

bluejetty:00165711:ios.description:
Wingman is the AI dating coach that actually knows your situation, so you're never stuck wondering what to do next. Add the people you're talking to, get your photos rated, fix your bio, and get suggestions for what to say next. It's one app that never loses the thread.
WHAT MAKES WINGMAN DIFFERENT
Most dating AI apps generate a reply and forget you exist. Wingman stays in it with you, move by move. It remembers who you're talking to, what you've said, what's worked, and what hasn't. So when you're staring at your phone at 1am wondering how to respond, the answer's already there. Wingman knows the dating guidance that works. No second-guessing. No shooting blind.
YOUR PERSONAL DATING COACH, 24/7
Ask Wingman anything about dating, relationships, or your love life. Share screenshots directly in chat for real-time, context-aware advice. Get clear, practical answers the moment you need them.
FIX YOUR PROFILE
- Rate My Photo — get brutally honest feedback on your dating pics and the strategy to improve them
- Compare Photos — find your strongest images side by side
- Fix My Bio — get your bio analyzed and rewritten
- Full Profile Review — a complete audit of your photos and bio together
GET OPENERS & REPLIES
- Upload screenshots of any conversation and get suggested lines that actually sound like you
- Check My Vibe — analyze your own messages before you send them
- Works with screenshots from the apps and conversations you already use
ROMANTIC INTERESTS — STAY ORGANIZED
Create a profile for each person you're talking to. Wingman tracks the full picture:
- Their attachment style and communication patterns
- Red flags and relationship dynamics
- Key dates, logistics, and conversation history
- AI-generated insights that update as things develop
Keep important details in one place so you can stay consistent and thoughtful. You'll never lose track of where things stand, and you'll have the context you need to make the next move with confidence.
INSIGHTS & ANALYTICS
Wingman learns from your conversations over time. See what's working, spot patterns that are costing you matches, and get personalized tips based on your actual dating style.
LEVEL UP WITH QUIZZES
Test your dating knowledge across real scenarios — crushes, exes, messaging, and online dating — and get scored with honest feedback.
No more overthinking. No more missed shots. More clarity when you need it most.
By downloading and using this app, you agree to the Apple End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.

bluejetty:00160640:ios.name: Swimmetry
bluejetty:00160640:ios.summary:
Maximize your competitive swimming experience with powerful analytics, goal tracking, AI-powered insights, head-to-head comparisons, and professional PDF sharing — all at your fingertips.
TRACK GOALS & STANDARDS
Visualize each swimmer's jo
bluejetty:00160640:ios.description:
Maximize your competitive swimming experience with powerful analytics, goal tracking, AI-powered insights, head-to-head comparisons, and professional PDF sharing — all at your fingertips.
TRACK GOALS & STANDARDS
Visualize each swimmer's journey towards their next milestone. See personal bests against National Age Group (NAG) motivational standards, state/LSC standards, and qualifying standards like Speedo Sectionals and Junior Nationals. Includes all USA Swimming state/LSC time standards. Year-over-year improvement indicators show exactly how much faster your swimmer is getting.
COMPARE SWIMMERS
See how you stack up against friends, rivals, or swimming legends. Compare lifetime bests, season bests, or best times at the same age — displayed with color-coded heat maps that reveal strengths at a glance. Overlay progression graphs for multiple swimmers side by side.
SWIMIQ — AI-POWERED INSIGHTS
Get personalized AI analysis for any swimmer: meet recaps, race day planning, qualifying time tracking, and performance highlights — all tailored to your athlete's data.
NEW: College Fit — your swimmer's college projection in one tap
Wonder where your swimmer might fit in college? College Fit projects their times forward to age 18 across three scenarios — conservative, expected, and aggressive — then ranks NCAA programs by how well they actually match.
Every school gets a two-part read:
• Conference fit — would they project to score at the conference championship?
• Roster fit — would their times earn a spot on this specific team's depth chart?
Browse the full ranked best-fits list, or search a specific school. Drill in for event-by-event detail: where they'd place at conference, where they'd rank on the roster, NCAA cuts they'd hit, and how their projection compares to the team's current top swimmers. An AI-generated narrative ties it all together — switch between swimmer-tone and coach-tone for the read that fits you.
Filter by school tier (NCAA D1 Power, D1 Mid-Major, D2 — D3 and NAIA coming), conference, target age, and course. Built to grow with the dataset as more programs come online.
SWIMMER SNAPSHOT — SHARE YOUR STORY
Generate professional PDF reports with one tap. Stroke balance radar, standards achieved, progression charts, and year-over-year trends — beautifully formatted and ready to share with coaches, college recruiters, or family. Export PDFs from Compare, Progression, Rankings, Meet Results, and SwimIQ screens.
PROGRESSION & ANALYTICS
Review a swimmer's progress over the past three years or set a custom date range. Analyze seasonal trends, identify strengths by stroke, and set realistic expectations for race day. Team analytics let you monitor achievements and average progressions across different groups.
DISCOVER & FOLLOW
Search for any USA Swimming athlete and add them to your favorites. Get updates whenever they compete in a meet or achieve a new standard.

bluejetty:00167013:ios.description:
Getting to and from your local Sydney Metro and train station is easy with Cooee Busways On Demand public transport that comes to you.
Forget about driving yourself to the station. Cooee Busways comes when you request - giving hassle free, great value, travel when you need it. Travel in comfort to and from Rouse Hill, Tallawong and Schofields stations in one of our air conditioned wheelchair accessible minibuses. 
How does Cooee Busways work?
Just download the Cooee Busways app today, book your seat and you’re on your way. It is as easy as click, book, go.
Our intelligent service allows you to share your trip with others going your way. Our powerful algorithm matches you with one of our vehicles that will pick you up at a convenient spot. Trip times are comparable to taxis with fares comparable to public transport.
Areas we serve:
- The Ponds
- Kellyville Ridge
- Schofields
How long will I wait?
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking. You can also track your minibus in real time in the app.
How many passengers will I share a vehicle with?
- The number of passengers you will share a trip with varies based on your chosen destination. Our comfortable minibuses seat 14 - plus provision for two wheelchairs. 
Try this new on-demand transport app that is guaranteed to change the way that you think about travelling. We look forward to seeing you on your next trip. Just click, book, go!
Love our app? Please rate us! Questions? Email us at cooee@busways.com.au.

bluejetty:00186537:ios.description:
Kartable, l’école de soutien scolaire nouvelle génération : l’application n°1 pour tes cours et révisions en ligne en primaire, au collège et au lycée, qui accompagne déjà plus d’un élève français sur trois. Tous nos contenus sont rédigés par des professeurs de l’Éducation nationale.
En utilisant régulièrement Kartable, un élève progresse de 4,4 points en moyenne ! 
*****
Avec Kartable, retrouve tous tes cours et des milliers d’exercices avec leurs corrections directement dans ta poche :  
- 19 matières >> Mathématiques, Français, Histoire, Géographie, ECS, Physique-Chimie, SVT, Anglais, Allemand, Espagnol (ES), SES, Philosophie, Littérature, Enseignement Scientifique, Géométrie, Questionner le monde, Humanités, littérature et philosophie.  
- 11 niveaux >> CE1, CE2, CM1, CM2, 6ème, 5ème, 4ème, 3ème, 2nde (seconde), 1ere (première), Terminale, y compris spécialités et options.
- Des milliers de cours, exercices et quiz avec les réponses détaillées conformes aux programmes officiels de l’Éducation nationale française et conformes également à la nouvelle réforme du lycée 2020/2021.
- Des fiches méthodologiques et des exercices type bac et type brevet pour tes révisions d’examen. Du vocabulaire en langues, des problèmes de maths, des règles de conjugaisons, tu as tout pour t’entraîner !  - Une méthode d’évaluation de tes acquis et tes lacunes pour te proposer un parcours personnalisé, comme dans une classe numérique.
- Une plateforme d’e-learning motivante, illustrée avec des images et photos pour apprendre en toute simplicité. 
De septembre pour un “back to school” qui cartonne à juin pour tes examens, Kartable t’accompagne toute l’année ! 
*****
La Presse en parle :
Le Parisien : "Kartable, la nouvelle star des applis de révisions scolaires"
Le Monde : "Avec Kartable, les cours c'est dans la poche"
Les Echos : "Réviser à tout moment sur un smartphone, en attendant le bus, chez soi, ou dans un couloir de lycée"
*****  
Accès gratuit à 10 contenus et un abonnement à Kartable Premium (13,99€ /mois sans engagement) qui permet d’accéder :  
• à tous les cours, exercices et corrigés en illimité  
• au téléchargement des cours pour les consulter hors ligne   
*****
Le paiement sera effectué avec ton compte iTunes, après la confirmation de l'achat.
L'abonnement est automatiquement renouvelé à moins que cette option soit désactivée au moins 24h avant le prochain renouvellement.
Le renouvellement de ton abonnement sera facturé dans les 24 heures précédents la fin de ton abonnement en cours 13,99€ (formule mensuelle) ou 109.99€ (formule annuelle).
Tu peux annuler l'auto-renouvellement de ton abonnement dans les paramètres de ton compte iTunes.
*****
CGU : https://www.kartable.fr/mentions-legales/cgu
Des questions, des suggestions, un problème ou un bug ? https://support.kartable.fr  
Twitter : https://twitter.com/kartable  
Facebook : https://www.facebook.com/kartable

bluejetty:00122978:ios.description:
Manage your finances with ease, wherever you are!
The app is valid for Bulgarian citizens, foreigners living in Bulgaria and Greek citizens with a valid ID card or passport.
NOT A FIBANK CUSTOMER YET?
Become a customer entirely online. Open an account, request a debit card and activate your banking without visiting a branch.
Access the full range of Fibank’s digital services and innovative features:
MONEY TRANSFERS
• Transfer funds domestically and internationally.
• blink transfers via mobile number (P2P) – make instant intra-bank and interbank transfers to phone contacts.
• Instant payments in euro (SEPA Instant Credit Transfer) – 24/7, 365 days a year.
• Add money to your account using a bank card.
• Minors (14–18 years old) with a teen card can transfer funds between their own accounts (current and Smart teen account).
• Create templates, save favorite recipients, and track your transfer history.
• Exchange currencies and negotiate preferential rates for currency exchanges and transfers.
PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
• Investments: Trade stocks and ETFs on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE) and international markets (USA & Europe).
• Apply for a Consumer loan or Credit card, sign your contract, and access your funds instantly – fully online!
• Payment for parking zones (blink Parking) - pay instantly and without additional fees.
• Open a current, savings or a gold account in XAU currency (non-physical gold).
• Open a new deposit account with an attractive interest rate.
• Instantly issue virtual debit and credit cards.
• Request a new debit card or a debit card for children and teenagers.
• Track and pay your utility bills, municipality taxes and fees to over 30 municipalities using the Utility payments option.
• Electronic vignette – buy and check validity, or pay a fine without a vignette.
• Cash desk operations – submit a request for deposits and withdrawals or send a request for cash availability at a convenient Fibank branch.
• Flexible banking packages/plans with products and services for easier daily banking.
BANK CARDS
• Monitor payments and balances on your bank cards.
• Click to Pay: for easy and convenient online shopping.
• Repay outstanding amounts on your credit card – minimum or full payment.
• Apple Pay: Add your bank cards in Apple Wallet for contactless payments.
• Card control and security: view your card details, including the PIN for virtual cards and check and adjust your transaction limits, choose new limits, set the card’s active region, or select usage channels (POS, Online, ATM).
• Installments: Split your credit card purchases into easy installments.
STAY INFORMED
• Loans – Access useful and detailed information about your loans.
• Notifications – Receive free alerts for every banking transaction.
• Detailed account statements – Check balances, transaction history, and fees. Export statements for both accounts and credit cards, including transaction history.
• Deposit information, including accrued interest and maturity dates.
• Easy navigation to Fibank branches and ATMs with up-to-date photos.
YOUR SECURITY IS OUR PRIORITY
Choose your preferred login and identification method in the app: biometric data or PIN. You can change your security question used for password recovery and update your PIN. Screen recording is restricted.
IMPORTANT: Some of the services listed above may not be available:
• when using the Greek version of the app;
• if the full functionality of the application has not been activated.
Accessibility statement:
https://www.fibank.bg/en/documents/accessibility-statement 
Learn more at http://www.fibank.bg , http://www.fibank.gr or contact us at *bank or 0800 11 011 for Bulgaria and +30 2103006303 for Greece.

bluejetty:00018948:ios.description:
The first ever mobile game based on the hit anime series Bungo Stray Dogs!
Take part in the mysterious literary battles of the Armed Detective Agency!
▼Anime scenes right on your phone!▼
The main story features extra information and new viewpoints on the original anime storyline!
Experience famous scenes and popular characters interacting in your very hands!
Event stories will feature never-before-seen game-original scenarios, as well as side stories not covered in the anime!
▼Easy-to-play Ability Battles!▼
Just pull and release to launch your attacks with the simple to use Ability Fling system!
High-power Abilities come with cool cut-in animations, too!
Beast Beneath the Moonlight, No Longer Human, Rashoumon...
Use these incredible Abilities to turn any fight in your favor, as the mini-characters move and attack with striking force!
▼Make your own original teams!▼
Featuring characters from the original anime, as well as characters in game-exclusive outfits, plus a range of adorable mini-characters taking the fight to their enemies!
Always wanted to see the Armed Detective Agency and Port Mafia working together? Now's your chance to make it happen!
Form your very own team and explore the dark and mysterious world of Bungo Stray Dogs!
▼Featuring original voice acting & new illustrations!▼
Nakajima Atsushi (VA: Yuto Uemura)
Dazai Osamu (VA: Mamoru Miyano)
Kunikida Doppo (VA: Yoshimasa Hosoya)
Edogawa Rampo (VA: Hiroshi Kamiya)
Izumi Kyouka (VA: Sumire Morohoshi)
Akutagawa Ryuunosuke (VA: Kensho Ono)
Nakahara Chuuya (VA: Kisho Taniyama)
▼Social Media Pages▼
Follow our official Facebook and Twitter pages for all the latest information.

bluejetty:00121593:ios.description:
Do you often find yourself indecisive and unable to make a decision? This feeling can cause anxiety and confusion, which can affect your life and work. Now, we have brought you an app designed specifically for this situation - Lucky Draw!
"Lucky Draw" is very simple and easy to use, allowing you to quickly randomly select pre-set items. Whether it's choosing what to eat, which movie to watch, or what to wear, you can easily make a decision with just a gentle tap.
In addition, "Lucky Draw" is designed with a clean and user-friendly interface that can be used anytime, anywhere. You can use it at home, in the office, on a trip, or anywhere you need to make a decision. Using this app can help you save a lot of trouble, time, and effort, making it easier for you to enjoy life.
Download "Lucky Draw" now and let decision-making no longer be a burden in your life. Make random choices fun and easy!
- Features -
1. Can randomly draw numbers within a specified range (e.g. 1 - 100,000).
2. Can customize the lottery content (e.g. names, prizes).
3. Can choose a theme color to represent the activity.
4. Instantly save lottery data to ensure that the lottery information will not be lost.
5. The results can be directly output as a PDF file and downloaded.
Contact us at Shrimp Studio: https://www.shrimpstudio.app

bluejetty:00015024:ios.description:
Sup human? I'm BAIKOH, a new and unique free word game, very different from what you are used to. I challenge your vocabulary and skill, try to write words by tapping tiles that randomly fall from the top of your screen, each tile has a letter so (hopefully)... you're getting the idea, genius.
Write words quickly and constantly to destroy tiles and keep them from reaching the top of your screen, or just use power-ups to make everything explode. That will work too.
The “get hyped” list:
• TOTALLY FREE WORD GAME! Yes, written in uppercase to grab your attention, you greedy human.
• ONLINE VERSUS MATCHES in real time. Make your friends suffer by writing words and sending them bombs, boulders, freezing tiles and more. The first one to reach the top loses the game!
• UNLOCK LOTS OF BADGES with the power to slash, ignite and blow up things.
• LEVEL UP! The better you get, the more your words will earn and the more you'll suffer.
• OBSESSIVELY CRAFTED WITH LOVE by my human pets: design, code, everything.
• Sarcastic humor.
• 100% candy-free app.
• No pay to play, no pay to win.
• IT’S FREE DAMMIT!
The storage permission is for storing cached ads on the SD memory card. The reasons are:
1. To save internal storage space and save data when not connected to WiFi.
2. More chances to watch rewarded ads (I confess this benefits me more than you).
NO, human, I don't want to spy on your files for embarrassing selfies or nudes. For more info about what I do with your data check my "Privacy Policy".
FOLLOW ME ON FACEBOOK! (That’s an order, human!)
www.facebook.com/playbaikoh
I would really love to hear your suggestions and feedback... totally.

Tapez rapidement et constamment pour détruire les tuiles et les empêcher d'atteindre le haut de votre écran, ou tout simplement utiliser des power-ups pour faire exploser tout. Cela fonctionnera aussi.
La liste "des choses intéressantes":
• JEU DE MOTS TOTALEMENT GRATUIT! Oui, écrit en majuscule pour attirer votre attention, vous êtes humain avide.
• BATTLES EN LIGNE en temps réel. Faites souffrir vos amis en leur envoyant des bombes, des rochers, des carreaux de congélation et plus encore. Le premier à atteindre le sommet perd le jeu!
• OBTENIR BEAUCOUP BADGES avec le pouvoir de slash, d'enflammer et de faire sauter des choses.
• LEVEL UP! Plus vous obtiendrez, plus vos mots gagneront et plus vous souffrirez.
• FAIT AVEC UN AMOUR OBSESSIONNEL par mes humains esclaves: design, code, tout.
• L'humour sarcastique.
• Application 100% sans bonbons.
• Pas de paie à jouer, pas de paie à gagner.
• C'est GRATUIT! que veux-tu de plus?
L'autorisation de stockage est pour stocker des annonces mises en cache sur la carte mémoire SD. Les raisons sont:
1. Pour économiser l'espace de stockage interne et enregistrer les données lorsqu'elles ne sont pas connectées au WiFi.
2. Plus de chances de regarder des publicités récompensées (j'avoue que cela me profite plus que toi).
NON, humain, je ne veux pas espionner vos fichiers pour des selfies ou des nus embarrassants. Pour plus d'informations sur ce que je fais avec vos données lire ma "Règles de confidentialité".
 • SUIVEZ-VOUS SUR FACEBOOK! (C'est une commande, humaine!)
www.facebook.com/playbaikoh
J'aimerais vraiment entendre vos suggestions et vos commentaires ... totalement.
 • TOUT DUR? LISEZ LA SECTION FAQ:
www.playbaikoh.com
...
 • ANY DOUBT? READ THE FAQ SECTION:
www.playbaikoh.com

bluejetty:00174492:ios.summary:
SEE A TRUSTED, WORLD CLASS ONLINE DOCTOR 
Get diagnosed and prescribed medications online. Major insurances accepted. Cost effective & convenient. Nationwide.
With over 300,000 users and counting PlushCare is a leading virtual primary ca
bluejetty:00174492:ios.description:
SEE A TRUSTED, WORLD CLASS ONLINE DOCTOR 
Get diagnosed and prescribed medications online. Major insurances accepted. Cost effective & convenient. Nationwide.
With over 300,000 users and counting PlushCare is a leading virtual primary care provider. Our physicians come from the top 50 U.S. medical schools and are licensed and U.S. board-certified. You can see our online doctors via phone or computer 365 days a year, including weekends and holidays for medical care and online treatments, including online prescriptions. Our physicians can treat over 3,500 medical conditions online and are committed to creating a stress free environment with positive patient outcomes.
97% of conditions are treated on the first visit. If the online doctor is unable to treat you, the appointment is free.
Our patients have consistently rated our medical care at close to 5 out of 5 stars across the most popular review platforms.
HERE’S WHAT PLUSHCARE PATIENTS ARE SAYING
"I'm a busy guy with work often finding myself out of area. I've used PlushCare a couple of times and couldn't be happier. Doctors are always nice and professional and appointments are easy to get."
"Outstanding service. Both my husband and I used the service. It's so much easier than going and sitting in an emergency room or clinic with other people and their germs. A great way to be checked out!"
HOW DOES A VISIT WITH A PLUSHCARE DOCTOR WORK?
To book an appointment simply select a time and preferred doctor from our booking page. Then enter your insurance information (if applicable), create an account, select your preferred pharmacy, and at your appointment time, video chat with the doctor of your choice via smartphone or webcam.
During your online consultation the online doctor will ask about your medical history as well as any current medications and supplements you may be taking. They will want to hear about your symptoms and together you will create a treatment plan.
WHAT DOES PLUSHCARE COMMONLY TREAT?
PlushCare offers virtual primary care for ongoing conditions, and virtual urgent care for non-emergency conditions. Our physicians have treated over 3,500 medical conditions online.
PRIMARY CARE FOR:
Acne
Anxiety
Asthma
Back pain
Depression
Diabetes
Erectile dysfunction
Hair loss
High blood pressure
High cholesterol
Thyroid conditions
Insomnia
And many more...
URGENT CARE FOR
Allergies
Bronchitis
Colds
Dental infections
Diarrhea
Ear pain
Flu
Headache/migraines
Nausea
PEP
Pink eye
Pneumonia
Rash
Sinus infection
Strep throat
Tonsillitis
UTIs
Vaginitis
Yeast infections
And many more...
COMMON ONLINE PRESCRIPTIONS OUR DOCTORS WRITE
Antibiotics (Amoxicillin, Penicillin, Augmentin)
Antiviral medications (Acyclovir, Valtrex)
Antidepressants (Prozac, Sertraline, Trazodone, Zoloft)
Antipsychotics (Olanzapine)
Birth Control (Apri, Yaz)
PrEP (Truvada, Descovy)
Diuretics (Bumex, Demadex)
Pain Killers (Naproxen, Voltaren)
High blood pressure medication (Amlodipine, Propranolol, Valsartan)
Diabetes medication (Metformin, Diabeta)
And many more...
WHAT IS PLUSHCARE’S PRESCRIPTION POLICY?
Our online doctor's can write a refill or initiation prescription on all medications not classified as controlled substances for 90 days. It is important to note that our doctors are highly trained physicians and will defer to their best medical judgement during your appointment
CAN I USE MY INSURANCE AND HOW MUCH WILL MY VISIT COST?
PlushCare accepts insurance from major insurance providers. Insured patients will pay their typical office visit copay. The average insured patient pays less than $25. 
We also accept patients without insurance. This is much more affordable than an in-person urgent care or primary care uninsured appointment.
CAN MY CHILDREN SEE A PLUSHCARE DOCTOR?
Yes. PlushCare has friendly & experienced pediatricians on staff.
For more information, you can visit our FAQ page at support.plushcare.com

bluejetty:00033792:ios.description:
Проверять гос номер авто важно перед покупкой машины.
Приложение «Номерограм» позволяет найти историю продаж и отдельные фото машины в Интернете по гос номеру. Пробить по гос номеру авто у нас можно бесплатно.
Установите «Номерограм». Введите в поиск гос номер, и мы найдём вам историю продажи машины или отдельные её фото из Интернета. Покажем даты размещения объявления, цену и пробег.
В нашей базе свыше 25 000 000 номеров. Фотографии в «Номерограм» приходят как от людей (можно добавить фото машины с гос номером через приложение), так и с досок объявлений, социальных сетей и других сайтов. Всё из открытых источников.
«Номерограм» найдёт для вас по гос номеру:
Пробег автомобиля.
Если автомобиль ранее размещался на авито, автору, дром и т.д., мы найдём его фотографии и покажем пробег, который указал продавец в объявлении. Наша база непрерывно пополняется. 
Цена машины.
Также мы сможем показать вам цену машины. А если она продавалась несколько раз, то вы сможете увидеть историю изменения цены. Это полезная информация, которая поможет вам поторговаться.
Город продажи.
Мы можем находить не только пробеги и цены, но и города продажи автомобиля. Всегда интересно узнать, где бегала машина ранее. 
Фото ДТП и ремонтов.
«Номерограм» мониторит не только доски объявлений, но и другие ресурсы. Поиск по номеру может помочь вам увидеть фото ДТП или процесс ремонта автомобиля.
Ещё вы можете по фото выяснить, что машина бегала в такси.
Несколько показательных примеров:
Скрутил 100 000 километров пробега — А 774 СО 716
Жёсткое ДТП, машину восстановили — А 714 НТ 38
Была в ДТП и работала в такси — Т 146 УС 56
Бесславный конец японской гонки — О 461 ЕА 125
И это не всё!
Мы хотим сделать мир лучше и помочь покупателям подержанных машин. Всё-таки приятно подстраховать себя перед покупкой авто, а не играть в лотерею. Для этого «Номерограм» и сделан.
Добавляйте фото машин с гос номерами в «Номерограм» и радости в жизни прибавится!

bluejetty:00062098:ios.name: Conversation Therapy Lite
bluejetty:00062098:ios.summary: Work more effectively toward your speech therapy goals. Help people who have had a stroke, live with autism, or have a speech or language impairment get talking with an app that sparks conversation. The best way to improve talking is by tal
bluejetty:00062098:ios.description:
Work more effectively toward your speech therapy goals. Help people who have had a stroke, live with autism, or have a speech or language impairment get talking with an app that sparks conversation. The best way to improve talking is by talking!
Download this free sample version of Conversation Therapy to try it for yourself! 
- Get a tool that helps adults, teens, and children put therapy strategies into practice
- Improve language, social skills, speech, and thinking while using this powerful speech therapy app
- Carryover the lessons from speech therapy at home with an app that’s easy for everyone to use
- Focus on what matters – stop racking your brain for fresh topics and let the app guide you
- Take things in any direction with thousands of possible conversation starters
- Create the right experience for each person with customizable settings
- Talk one-on-one, host groups of up to 4 at a time, and track improvement with ease
Coming up with fresh, attention-grabbing conversation starters every day is surprisingly hard, even for speech therapy professionals. Think of this app as your talk facilitator, taking the pressure and planning out of starting and maintaining dialogue while you monitor how your clients use their speech strategies.
"This is the app that is going to pave the way for converting speech therapists to the digital age."
- Ryan Knoblauch, SLP, The Speech Knob
GETTING STARTED IS AS EASY AS 1, 2, 3
Target higher-level expressive language, pragmatic, problem-solving, speech, and cognitive-communication goals with open-ended conversation starters. Here’s how it works.
1) CHOOSE YOUR CATEGORIES. Tailor your experience with specific topics like Food or Health, or select all topics for free-flowing discussion that could go anywhere! You can always change the settings to see only age-appropriate categories for children, teens, or adults.
*This free Lite version of the app has 3 photos and 30 questions suitable for all ages*
2) START THE CONVERSATION. Look at the picture, then touch any of the 10 buttons to see a question. The questions on the left are simpler (like “What is…?”) while the ones on the right are more complex (“How do you know…?”). Hear the question aloud, record your own audio, and score answers as you go.
3) USE YOUR STRATEGIES. While taking turns discussing the answers to the questions, use your word-finding strategies, smooth speech techniques, or other personalized therapy approaches to communicate more clearly.
ALL DONE? E-mail an automatically generated summary of your results, along with any audio, or share the results to a PDF, file storage, printer, or copy/paste.
GET EVERY FEATURE YOU NEED IN THE FULL APP
- 275+ vivid photos, with 10 questions per photo, for over 2750 possible questions in the full app; 3 photos in the Lite version
- 10 languages: English, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Zulu
- 11 categories full of real-world topics including daily life, hobbies, current events, social issues, health concerns, and much more in the full app
- Record audio at any time with just a tap
- Perfect for treating language, cognitive-communication, pragmatic, and speech disorders
- Great as stimulus material to work on fluency, articulation, eye contact, and word-finding strategies in spontaneous speech
- No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
BETTER DISCUSSIONS MEAN BETTER PRACTICE. Inspire curiosity and creativity while motivating people to keep improving – DOWNLOAD IT NOW!
Once you've had a chance to try this free Lite app, download the full version of Conversation Therapy to get so much more content.
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at tactustherapy.com/find

bluejetty:00135026:ios.description:
The World's First Patented Digital Antler Scoring Application
Ever wondered how to score deer? Curious what the easiest way to score a deer is? BuckScore® is your answer! Holding two U.S. issued patents, BuckScore® is the only science-proven program that allows you to score pictures of bucks in minutes. The app accurately estimates antler size including spread, beam length, tine length, and circumference all to calculate a Net and Gross score within 3% of the actual score. With BuckScore®, you have one app that organizes, documents, and scores all of your big bucks. Take a trail cam photo and get new insights with the ability to estimate the score of a buck on the hoof. Calculate size on harvest photos from years past. BuckScore® is easier and saves you time over the normal tape and note pad mess. Join BuckScore® Today!
* The BuckScore® program’s accuracy is contingent upon the quality of your photo, the accuracy of the reference feature, accurate buck information (age of buck and location by state), and the manual insertion of measurement points input by the individual. These elements are also used to determine if the photo is “scoreable”. The BuckScore® program’s final gross and net score accuracy comes from your ability to measure the reference feature perfectly. On mobile, as convenient as it may seem, your finger/stylus can add extra error to scoring if not measured properly. The BuckScore® program is not an “automatic” program as it does requires manual drawing of start and stop points on each measurement to achieve an accurate result. If you are not satisfied with the ability of the BuckScore® program, please contact us for additional resources and help from a BuckScore® specialist. 
** BuckScore subscription required to score photos

Bringing you free texting, free picture messaging, a free US phone number, free inbound phone calls, and cheap outbound phone calls for nearly a decade! Works over WiFi or data to keep you connected with family and friends around the globe. 

text+ gives you:

- A free US Phone number so friends can call & text you (you pick the area code)
- Free texting (SMS, MMS + group chat) to any US or Canadian mobile number
- Free inbound phone calls
- Toll-free calling from anywhere in the world with no restrictions!
- Inexpensive outbound phone calls
- Works great over WiFi so you don’t even need a 3G/4G connection. 
- No contracts, no “surprise” costs.
- Turn your iPod touch and iPad into a phone!

Why keep paying for expensive mobile phone plans when you can switch to text+ and save $$$! 

IN APP SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS 
- If you choose to subscribe to a plan, you will be charged a price according to the plan selected in your country. The price will be shown in the app before you complete the payment.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of your current period 
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the purchase price listed above 
- You may manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings and then “Manage Subscriptions” 

* IMPORTANT: 
- We do not support 911 in the US
- In order to place most outbound phone calls you will need to purchase credits within the App
- If push notifications are not enabled, you may not receive messages and calls

Terms of Use: https://textplus.com/textplus-terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://textplus.com/textplus-privacy-policy/

Subscription Products:
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication

bluejetty:00183444:ios.summary:
FEATURES OF AUTORESERVE

bluejetty:00183444:ios.description:
FEATURES OF AUTORESERVE
AutoReserve lets you search and book restaurants, cafés, bars and more worldwide in one app.
BOOK PHONE-ONLY RESTAURANTS WITH AI
Many popular places still only accept reservations by phone. With AutoReserve, our AI makes those calls for you, so you never have to pick up the phone yourself. Even if you submit a request after the restaurant has closed for the day, the AI automatically calls during the next business hours and tries to secure your table.
EASY BOOKING FOR RESTAURANTS ABROAD
If you have ever struggled to book restaurants while traveling abroad, AutoReserve makes it much simpler. You can request a table in the app, and our AI contacts the local restaurant on your behalf. This helps you reserve popular spots at your destination in the countries and regions where AutoReserve is available, without worrying about language or phone calls.
PERFECT FOR MOMENTS LIKE THESE
- Booking a table when making a call is difficult.
- Reserving a place you really want to visit, even if you feel uncomfortable making phone calls.
- Quickly finding restaurants near your current location that you can book on the spot.
- Securing a seat at any available spot when a last-minute drinking plan pops up.
- Searching by budget, area and detailed preferences to find the right place, from casual dinners to large parties.
- Planning a weekend date and reserving a popular Michelin-listed restaurant with private rooms.
- Working through your saved list in order and booking whichever restaurant has an open table.
- Booking popular local spots while traveling abroad, including even hard-to-book restaurants.
* Source: Internal survey of bookable restaurants across major dining reservation services (As of November 2025)

bluejetty:00120153:ios.name: Gran Cursos Online
bluejetty:00120153:ios.summary:
Baixe agora o maior, melhor e mais completo app para concursos públicos e Exame de Ordem do país!
Com o app do Gran Cursos Online, você poderá acessar um moderno Ambiente de Estudos e as seguintes funcionalidades que vão acelerar a sua apr
bluejetty:00120153:ios.description:
Baixe agora o maior, melhor e mais completo app para concursos públicos e Exame de Ordem do país!
Com o app do Gran Cursos Online, você poderá acessar um moderno Ambiente de Estudos e as seguintes funcionalidades que vão acelerar a sua aprovação:
1. Assistir às videoaulas em modo offline (como na Netflix);
2. Ouvir as audioaulas em modo offline (como no Spotify);
3. Ler as nossas aulas em PDF autossuficientes;
4. Montar um cronograma de estudos automático em que você apresentará os dias e os horários nos quais pode estudar e, automaticamente, o sistema montará um plano de estudos pra você;
5. Ao acessar o app, retomar os estudos exatamente do minuto e segundo da videoaula em que parou de assistir ou do número da página do PDF em que parou de ler;
6. Simulados inéditos: faça simulados com questões 100% focadas no edital do concurso para o qual você está estudando.
7. Mapas mentais: tenha acesso a mapas mentais que o auxiliarão na fixação do conteúdo.
8. Caderno de questões: ao estudar um determinado tema, forneceremos a você um caderno de questões com exercícios focados no assunto que você acabou de ler ou assistir.
9. Degravação: nossas videoaulas contam com um PDF de degravação do que é abordado no vídeo.
10. Videoaulas com resolução Full HD (1080p).
11. Videoaulas com legenda. Ao habilitar a legenda, você pode aumentar a absorção do conteúdo, pois gera um estímulo a mais para o cérebro. Além disso, caso tenha algum nível de deficiência auditiva e seja oralizado, o Gran Cursos Online é para você. Somos a única empresa no mercado que se preocupa com os deficientes auditivos oralizados.
12. Download de todas as videoaulas, aulas em PDF, audioaulas e mapas mentais em PDF com apenas 1 clique, por disciplina. Após efetuar o download, caso você perca a conexão com a internet, o sistema habilitará o modo offline, e você continuará estudando normalmente.
13. Sincronize os dados offline com o online. Ao assistir às videoaulas e ler PDFs em modo offline, automaticamente enviaremos os dados aos nossos servidores, no momento em que você se reconectar à internet. Assim, o seu desempenho será mantido, além do cronograma de estudos.
14. Cast: por meio da função CAST, transmita a videoaula diretamente para a sua TV. A função de legenda e acelerador do vídeo também é mantida na TV.
15. Conexão simultânea: agora é permitida a conexão simultânea entre a plataforma web e o app, ou seja, você não será derrubado, caso queira usar o celular ou tablet como apoio.
16. Player similar ao do YouTube. Assim, você não perde tempo tentando aprender as funções de um novo player.
17. Layout 100% desenvolvido para que as funções necessárias ao seu estudo estejam a poucos cliques e de forma bem visível.
18. Reprodução automática: a próxima videoaula será executada automaticamente.
Não sou aluno do Gran Cursos Online, o que ganho ao baixar o app?
1. Há cursos gratuitos para todas as carreiras com conteúdo básico.
2. Notícias quentes sobre concursos públicos em tempo real.
3. Avisos sobre eventos gratuitos e promoções para você ficar por dentro do mundo dos concursos públicos.
Aproveite e baixe agora o app do Gran Cursos Online!
Termos de uso: https://www.grancursosonline.com.br/termos-de-uso
Política de privacidade: https://www.grancursosonline.com.br/politica-de-privacidade

bluejetty:00032191:ios.description:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of numbers with X2 Number Merge Puzzle 2048, an incredible brain-teasing game crafted by Unico Studio, the brilliant minds behind popular titles like Brain Test and 2048 Blast. Building upon their legacy of mind-bending games, X2: Number Merge Puzzle 2048 invites you to embark on an enchanting numerical journey.
Prepare for an addictive puzzle experience that will put your critical thinking and quick reflexes to the test. Your main objective is to merge numbers displayed on the screen, creating larger numbers and aiming for the highest score possible.
As you connect larger number blocks, the challenge escalates: 1024 -> 2048 -> 4K -> 8K ->16K ->32K and onward to Infinity ∞. Imagine 2048 meets bubble shooter - X2: Number Merge Puzzle 2048 combines elements from popular casual and classic games.
The more you play, the more irresistible it becomes, making it nearly impossible to put down. If you've enjoyed games like Drop the Number, Number Blocks, Brick, Numbers, Connect Blocks, Math Puzzle Games, Color Matching, Sudoku, or any type of merge cube games, rest assured, you're in for a treat with this Wi-Fi-free gaming experience. 
Play without the internet - our free game lets you explore new worlds offline. Game from the Creators of 2248: Number Puzzle 2048 and 2048 Blast: Merge 2248 Numbers games.

All you know is he’s your Neighbor, and it’s up to you to figure out what he’s hiding. Nicky’s Diaries follows Nicky’s in-depth quest of figuring out what Mr. Peterson is hiding. 

A multitude of puzzles awaits.


To unlock the secrets of Nicky's past, you'll need to solve intricate puzzles and utilize objects hidden throughout the environment. Sneak past CCTV cameras, disable motion detectors around the doors and improvise with multiple tools at your disposal.

Equip yourself.

Utilize JUMP BOOTS to reach higher vantage points, X-RAY GLASSES to locate the Neighbor and sneak past him, EMP devices to disable traps, and no Neighbor game would be complete without throwing jugs of glue.

Prepare for the BASEMENT.

Take a deep breath and brace yourself before entering the basement, as there is more there than meets the eye.

bluejetty:00124144:ios.name: Police Car Driving: Crime City
bluejetty:00124144:ios.summary: Ready to become the latest in the line of duty of the best police in the city? Get straight into the epic police driving action as you take to the streets and uphold the law to put a stop to dangerous drivers and ruthless criminal in one of
bluejetty:00124144:ios.description:
Ready to become the latest in the line of duty of the best police in the city? Get straight into the epic police driving action as you take to the streets and uphold the law to put a stop to dangerous drivers and ruthless criminal in one of the best first person police car driving simulator games!
Perform your cop duty, take on reports to find and arrest criminal drivers to help clear the city streets of crime. Choose from a wide selection of top of the line police grade cars and police motorbikes. Take the call over your police radio, blast the police car sirens, and pursue the criminal in the all-new police car driving action game!
!! Police Car Driving: Crime City is a new open world driving simulator !!
Explore the city and drive real police cop cars and motorbike in the huge open world, filled with miles of road to drive on. Exit your vehicle at any time to explore on foot, patrol the streets around the city and surrounding countryside in the exciting open world action game. Blast past busy city rush hour traffic on you police motorbike riding at top speeds!
Experience real police duty action, take on unique cop missions like vehicle takedowns, hostage situations, V.I.P. vehicle escorts, drug busts, and a whole load more! All-new exciting police crime-fighting action ready to play right now!
Example of missions:
- Save victims in hostage situations
- Chase and pursue dangerous criminal drivers
- Take on risky crime hideout bust-ups
- Protect and escort V.I.P vehicles
- Stop and arrest all the gangsters with police SUVs and other cops cars
- Drive quickly to stop fleeing criminals
Upgrade your police gear with new, more powerful weapons and vehicles. Get the keys to drive your own police vehicle from a wide selection of city cars, sports motorbikes, offroad 4x4 trucks, dirtbikes, and more fast cop vehicles! Take on the criminal robbers with Desert Eagles, M16, hand grenades, mini-guns, and a whole load more to try out!!
All thrills action of police motorbike riding can be played now! At any time alerts from the police radio, accept the police response and make your way to the crime to get right into the real cop action. If that doesn't sound like your style, decline the call and explore the city open world in your cop car, motorbike, or on foot. Do whatever it takes to be one of the best police officers!
Features:
- A huge, incredibly detailed open world environment
- Miles of intricate road systems to drive on, city road and offroad!
- A realistic police car and motorbike driving simulator
- Realistic driving and first-person gameplay physics
- Real-time vehicles damage
- High-quality police vehicles and weapons
- Unlimited mission objectives, non-stop action!!
- Dynamic camera angles
- Easy to play driving controls, use touch, wheel and tilt controls!
Watch out for your health and your vehicle's stability, be sure to look out for garages and hospitals around the city for police vehicle repair and player health packs to keep you going longer in the line of police duty.
Witness non-stop action in the latest police driving game as it brings you closer to the realistic police duty. A massive open world for the best police driving simulator game experience! Drive, drift, crash, chase, and arrest criminals around a huge detailed open city with real police cars and cop motorbikes! 
Play the most realistic action-packed police motorbike and car driving game you'll ever experience, Police Car Driving: Crime City

Clean up your camera roll by swiping. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep, and watch the storage you free up grow with every photo.

START WHEREVER THE MESS IS
- By month: work through your library one month at a time

SEE YOUR PROGRESS

EXTRA TOOLS

- Album Cleaner
- Video Compressor
- PDF Creator
- Hidden Photos

FREE AND PRO
Delete up to 15 photos and videos in total for free. Swiping and sorting stay free. Once you have used this allowance, deleting requires Unroller Pro. Pro also unlocks the extra tools and is available as an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.
Built by one developer who reads every email. Questions or ideas: support@unroller.app

bluejetty:00150146:ios.summary: Dogwood Branch is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by
bluejetty:00150146:ios.description:
Dogwood Branch is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Dogwood Branch:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Dogwood Branch app, you must be enrolled as a Dogwood State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00185388:ios.summary:
Online team-based action horror. Play with others in real-time. Who will get caught and sacrificed by the angry butcher, and who will escape and stay alive? It’s all up to you.
Join the camp of 7 different survivors, each with their own un
bluejetty:00185388:ios.description:
Online team-based action horror. Play with others in real-time. Who will get caught and sacrificed by the angry butcher, and who will escape and stay alive? It’s all up to you.
Join the camp of 7 different survivors, each with their own unique role and set of abilities:
BASKETBALL PLAYER can run away from the maniac faster than the other players
DOCTOR heals himself and other players
ENGINEER can fix generators around the asylum and crafts items more quickly
THIEF has high stealth and dexterity
MERCENARY is a brave soldier with high morale
SCIENTIST can upgrade military equipment and spread his aura of wisdom to the other survivors
POLICE OFFICER can catch the murderer
Creepy online hide-and-seek game seek is about to begin! Try to stay alive and avoid a scary death!
You also can play as 4 different psychos, each with a unique set of skills and a trademark hunting style:
BUTCHER breaks the generators to prevent his prey from escaping
CULTIST is a damned monster who has escaped from the mental hospital and yearns to sacrifice the survivors
GHOST can pass through walls like a true poltergeist and terrify its victims
BEAST hungry werewolf monster that can turn into a bloodthirsty wolf
The psycho’s goal is very simple — search the desolate shelter, bewilder every victim hiding in the dark labyrinth and commit murder.
GAME FEATURES:
- Maniac mode allows you to independently develop a strategy for hunting your victims
- Survivor mode allows players to cooperatively escape from the killer
- Authentic character leveling and unique skills
- Unique crafting system - create and upgrade items at workshops and smithies
- High-detailed locations with the atmosphere of post-apocalypse and creepy game
- Coming soon: clans, quests, and leaderboards
Horrorfield - multiplayer horror game, might be the most terrifying horror adventure of your life!
Four victims versus one psycho. Choose your side.
Contact us at support@skytecgames.com
Terms of Service: http://www.skytecgames.com/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.skytecgames.com/privacy-policy.html

Create a personal Advent calendar and gift it to someone you love: 24 doors filled with photos, videos, voice messages and little surprises, opening one by one in December.
Newly redesigned for 2026: fresh calendar designs, a warmer, calme
bluejetty:00185976:ios.description:
Create a personal Advent calendar and gift it to someone you love: 24 doors filled with photos, videos, voice messages and little surprises, opening one by one in December.
Newly redesigned for 2026: fresh calendar designs, a warmer, calmer look, voice messages behind any door, and full iPad support with iCloud sync — in 20 languages.
Why you'll love the Advent App
Doors made for your loved one
Fill every door with your favorite photos and videos, a special song, a voucher, a funny quote, or a little memory you know they'll smile about.
Fill it your way, not all at once
Because the calendar is digital, you don't need to finish everything by December 1. Add doors as you go and update them whenever you like.
Gentle reminders so you never miss a day
If you enable notifications, we'll send you a little reminder the day before each door opens.
No account needed
When you create your calendar, we generate a custom link you can send to your loved ones via WhatsApp, SMS or email. No sign-up for anyone — they simply download the free Advent App, tap your link, and their calendar is ready.
Share with as many people as you like
One calendar, one link — send it to one special person or the whole family.
Gift it ad-free — or send it for free
Sending an ad-free calendar is a one-time purchase per calendar — no subscription. And if you'd rather not pay, there's a free option too: your loved one simply watches a short ad before opening each door.
Have fun creating and gifting, and have a tree-mendous holiday season!
Your Advent App Team

bluejetty:00091545:ios.name: Journal
bluejetty:00091545:ios.summary: Take a moment to reflect on your day. Capture and write about the details of everyday moments and special events using photos, videos, audio recordings, places, your state of mind, and more. Journaling suggestions make it easy to remember y
bluejetty:00091545:ios.description:
Take a moment to reflect on your day. Capture and write about the details of everyday moments and special events using photos, videos, audio recordings, places, your state of mind, and more. Journaling suggestions make it easy to remember your daily experiences—so you can add them to your journal and never have to start with a blank page. Organize your entries by creating multiple journals for different aspects of your life, keep track of your journaling goals with insights and streaks, and sync your journal between iPhone, iPad, and Mac using iCloud.
Get started writing with journaling suggestions
• Choose from suggested moments to start your journal entry with intelligently grouped outings, photos, workouts, media and more.
• Get a writing prompt to guide your insights.
• Find inspiration with reflection prompts to focus on gratitude, kindness, purpose, and more.
• Journaling suggestions are created using on-device intelligence based on how you use your iPhone. Choose what information you want to enable for suggestions.
• Suggestions created on your iPhone sync securely to iPad.
Preserve powerful memories in rich detail
• Illustrate your entries with the photos, videos, and places that tell your story. Customize the layout by placing attachments seamlessly within the text you write.
• Get inspired to keep writing by asking for prompts tailored to the contents of your entry.
• Get creative and express yourself with lettering, sketches, and doodles using your finger, or Apple Pencil on iPad. And you can make your journal even more personal with entries in your own handwriting.
• Record your voice directly into your journal and have it transcribed automatically, or record your surroundings to add context to your entry.
• Express yourself with text formatting options, including lists, quotes, and various text styles.
• Add a widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen that shows your current streak at a glance or presents writing prompts that change throughout the day so you can reflect on what’s going on in the moment.
• Start a new entry and add content from other apps like News, Music, or Safari.
• Keep your entries organized by creating multiple journals for different aspects of your life, and add a custom name and icon for each.
Enjoy past moments
• Browse, search, and sort your journal to look back and reflect on key moments in your life.
• Easily find past entries using the calendar.
• See entries written at a specific location or find entries you made nearby in the new Places view.
• View each entry and its attachments in a beautiful fullscreen view.
• Print or export your entries.
Build a good habit
• View your journaling streaks, the days you journaled, and other fun stats in the new Insights view.
• Set a schedule or receive notifications at convenient times based on how you use the app. You’ll get reminders when it’s time to write, or when new journaling suggestions are ready, so you can keep a consistent journaling practice.
Journal for wellbeing
• Log your state of mind right from within Journal and save it to the Health app.
• Automatically save your writing time as Mindful Minutes in Health.
• Keep your journal private and secure
• Protect your journal with your device passcode, Touch ID, or Face ID, so no one but you can access it.
• Store your entries safely in iCloud so they’re automatically backed up.
Certain features are available only in select languages and regions.

-Encoding: We support both Constant Bitrate(CBR) and Variable Bitrate(VBR) encoding.
-Sample Rate: You can choose a sample rate from 8K to 48K.
# Audio Merger
** Merge almost any format Audios to any other format. We support MP3, AAC, AC3, WAV, OGG, and FLAC files as input and output formats.
** All our features support Batch Processing.

bluejetty:00144930:ios.description:
A modern baby monitor for two phones: with Mamka, one device becomes the baby camera and the other becomes the parent monitor.
Watch and listen at home on Wi-Fi or on the go via mobile data (4G/5G/LTE).
Perfect for travel and as a backup when you don’t have a dedicated baby monitor with you.
PAIR QUICKLY
Connect the baby device and parent monitor via QR code — quick to set up, ready right away.
MULTIPLE MONITORS & CAMERAS
Connect multiple parent devices (monitors) and multiple baby devices (cameras) — ideal for multiple kids, rooms, or caregivers.
MONITOR FROM ANYWHERE
Use your iPhone, iPad, or a web browser on your computer — keep an eye on your baby wherever it’s most convenient.
PRIVACY MATTERS
• No ads. No tracking for advertising purposes.
• Live streaming is encrypted.
• Live streams are not stored.
• Cloud events are optional — if enabled, they’re automatically deleted after 30 days.
SOUND & MOTION DETECTION (WITH ALERTS)
Mamka detects sound and motion and notifies you instantly — so you can react fast, even when you’re not looking at the screen.
OPTIONAL CLOUD EVENTS (PHOTOS/CLIPS)
When enabled, Mamka automatically saves photos or short clips for detected events — handy for checking later what happened.
• Continuous event capture
• 30-day history, automatic deletion
• Content can be deleted manually at any time
PICTURE-IN-PICTURE (PiP)
Keep the stream in a floating window while using other apps — perfect for everyday life, work, or chores.
TWO-WAY COMMUNICATION
Comfort your child live — talk to your baby and stay connected even when you’re not in the room.
SLEEP VIDEOS & LULLABIES (INCLUDING YOUR UPLOADS)
Play calming sleep videos or lullabies — including your own audio/video recordings your baby recognizes.
REMOTE START — EVEN WHEN THE BABY DEVICE IS LOCKED
Start the baby camera remotely, even if the baby device is locked — especially helpful when the phone is already in the nursery.
APP LOCK / CHILD-PROOF PROTECTION
Protect the baby camera app from being closed by accident — so monitoring keeps running reliably.
UP TO 4K VIDEO QUALITY
Choose the quality from SD up to 4K UHD — for smooth monitoring or maximum sharpness, depending on your device and connection.
HOW IT WORKS (2 PHONES)
1) Install Mamka on the baby device (camera)
2) Install Mamka on the parent device (monitor)
3) Pair, start, watch and listen live
IDEAL FOR
• Monitoring your baby while you’re busy at home
• Checking in while you’re away or at work
• Watching multiple kids or rooms at the same time
• Travel: forgot your baby monitor? Just use two phones
• Reusing an old smartphone as a baby camera
FREE TRIAL & SUBSCRIPTION
New users get a free trial. After that, a subscription is required to keep using Mamka.
Please read the Terms of Use (EULA) before using the app:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00098897:android.description:
Breaking News — Local News & Breaking Alerts
Stay connected to what matters most with Breaking News—your personalized local news and world news reader. Get breaking news alerts, follow trending topics, and stay ready with local weather forecasts and weather alerts. From neighborhood updates to major global headlines, we curate stories from trusted publishers so you can stay informed every day.
What you’ll get
- Local News Near You: Discover local updates, community stories, and city headlines—built for staying informed where you live.
- Breaking News Alerts: Instant notifications for urgent updates and major events. Customize alerts by topics you care about.
- Personalized News Feed: Choose categories and interests to create your own daily news stream—less noise, more relevance.
- Trending Headlines & Topics: Track what’s trending locally and across the world, all in one place.
- World & National Coverage: Follow big stories, national headlines, and international developments as they happen.
- Weather Forecasts & Alerts: Real-time local weather, forecasts, and important weather changes—so you can plan ahead.
- Quick Daily Briefing: Scan key stories fast when you’re short on time.
⭐️⭐️Breaking News Features⭐️⭐️:
🌎 Comprehensive Local and Global Coverage
Breaking News brings you the most relevant local stories alongside major breaking news from around the world. From community events to international headlines, our platform curates content from trusted newspapers and media sources, ensuring you stay informed about the issues that matter most to you.
🔔 Instant Alerts for Breaking News
Never miss a moment with our instant notifications for breaking news and significant local events. Customize your alerts to receive updates on the topics you care about, whether it’s urgent news from your neighborhood or global developments. With Breaking News, you’ll be the first to know.
⭐️ Personalized News Feed
Tailor your news experience with our personalized feed that highlights local updates, breaking news, and weather alerts. Choose your favorite categories and topics to receive a news stream that resonates with your interests, ensuring you stay engaged with the latest happenings in your community and beyond.
🔥 Stay Ahead with Trending Headlines
Be at the forefront of the news cycle with Breaking News. Our platform sources the latest breaking news and trending stories from both local and international media. Stay informed about the events shaping your world, all while enjoying a seamless reading experience.
🌥️ Up-to-Date Weather Insights
Plan your day with confidence using our real-time weather updates. Get essential weather forecasts and alerts tailored to your local area, helping you prepare for any significant events or changes in conditions. With Breaking News, you’ll always be ready for what lies ahead.
👁️🗨️ Quick Overview of Local Events
Stay in the loop with our quick overview feature that highlights the most important local events and breaking news of the day. Browse through key updates in just a few minutes and keep your finger on the pulse of what’s happening around you.
Download Breaking News to read US local news, national headlines, world news, breaking alerts, trending stories, and weather updates—all in one app.

bluejetty:00083904:ios.description:
ShopShops was named the Best Livestream Shopping App of the Year by Retail Boss for 2022. ShopShops eliminates all the stressful guesswork of online shopping and instantly connects shoppers with the most coveted new, discounted, pre-loved and pre-owned designer items. On ShopShops, you can follow and interact with hosts and sellers directly to know exactly what you're buying, while taking part in instantly shoppable video streams that are always fun, timely, and genuine.
LIVE SHOPPING
Interact with live shopping shows from your favorite sellers, chat directly with shoppers and hosts, and securely purchase unique products, all without ever leaving the app. New shows are added daily, and you can follow hosts or RSVP to live streams to get notified the moment they go live.
UNLOCK UP TO $500 OF SHOPPING REWARDS
Every new shopper receives a $75 coupon to apply to the first purchase and up to an additional $500 to apply to purchases. All you have to do is complete actions like following hosts, RSVPing to live events, and commenting on live shows.
GLOBAL COMMUNITY
Join a global community to buy products from NYC, Miami, LA, Paris, Milan, Tokyo, Osaka, Madrid, London, Dubai, and more exciting cities. Including: designer bags, vintage clothes, streetwear, luxury watches, high-end jewelry, antiques, and so much more.
DEALS & GIVEAWAYS
Shop and save money with daily exclusive deals and discounts from all over the world – right in the ShopShops app. You can find deals on pre-loved and pre-owned products from brands like Luis Vuitton, Gucci, Chanel, Prada, Burberry, Rolex, Hermes, and Dior. We also host weekly giveaways and offers during our Mystery Box live event series.
BUY NOW PAY LATER
When you shop in the ShopShops app, you can pay immediately or split the cost of your purchases into 4 smaller, interest-free payments.
LEARN MORE
Whether you’re a designer and luxury lover, a beauty products collector, a home decor enthusiast, or just looking for some retail therapy, there’s something for everyone in the ShopShops apps. All you have to do is watch, and engage with what inspires you, and you’ll find an endless stream of inspirational shopping videos that feel personalized just for you. 
Follow us @shopshops_official to stay in the loop and learn about our latest partnerships and deals.

bluejetty:00123539:ios.description:
The first time you sign into the app you’ll receive 100 reward points to redeem towards premium Omaha Steaks products with your next purchase!
The Omaha Steaks app is loaded with gourmet-focused features from easy shopping and gifts to Steaklover Rewards to a one-of-a-kind interactive steak cooking timer. It’s the complete experience for anyone who loves to make, eat, and share great food.
SCAN TO BUY
Use your smartphone’s camera with your Omaha Steaks catalogs and experience the newest, most convenient way to shop. Just point your camera at any page of the catalog and you’re shopping our deals in the app.
STEAK & COOKING TIMER
Don’t guess at the grill! Your Omaha Steaks app includes a helpful interactive timer that’s at your side the whole time you’re cooking. Expert-chef presets for steaks, roasts, seafood, and smoking/barbeque are built in.
