• Add as many different items as you want to your timer
• Complete step-by-step directions before you start
• Countdowns and heads-up for the next step
• Notifications and audio alerts as you cook
• When to flip; When to turn; When to remove; Resting time
• Cook anything from a small grilled filet mignon to a full smoked brisket
RECIPES
The complete library of Omaha Steaks-approved recipes is here. Find your new favorite by steak, by meal, by ingredients, or by occasion… the app will teach you how to create something amazing for your table.
STEAKLOVER REWARDS
Members of our rewards program get free Omaha Steaks food items, discounts when they shop, and exclusive deals. Use the app to easily track your points, shop for the latest, and redeem when you’re ready. Not a member yet? Join Steaklover Rewards with just a few taps.
GIFTS
Omaha Steaks huge selection of can’t-go-wrong gourmet gifts is here, easy to find and send within the app. It takes just a few minutes to shop by recipient, occasion, budget, or send a gift card.
STORE LOCATOR
Improved map functionality makes it easy to find the nearest Omaha Steaks store.
NOTIFICATIONS
Your Omaha Steaks in-box where you will get personalized deals and the inside scoop on what’s going on at Omaha Steaks.

bluejetty:00023017:ios.description:
القرآن الكريم… رفيقك في كل وقت
تطبيق متكامل للقرآن الكريم صُمم ليمنحك تجربة هادئة ومريحة في القراءة والاستماع، بواجهة عربية بسيطة تجمع أهم ما تحتاج إليه في مكان واحد.
اقرأ القرآن الكريم وتصفح صفحات المصحف بسهولة، أو استمع إلى التلاوات بصوت واضح وجودة عالية، مع إمكانية تحميل القرآن والاستماع إليه في أي وقت حتى بدون اتصال بالإنترنت.
◉ القرآن الكريم كاملًا
تصفح المصحف واقرأ القرآن بتجربة واضحة ومريحة تحافظ على تركيزك أثناء القراءة.
◉ استماع بجودة عالية
استمع إلى سور القرآن الكريم من خلال مشغل صوتي متكامل صُمم لتجربة استماع سهلة ومتواصلة.
◉ الاستماع بدون إنترنت
حمّل التلاوات على جهازك واستمع إليها لاحقًا أينما كنت دون الحاجة إلى اتصال بالإنترنت.
◉ الحفظ والمراجعة
استخدم خاصية تكرار الآيات والمقاطع لمساعدتك على الحفظ والمراجعة والاستماع المتكرر.
◉ متابعة القراءة
احتفظ بآخر موضع وصلت إليه لتتمكن من العودة ومواصلة القراءة بسهولة.
◉ ختمة القرآن
نظّم ختمتك وتابع تقدمك يومًا بعد يوم بطريقة بسيطة تساعدك على الاستمرار والوصول إلى هدفك.
◉ ختمة الاستماع
استمتع بختمة تعتمد على الاستماع، مع تنظيم ما تستمع إليه ومتابعة تقدمك حتى إتمام القرآن الكريم.
◉ مؤقت النوم
استمع إلى التلاوة قبل النوم وحدد الوقت المناسب لإيقاف التشغيل تلقائيًا.
◉ تجربة قراءة مريحة
واجهة هادئة، وضع داكن، وتنظيم بسيط للمحتوى لتجربة أكثر راحة أثناء القراءة ليلًا ونهارًا.
◉ أدوات مفيدة في مكان واحد
احفظ مواضعك المهمة، ارجع إليها بسهولة، واستفد من الأدوات المصممة لجعل استخدام القرآن الكريم جزءًا أكثر سهولة من يومك.
صُمم التطبيق ليضع القرآن الكريم في المقدمة؛ بدون تعقيد، مع تجربة تجمع القراءة والاستماع والحفظ والمتابعة في مكان واحد.

bluejetty:00031074:ios.name: StopTheMadness Pro
bluejetty:00031074:ios.summary: StopTheMadness Pro is a web browser extension that stops websites from making your browser harder to use, and it protects your privacy on the web. StopTheMadness Pro is not an ad blocker but rather a one of a kind extension with a huge numb
bluejetty:00031074:ios.description:
StopTheMadness Pro is a web browser extension that stops websites from making your browser harder to use, and it protects your privacy on the web. StopTheMadness Pro is not an ad blocker but rather a one of a kind extension with a huge number of unique features! Made by indie developer Jeff Johnson. The support link has documentation and my email address. StopTheMadness Pro includes extensions for Safari on iOS and iPadOS, Safari, Safari web apps, Chrome, and Firefox on macOS.
StopTheMadness Pro is a major update to the beloved StopTheMadness extension, adding automatic iCloud sync of settings between all devices, as well as countless other new features and improvements.
StopTheMadness Pro features:
• Stop websites from disabling user interface features in your browser such as text selection, copy, cut, and paste, drag and drop, contextual menus, AutoFill, ⌘-key keyboard shortcuts, and 2-finger tap to open links in a new tab
• Stop Google AMP
• Remove URL query tracking parameters automatically
• Stop clickjacking on Google Search, Gmail, Facebook, and DuckDuckGo
• Stop hyperlink auditing (anchor "ping")
• Stop tracking beacons (Navigator.sendBeacon)
• Bypass well-known URL shorteners such as bit.ly, tinyurl, and t.co
• Stop autoplaying audio and video
• Always show Safari's native video controls, including Picture-in-Picture
• Unmute videos automatically on first play
• Auto-select video playback speed
• Stop Safari from pausing audio in background apps such as Apple Music
• Hide "Get the app" banners on Google, Google Maps, DuckDuckGo, IMDb, Quora, Patreon, Reddit, and Tumblr
• Hide "Sign in with Google" on all websites
• Hide "We'd like to send you some notifications" banners on many websites
• Hide elements on web pages with a tap
• Edit the tab URL in a large separate window instead of Safari's small address bar
• Font substitution on websites
• Website-specific CSS and JavaScript
• Run custom JavaScript snippets at any time
• Custom URL redirects
• Stop losing characters in maxlength password fields
• Force links to open in the current tab instead of a new tab, or force links to open in a new tab instead of the current tab
• Force images to the front so you can drag, use the contextual menu, and save
• Stop web animations
• Stop websites from overwriting your system clipboard
• Show the concealed password in password fields
• Stop websites from disabling text replacements in Safari
• Stop websites from changing the cursor and hiding the scrollbar
• Stop the software keyboard from zooming in the web page
• Stop websites from disabling pinch to zoom
• Reload the web page on a timer
• View and edit web page HTML
• And many more!

bluejetty:00043455:ios.description:
Minimizit: Minimal Dumb Phone
Cut clutter, reclaim focus, and shape your ideal phone experience.
Minimizit helps you create a distraction-free home screen by showing only the apps and tasks you actually need. Our integrated checklists keep your to-dos in clear view—right on your home screen or lock screen. If you’re looking to mimic a “dumb phone” setup, Minimizit does that too. Whether you want to launch essential apps in one tap, track your must-do tasks, stay on top of small repeating routines, or go ultra-minimal, Minimizit’s flexible approach adapts to your lifestyle.
Key Features
• Minimal Phone Setup – Easily pare down your home screen to a few must-have apps, or replace app icons entirely with sleek launcher widgets.
• Checklists – Keep track of important tasks without opening a separate app. Add, mark complete, and review tasks at a glance.
• Cycles – Handle repeating tasks like taking vitamins, watering plants, or checking the mail. Set intervals and mark them done.
• Customizable Aesthetics – Tweak fonts, colors, and layouts to match your personal style—make it as minimal or expressive as you like.
• Lock Screen Widgets – Jump into essential apps or checklists from anywhere, including your lock screen, for ultimate convenience.
• App Locking (Focus Mode) – Temporarily lock distracting apps with custom timers and motivational messages to stay on task.
• Quick Launch Mode: Enjoy faster, smoother transitions when accessing Minimizit via widgets.
Why Choose Minimizit?
• Stay Organized & Focused – Eliminate unnecessary clutter so you can see what’s important at a glance.
• One App, Many Uses – From minimal “dumb phone” mode to intuitive task management, Minimizit lets you shape your phone to your needs.
• Seamless Customization – Personalize your setup without the learning curve—get a fresh, calm layout in just a few taps.
• Future-Ready – We’re constantly evolving. With upcoming features like habit tracking and daily reminders, Minimizit will grow with you.
Give your phone a fresh start and let simplicity fuel your productivity.
Download Minimizit today to experience a calmer, more focused digital life.

Rec Room – The Ultimate Sandbox for Creativity & Fun! 🏗️
Rec Room is the craziest and coolest sandbox game where EVERYONE can create! Rec Room is perfect for anyone looking to craft and refine their skills to make something one-of-a-kind! Whether you're new to making games or a seasoned creator, Rec Room makes designing and playing your own games easy, social, and FUN for everyone!
🛠️ Build Games & More – Solo or with Friends
Jump into an immersive social experience where you can create alongside friends from around the globe. Collaborate on your own games and design unique hangout spaces, all with easy-to-use tools! Creation in Rec Room is real-time, which means you and your friends can work together seamlessly to bring your ideas to life. 
🕹️ Publish & Play – Instantly
Press ‘Publish’ and watch your creations go live across all devices, from VR to mobile - instantly available for a global audience to enjoy. Make an action-packed multiplayer PVP game, a spooky horror escape room, or just a chill place to hangout with friends. Whatever you create, there’s an engaged community of players and creators waiting to jump in and check it out.
🎨 Express Your Creativity With No Limits
From designing your avatar’s perfect outfit to customizing your own dorm room to 3D modeling and building entire games, there’s no limit to what you can create. Use Rec Room’s powerful in-game tools to bring your dream project to life. Level up your creation skills with simple tutorials, live classes, and building clubs so that you can create anything you want!
📱 Create Anytime, Anywhere – VR & Beyond
Whether you're on a VR headset, PC, console, or mobile, Rec Room gives you seamless cross-platform building—no pro skills or external software needed! Full voice-chat and cross-play make creating and playing with friends on different devices a breeze. 
💰 Find Your Audience & Earn Rewards!
Showcase your work, monetize your creations, and grow a fanbase! Whether you're designing custom avatar items & games, founding a club, hosting live events, or just hanging out and making friends - Rec Room gives you the tools to turn creativity into endless possibilities.

bluejetty:00046436:ios.description:

bluejetty:00027505:ios.name: OCTACHRON MIDI Drum Sequencer
bluejetty:00027505:ios.summary: OCTACHRON is a very flexible iOS MIDI Drum Sequencer with up to 16 tracks and rich modulation and sequencing capabilities. It is optimized for drums, but also a lot of fun for basic melody lines. It works standalone or as AUv3 MIDI plugin i
bluejetty:00027505:ios.description:
OCTACHRON is a very flexible iOS MIDI Drum Sequencer with up to 16 tracks and rich modulation and sequencing capabilities. It is optimized for drums, but also a lot of fun for basic melody lines. It works standalone or as AUv3 MIDI plugin in your favorite iOS DAW or mixer. (E.g. AUM, Logic Pro, Cubasis, Beatmaker, ApeMatrix, Groove Rider, Nanostudio and more (not GarageBand))
PRESS REVIEWS 
- “OCTACHRON is almost perfect now” (haQ attaQ)
- “Favorite MIDI Sequencer - User's Choice Award 2022” (iOS AUv3 Facebook Group)
- “An exciting MIDI sequencer with advanced features” (Synth Anatomy)
- “Particularly the probability parameters are a lot of fun” (Amazona)
!!! PLEASE NOTICE: OCTACHRON IS A MIDI SEQUENCER AND DOES NOT CREATE ANY SOUNDS OF ITS OWN !!!
We believe in specialization. This is why OCTACHRON is focused on in depth MIDI sequencing. Control your favorite iOS drums like Blip Box, Ruismaker or MV08, synths like Zeeon or Model D or any other hard- or software MIDI instrument with it.
iOS 12 or higher required. If used with a host software, this has to be compatible with the MIDI AudioUnit standard.
OVERVIEW
- Standalone or AUv3 AudioUnit
- 1-32 steps with flexible clock divider and custom time signatures
- Up to 16 mutable tracks with adjustable length
- Up to 8 chainable patterns (song mode)
- Swing with flexible swing grid
- Save, restore and export your pattern presets, MIDI files and MIDI mapping presets
- Parameter lock for velocity, ratcheting, offset, trigger probability, trigger condition, gate length and MIDI CC Modulation
- Scales generator
- MIDI control pattern selection, play and mute
- Customizable mapping and mapping presets
- Works iOS 12 upwards
- Optimized for iPad and iPhone
- Also compatible standalone with M Macs and Apple Vision Pro
LOTS OF MAPPING PRESETS FOR POPULAR DRUM APPS AND HARDWARE
- AR-909, Axxon 2 & Blip Box
- Dadamachines Automat, Digistix & DM1/DM2/Drumlab
- DrumComputer by Sugar Bytes
- EGDR 606, 808 & 909
- FAC Drumkit, Hammerhead
- Koala Sampler & Korg Gadgets
- MV08 & NS2 Slate
- Pure Acid Drums
- Ruismaker & Ruismaker FM
- SDS-X, Sitala & Splat-To-Clat
- VA Drum SM, VA Drum2 808 & 909
- Vatanator
- Korg Electribe EMX & ER-1
- Korg Volca Beats
- MFB 522
- Roland MC-101
- Roland TR-08
- Roland TR-707 & 727
- Roland TR-808
- Roland TR-909
Also save, load and share your own MIDI mappings ...
SMART RANDOMIZER 
- Smart pattern randomizer
- Randomizer configuration per track
- Trigger mutation per track
- Mutation of internal and CC modulation parameters
PARAMETER LOCK
- Velocity and MIDI CC modulation
- Multiple hits per step with ratcheting
- Offset
- Trigger probability
- Trigger condition
- Gate length
- MIDI CC on every step
- 8 CCs per Track
- Mutation of Internal and CC Modulation
TRACK SETTINGS
- Assign MIDI notes to each track or use mapping presets
- Individual track length to create polyrhythms
LIVE PERFORMANCE FEATURES 
- Instant pattern switch option
- Mute function per track to easily build up layers
CONNECTIVIY
- Sequence other standalone apps, AUv3 AudioUnits or external hardware via MIDI
- OCTACHRON derives its timing from the host application, its internal clock or via AbletonLink
- Trigger on different MIDI channels per track
NO TRACKING 
- OCTACHRON works offline
- No push notifications
- No ads or in-app purchases
- No tracking tools
- Active on social media and in the mobile music community
- Ongoing development and support and many new features on the list
FOR MELODIC INSTRUMENTS GENERATE VARIOUS SCALES IN ALL KEYS
OCTACHRON is optimized for drums. But it also supports standard melodic scales like major, minor and also more unusual ones like mixolydian, phrygian and more ...

bluejetty:00120045:ios.description:
Are you looking for free educational games for your children to learn and enjoy at the same time? 
Here you go! With “Dino Tim: Learning colors and shapes and my first words” children in preschool age (3, 4, 5 and 6 years old) and primary school will learn with no effort while having fun.
The game is entirely translated into English but, if you wish so, you can also use Tim the Dino to learn Spanish, French, Italian... You only need to switch languages!
It suits perfectly to every age although it’s specifically suggested for pre-school and primary school (3-8 years).
Enjoy the adventure!
Some funny witches have abducted Tim’s family. Become a superhero and help him rescuing them!
Thanks to the good witch, you will be able to fly and collect figures that will allow you to do magic and turn the witches into animals!!
Children will experience an exciting adventure, solving puzzle games with colors and geometric shapes, running, flying, jumping and doing magic to unblock all the dino-characters and all game modes.

Learn to recognise geometric shapes: square, circle, rectangle, triangle, pentagon and rhombus.
Enhance speed, attention and psychomotoricity with the color recognizing game: red, green, blue, yellow, etc.
Learn first words, letters, consonants and vowels (literacy -abc-) in a fun manner in his native language (English).
Start learning a foreign language (Spanish, French, Italian…) for pre-school and primary school children (3-12 years old).
Resolve educational puzzles about different geometric shapes: squares, circles, rectangles, triangles, trapeziums and rhombuses.
Learn and enhance coordination and fine motor skill in youngsters.
Develop visual perception of different shapes and objects in motion.
Develop attention and concentration in children.
Our development studio, EducaGames, has wide experience in developing educational apps that combine learning and fun.
So don’t miss it and download the free educational game: Dino Tim!

bluejetty:00127562:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00127562:ios.description:
Move files between your iPhone, iPad and computer over Wi-Fi, then keep them organized in Phone Drive. Store documents, view PDFs, play music and manage local files alongside your connected cloud accounts.
TRANSFER FILES TO PC OR MAC
Connect your iPhone or iPad and computer to the same Wi-Fi network. Open the address shown in Phone Drive in your computer's web browser to upload or download files. No USB cable or separate desktop app is needed for browser transfers.
KEEP FILES ORGANIZED
Create folders for work, study and everyday life. Copy, move, rename, delete and share files. Create ZIP archives or unzip received files, and keep the documents you need stored in Phone Drive for offline access.
VIEW DOCUMENTS AND PHOTOS
Read PDFs and preview supported Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers and Keynote files. View images and text files in the app. Edit plain text and source code with the built-in text editor.
PLAY YOUR MUSIC AND VIDEOS
Listen to your own music with playlists, shuffle, repeat and background playback. Watch supported videos or stream compatible media from connected cloud services.
CONNECT YOUR CLOUD STORAGE
Access supported Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, iCloud Drive and Yandex Disk accounts, plus FTP and WebDAV servers. Manage files across connected locations from the same app.
ADD A PASSCODE
Restrict access to Phone Drive with a passcode and unlock with Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices.
FILES FOR WORK AND EVERYDAY LIFE
Bring a presentation to a meeting, carry PDFs for a trip, or move photos and music from your computer to your phone. Import photos from your library and keep related files together in folders.
Phone Drive is free to download. Some features, including cloud connections and device-to-device sharing, require in-app purchases. Check the options available in the app.
For local Wi-Fi transfers, keep Phone Drive open and your device awake until the transfer finishes. Cloud services require an internet connection and a supported account.

listings.name: Phone Drive: File Manager
listings.description:
Move files between your iPhone, iPad and computer over Wi-Fi, then keep them organized in Phone Drive. Store documents, view PDFs, play music and manage local files alongside your connected cloud accounts.

TRANSFER FILES TO PC OR MAC
Connect your iPhone or iPad and computer to the same Wi-Fi network. Open the address shown in Phone Drive in your computer's web browser to upload or download files. No USB cable or separate desktop app is needed for browser transfers.

KEEP FILES ORGANIZED
Create folders for work, study and everyday life. Copy, move, rename, delete and share files. Create ZIP archives or unzip received files, and keep the documents you need stored in Phone Drive for offline access.

VIEW DOCUMENTS AND PHOTOS
Read PDFs and preview supported Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers and Keynote files. View images and text files in the app. Edit plain text and source code with the built-in text editor.

PLAY YOUR MUSIC AND VIDEOS
Listen to your own music with playlists, shuffle, repeat and background playback. Watch supported videos or stream compatible media from connected cloud services.

CONNECT YOUR CLOUD STORAGE
Access supported Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, iCloud Drive and Yandex Disk accounts, plus FTP and WebDAV servers. Manage files across connected locations from the same app.

ADD A PASSCODE
Restrict access to Phone Drive with a passcode and unlock with Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices.

FILES FOR WORK AND EVERYDAY LIFE
Bring a presentation to a meeting, carry PDFs for a trip, or move photos and music from your computer to your phone. Import photos from your library and keep related files together in folders.

Phone Drive is free to download. Some features, including cloud connections and device-to-device sharing, require in-app purchases. Check the options available in the app.

For local Wi-Fi transfers, keep Phone Drive open and your device awake until the transfer finishes. Cloud services require an internet connection and a supported account.

bluejetty:00120099:ios.description:
Learning English can be an exciting journey, and it becomes even more rewarding when every verb, phrase, and tense starts making sense. Whether you're revisiting your English course or starting fresh, there's always something new to explore and enjoy. With a warm, friendly design and structured content, this app is a companion for anyone ready to make steady progress in English.
Clear grammar explanations combined with real-life examples create a strong foundation. Each topic is followed by more than 15 types of exercises, allowing you to test your understanding right away. You’ll find practical uses of verbs in different tenses, enriching your grasp of how English works in various contexts.
A variety of texts—from popular magazines to timeless books—bring English to life. Verbs appear in meaningful sentences, helping you see their role naturally. You’ll read authentic materials while choosing the correct verbs to complete each sentence. This type of immersive language learning turns reading into a powerful tool to strengthen vocabulary and speaking skills.
Interactive practice makes everything more dynamic. Sentences with missing verbs challenge your attention and boost your focus. Multiple-choice tasks offer a quick and effective way to reinforce knowledge. With instant answer-checking, you know exactly how you're progressing.
– Grammar topics supported by examples and practice exercises
– Reading sections with texts from newspapers and literature
– Exercises focused on verb usage in context
– Multiple-choice questions with immediate feedback
– Coverage of irregular verbs and tenses in practical situations
– Materials suitable for those preparing for IELTS and TOEFL
– English study designed for different levels and learning goals
– Alphabet and basic structures useful even for kids and beginners
– Vocabulary-building through everyday language practice
– Useful support for classroom study, homework, or self-learning
– A game-inspired approach to keep motivation high
– Helps improve reading, listening, and language intuition naturally
The clean and intuitive interface makes it easy to stay engaged. You can dive into a quick session while commuting or enjoy a more in-depth review when time allows. The flexible format fits into any schedule, supporting learning that feels light but brings steady results.
Whether you're brushing up for an upcoming exam or simply enjoy expanding your English vocabulary, you’ll find tools that help improve your grammar, reading fluency, and understanding of verbs. Step by step, sentence by sentence, every moment spent here adds to your confidence with the language.
With consistent use, your English will grow stronger, your use of different tenses will become more accurate, and your overall ability to express yourself will improve in a natural way.

• 10 000+ words & phrases —never play the same deck twice.

Split into two teams (or circle pass).

bluejetty:00021546:ios.description:
With the Konnect Parent App, you gain more insight into what your child experiences during a day at childcare. The Parent App contributes to better communication between parents and staff in a secure environment. Through the timeline, you can instantly see the photos and daily report. In the Inbox, you can read messages from the group and also send your own messages. In addition, you have access to the calendar and can read news items and newsletters.
To use the Parent App, your childcare organization must be connected to Konnect. You also need a username and password, which you will receive from your childcare organization. If your children attend different childcare organizations that are connected to Konnect, you can easily switch between the different accounts.

bluejetty:00061019:ios.description:
We are the number one source for crypto news, coin stats and cryptocurrency tracking. Stay up-to-date with daily live crypto prices, coin stats and market trends with our crypto tracker app. Choose your favorite cryptos for your crypto portfolio tracker and have all the data updated in real time. It has never been easier to have your crypto portfolio, coin stats and latest Bitcoin and crypto news together in the same crypto tracker app. 
CoinMarketCap is a free crypto tracker app that allows you to: 
Track 50M+ cryptocurrencies, including: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, Ripple, Cardano, Dogecoin, Shiba Inu
Discover the latest blockchain and NFTs technology trends from top cryptocurrency media outlets.
Create your own portfolio with our real-time portfolio tracker
Stay up to date on the latest crypto news and coin stats with this crypto tracker app.
Customize crypto prices alerts for your favorite cryptocurrencies
Track over 45,000+ active cryptocurrency markets and compare cryptocurrencies based on their price
Here's what you can do on the CoinMarketCap App - crypto news:
CRYPTO PRICES ALERT
Set up a crypto alert for your favorite coin stats or your portfolio tracker. Customize the price (in your preferred cryptocurrency) and you will be notified when your crypto prices targets are met!
 PERSONALIZED WATCHLISTS
Create a watchlist of your preferred crypto prices and coin stats. Track your crypto portfolio with our portfolio tracker with the latest prices from Bitcoin, altcoins and tokens, such as BTC, Ethereum, Tether, Binance BNB, Cardano, Dogecoin, Shiba inu and 50M+ more. View your portfolio tracker in 90+ fiat currencies such as USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, CNY, crypto bases such as BTC, ETH, XRP, LTC and precious metals such as gold and palladium.
COMPARE CRYPTOCURRENCIES
Compare market and coin stats, rankings, market cap and volume for two crypto assets in BTC value or your preferred currency. Track over 45,000+ active crypto markets and compare cryptocurrencies based on their price, market capitalization and volume over 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, 1 year and total time in the market.
 CRYPTO CONVERTER
Convert crypto to crypto, crypto to fiat, or crypto to precious metals using our powerful crypto prices converter with our crypto tracker app.
CRYPTO ACCOUNT
Sign up to make your crypto portfolio tracker. Create your own shareable watchlists or follow multiple watchlists. Choose to go incognito without logging in at any time, saving your data locally. Use night mode or day mode.
CRYPTO APP FOR EXCHANGES AND SECTORS
Get crypto live updates & market stats for:
Cryptocurrency Exchanges: Binance, Bybit, Coinbase, BitMart, Crypto com & more.
Cryptocurrency Sector: NFTs & collectibles, BSC ecosystem, DeFi, Polkadot ecosystem & more. 
GLOBAL CRYPTO STATS
Crypto investors can keep up to date with important crypto news and metrics, such as total market cap, Bitcoin dominance, Ethereum dominance, number of cryptocurrencies and more. Check the overall crypto market performance and know where the industry stands today with our crypto tracker app.
View the health and activity of your crypto portfolio tracker and blockchain projects with a crypto profile tracker.

bluejetty:00133613:ios.summary:

MODIFY YOUR CAR

bluejetty:00133613:ios.description:
Modify your car, choose from an endless assortment of customization options, then take your ride to the streets to prove your metal on the pavement. Verse real players in an open world made for racing!
MODIFY YOUR CAR
Car customization is the heart of Static Shift Racing. Its in-depth modification options enable you to build and drive the car of your dreams. 
● Browse an exhaustive catalog of unique modifications from rims, bumpers, side skirts, full-body kits, spoilers, hoods, and so much more.
● Personalize your car with a custom paint job. 
● Adjustable suspension and camber empower you to enhance the stance of your car.
● Install upgrades to increase the performance of your car and help you dominate rivals. 
OPEN WORLD
Tear through the streets of Static Nation, a vast open world playground comprised of multiple thriving districts. Explore sweeping highways, race through dirty industrial zones, and drift among forested mountain passes. Stay tuned for updates as additional districts will soon expand the city limits of Static Nation. 
RACE REAL RIVALS
Compete against real opponents in nail bitting races to prove your driving skill and earn exciting rewards in an array of electrifying race types:
● Experience high-speed Circuit Races
● Go all out in Sprint Races
● Flex your drifting ability in Drift Sprints
● Amass the highest score in Drift Attack
● Come in clutch in Marker Hunt
CHALLENGES
Challenges scattered throughout the world allow you to demonstrate your driving ability, from drift based challenges to time trials. Static Shift Racing's unique mix of activities will keep you entertained.
GROWING CAR LIST
Static Shift Racing’s car list is ever-expanding. Unlock legendary cars from the 80s and 90s, and drive them to the absolute limit. Each car has hundreds of customization options, allowing you to build a truly unique car. Stay tuned for updates on upcoming cars being added to the game.
GORGEOUS GRAPHICS
Static Shift Racing delivers stunning graphics to bring you an unrivaled mobile gaming experience. Drift, drive, and race through a meticulously created open world, enjoying true-to-life car visuals on your mobile device. 
CONTROLLER SUPPORT
Static Shift Racing supports controllers! Just connect your controller and give it a go. The controller is not supported in the menus and is purely for driving. Get out there and dominate with your peripherals! 
Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate underground street racing KING? Get behind the wheel and find out! Download Static Shift Racing for free now!
For news and updates, follow Static Shift Racing on social media:
● tiktok.com/@staticshiftracing
● instagram.com/staticshiftracing/
● youtube.com/@staticshiftracing
● twitter.com/PlayStaticShift
● facebook.com/staticshiftracing/

bluejetty:00062581:ios.summary: Popsicle Sticks: Teacher Picks replaces your mug of popsicle sticks. Use it to randomly select and group students, to pick random numbers and simulate dice rolls, to score responses during discussions, to create classroom tournaments, and t
bluejetty:00062581:ios.description:
Popsicle Sticks: Teacher Picks replaces your mug of popsicle sticks. Use it to randomly select and group students, to pick random numbers and simulate dice rolls, to score responses during discussions, to create classroom tournaments, and to energize your daily roll call! Its features include:
RANDOM SELECT
Select students randomly one student at a time. Use the "Random Bar" slider to precisely set the "randomness" of the next selection; from "uncalled students only" to "completely random" (and everywhere in-between). And although your students may not always love being selected, they will love listening to Siri say their name! (But rest assured, there is a "Mute" button for text-only selections.)
RANDOM GROUPS
Put students into random groups with just a couple taps. If the groups need a little tweaking, you can "swap" students with the Swap button. Easily view the "jigsaw" version of any random grouping, or create "round-robin pairings" for multi-day partner activities. Utilize the Share button to export a grouping (onto a white board, for example).
RANDOM LIST
Random List displays your class list in random order. Need a better system for picking the next student to take down the attendance, or to choose a birthday donut? Random List is the answer. Create, save, and export random lists for just about anything.
GRADE CALCULATOR
Utilize Grade Calculator to quickly determine final grades for test, quizzes, and other assignments. Calculate percentages and determine letter grades for a traditional grading system, or point averages and average performance levels for a rubric-based system. You can customize the output to include halves and/or thirds as well as extra credit points.
MENTL
Play Mentl with your students to improve their mental math skills. Utilizing a set of randomly generated digits, students build math equations equal to numbers on a Bingo board. Brain Bingo!
DIGITAL DABBLE
For each round of Digital Dabble, Popsicle Sticks generates a random set of digits (from a dice roll) and a target number. The challenge for your students is to use the digits to make an equation equal to the Target Number. Think digital!
RAD ROLL CALL
Invigorate your daily attendance with Rad Roll Call! Start each day by choosing one of over 200 Rad Roll Call questions. Students confirm they are present by responding to the question. Their answers (as well as the day's attendance) are saved and used for the Roll Call Recall game, where students earn points for remembering their classmates' responses.
TOURNAMENT BUILDER
With just a few taps, create a class tournament for almost any game (educational or otherwise). You can set it up for students to compete individually or in teams. You control the composition of the teams and the number of games. Choose from round-robin, single-elimination, or "quick-tournament." Record game results with a single tap. Popsicle Sticks will keep track of the standings, and, if you'd like, automatically slot the best players (or teams) into an end-of-tournament playoff! May the best student win! 
SCORED DISCUSSION
Use Scored Discussion to track student responses during discussions. Just tap on a score as students give answers. Popsicle Sticks will display a running total for each student and automatically save the scores for future discussions. You can select students randomly (of course) or manually (by just tapping on a name). Save multiple discussions for various subjects, and easily export the scores to Excel or another application.
With this free version of Popsicle Sticks: Teacher Picks, you can input one class, randomly select up to 500 students, create 10 random lists, 5 random groupings, 5 scored discussions, 5 tournaments, and 5 Rad Roll Calls. If you find it helpful, you can upgrade to the full version, Popsicle Sticks Unlimited. With Popsicle Sticks Unlimited you'll get unlimited access to all the features.
Use Popsicle Sticks: Teacher Picks as a student picker, grouper, scorer, and gamer!

bluejetty:00132119:ios.description:
Five Seconds is a fast party game for any group. Read the task, give 3 answers in 5 seconds, and let the others decide if they count. No long rules and no deep thinking: just say the first thing that comes to mind, and say it fast!
It gets any party going and pulls even the quiet ones into the game.
HOW TO PLAY
• 2 or more players.
• On your turn, tap Reveal task, read it out loud, then tap Start timer.
• You have 5 seconds to give 3 answers. Task: name 3 sports. You: tennis, golf, boxing. Nailed it!
• The others decide. If it counts, they tap Yes and you get a point. If not, No.
• First to 5, 10, 15, or 20 points wins. Turn on the penalty for a miss, and every miss costs a point.
SETS FOR ANY GROUP
We picked every task by hand and sorted them into themed sets. Turn on the ones you like and play your way.
• Demo — a bit of everything to try the game
• For the Starters — a warm-up to get the hang of it
• Kid Time — simple tasks for the young ones
• Cinema Fans — favorite shows, movies, and characters
• Around the World — a trip around the globe without leaving the couch
• New Friends — personal questions to get to know each other better
• Naked Truth — spicy questions about love and relationships
• Fridge Dashers — dishes, snacks, and everything yummy
WHO IT'S FOR
Friends, family, coworkers, a couple on date night, a group on a road trip. There are sets for every age, and one for those who like it spicy.
PREMIUM
Premium unlocks every set. It comes as an auto-renewing subscription or a one-time purchase.

bluejetty:00155249:ios.description:
QUALLYGESTÃO PREDIAL - Empresa especializada em gestão de condomínios.
Nossa equipe é preparada para atender suas necessidades, provendo uma gestão transparente, segura e tranquila para todos os nossos clientes.
Tanto pelo site da QUALLYGESTÃO quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a QUALLYGESTÃO, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para quallygestao@winker.com.br

Smart Printer App is a powerful tool designed to make connecting your phone to a printer easier than ever. Whether it’s docs or photos, we have everything you need for printing. Download our app and experience convenient mobile printing services!

• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period

bluejetty:00015200:ios.summary:
Spanish verbs don't have to be scary.

bluejetty:00015200:ios.description:
Spanish verbs don't have to be scary.
Whether you're just starting to learn Spanish or pushing towards fluency, Spanish verb conjugation is usually what holds you back. Other apps make you memorize. We teach you to understand, so conjugation finally clicks and you can actually hold a conversation.
Ella Verbs is the Spanish verb app built for learners who want real progress.
How Ella Verbs works:
Learn a concept → Quiz until it clicks → Level up. Short lessons, plenty of practice, and a clear path from the present tense to the subjunctive, broken into 50 manageable levels. Our Smart Quizzes use spaced repetition (SRS) to target the patterns you're struggling with: not just individual words, but the tenses and verb types that aren't clicking yet. You practice what actually needs work, not what you already know.
What learners are saying:
"In 22 days I've learned more than in all the years before."
"I am not afraid to form sentences or speak anymore."
"Learned more in 3 days than 3 years on Duolingo."
"Great for beginners but essential for serious learners."
Rated 4.9 out of 5 from 15,000+ ratings.
What you get:
• 50 levels of bite-sized lessons and quizzes covering 18 tenses
• 2,500+ verbs with full English translations, synonyms, and step-by-step conjugation guides
• Smart Quizzes with spaced repetition (SRS) that target your weak spots (Pro)
• CEFR level tracking (A1 → C2) to see where you stand
• Speaking quizzes: say each answer out loud and the app checks it
• Practice your way: typing, multiple choice, flashcards, listening, or sentences in context
• Daily Verb Sudoku: a conjugation puzzle for when you want a change from quizzes
• Full lessons on tricky topics like ser vs. estar and reflexive verbs
• Works offline, and syncs across phone, tablet, web, and Mac
Start free: the first 11 levels, the top 100 verbs, the daily Verb Sudoku, and a free Pro trial with no card needed. Pro unlocks all 50 levels, all 2,500+ verbs, Smart Quizzes, custom quizzes in every tense, and your own verb lists.
Built by learners, for learners:
We're Jane and Brian: an Irish couple living in Spain, learning Spanish ourselves. We built Ella Verbs because we couldn't find a method that actually taught conjugation instead of just drilling it. We're a small team and read every email ourselves (really). We release updates almost every week.
Have an idea or question? Reach us at jane@ellaverbs.com or brian@ellaverbs.com. We also offer free access through our Give Back program for those who need it.
More features:
• Milestone levels testing verbs in real sentence contexts
• Custom quiz builder: choose your tenses, verbs, and practice styles (present tense free)
• Create your own verb lists to study (Pro)
• Daily streak tracking across devices
• Both European Spanish (with vosotros) and Latin American Spanish
• Dark mode and extensive customization options
Tenses covered (18 total):
Indicative mood:
• Present (El Presente)
• Present Continuous (El Presente Progresivo)
• Informal/Near Future (El Futuro Próximo)
• Preterite (El Pretérito Indefinido)
• Imperfect (El Pretérito Imperfecto)
• Present Perfect (El Pretérito Perfecto)
• Past Perfect (El Pretérito Pluscuamperfecto)
• Future (El Futuro Simple)
• Future Perfect (El Futuro Perfecto)
• Conditional (El Condicional Simple)
• Conditional Perfect (El Condicional Perfecto)
Subjunctive mood:
• Present Subjunctive (El Presente de Subjuntivo)
• Imperfect Subjunctive (El Imperfecto de Subjuntivo)
• Present Perfect Subjunctive (El Pretérito Perfecto de Subjuntivo)
• Past Perfect Subjunctive (El Pretérito Pluscuamperfecto de Subjuntivo)
• Future Subjunctive (El Futuro de Subjuntivo)
• Future Perfect Subjunctive (El Futuro Perfecto de Subjuntivo)
Imperative mood:
• Imperative, affirmative & negative (El Imperativo)
By using Ella Verbs you agree to our terms (https://ellaverbs.com/terms) and privacy policy (https://ellaverbs.com/privacy). Learn more at https://ellaverbs.com.

bluejetty:00024557:ios.description:
What is the moon phase today? When is the next full moon or new moon?
Moon Calendar is a clear lunar phase calendar for iOS on iPhone and iPad. The app shows the moon phase and illuminated percentage for every calendar day, so you can quickly see what the Moon looks like today, tonight, tomorrow, on your birthday, or on another date.
Key features:
- Lunar phase calendar: See all eight moon phases—new moon, waxing crescent, first quarter, waxing gibbous, full moon, waning gibbous, last quarter, and waning crescent.
- Detailed lunar data: Check the illuminated percentage, moon age, moon sign, and distance of the Moon. The exact time is also shown for the principal phases.
- Next full moon and new moon: See at a glance when the next full moon and next new moon will occur.
- Moon phase on a specific date: Jump directly to any month and year from 1900 to 2100. For example, look up the moon phase on the day you were born or on another important date.
- Moon reminders: Get reminders for the full moon, new moon, first quarter, or last quarter. Choose a notification for the day before, one hour before, or the exact moment of the phase.
- Live countdown: Follow the time remaining until the next full moon or new moon, accurate to the second. You can also create a personal countdown for a date of your choice.
- Full moon and new moon calendar for the whole year: View every full moon and new moon of a year in one clear list, including supermoons and blue moons. You can also share the yearly overview.
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: Keep the current moon phase visible on your device. Depending on the widget layout, see today’s Moon, a five-day overview, or the next full moon and new moon.
- Northern and Southern Hemispheres: Adjust the display for your hemisphere. In the Southern Hemisphere, the Moon is mirrored accordingly.
- Personalized appearance: Choose light, dark, or automatic system appearance.
Whether you want to know when the next full moon is, which moon phase is visible tonight, or what the phase was on a past or future date, Moon Calendar brings the most important lunar information together in a clear and easy-to-read format.
Download Moon Calendar for free now on your iPhone or iPad and keep every full moon, new moon, and phase in between close at hand.

bluejetty:00135130:ios.name: Lovetastic: Pictureless Dating
bluejetty:00135130:ios.summary:
Thanks to our unique matching, you get to know the people who really match you. Successful dates are part of everyday life thanks to LOVETASTIC and will soon be the beginning of something great for you too. What are you waiting for?
HOW IT
bluejetty:00135130:ios.description:
Thanks to our unique matching, you get to know the people who really match you. Successful dates are part of everyday life thanks to LOVETASTIC and will soon be the beginning of something great for you too. What are you waiting for?
HOW IT WORKS
The goal of Lovetastic is that other users like you without a photo at first impression. This is possible because Lovetastic profiles contain a lot of exciting information. So even without a photo you can imagine how well a user matches you. If you have a match, you will enter the private chat. There you have the possibility to exchange pictures. Our unique matching ensures that you get to know exactly the people who make your heart beat faster.
STEP BY STEP
• Create your profile by entering the most important information about yourself. This works without a photo.
• Lovetastic shows you users of the desired age, radius and gender who are searching for your gender.
• Swipe through users or press the heart, cross, Power-Booster or replay.
• To enter the private chat, you need a match. With the Power-Booster your message will go directly into the private chat.
• In private chat you can write and exchange pictures. Pictures are deleted after 10 seconds.
Functions in detail:
• Heart / swipe right: You like a person. If she also likes you, you have a match.
• Cross / Swipe to the left: The next person will be displayed.
• Power-Booster: The other person sees your Power-Booster message and can answer you directly.
• Replay: Get back a person accidentally swiped to the left.
• Voice: Listen to the voice of other users. You can also add your voice to your profile.
_________________
Lovetastic VIP / Platinum
• Thanks to Lovetastic VIP / Platinum you get the additional features described in the app.
• Your subscription will automatically renew for the same price and period until you cancel it in your iTunes account at least 24 hours before expiration.
• A subscription that has already begun cannot be cancelled for the current term but only for the next term.
• If you do not want to get Lovetastic VIP / Platinum or if you cancel it, you can still use Lovetastic for free.
_________________

Website of Lovetastic: https://en.lovetastic.ch
Privacy policy: https://en.lovetastic.ch/datenschutzrichtlinie
Terms of use: https://en.lovetastic.ch/nutzungsbedingungen

bluejetty:00041432:ios.name: Gas Station Manager Simulator
bluejetty:00041432:ios.summary: Welcome to the ultimate gas station management experience! In Gas Station Manager Simulator, you are the owner of a bustling gas station in the heart of a vast desert. Your mission is to provide top-notch services to an ever-growing stream
bluejetty:00041432:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate gas station management experience! In Gas Station Manager Simulator, you are the owner of a bustling gas station in the heart of a vast desert. Your mission is to provide top-notch services to an ever-growing stream of customers. From refueling cars with gas, petrol, or oil to managing a fully-equipped mechanic shop, your tasks are as diverse as they are engaging.
Key Features:
1. Refuel Cars:
Fuel Variety: Provide gas, petrol, or oil to a wide range of vehicles.
Order Management: Monitor your fuel levels and place orders to keep your main tank stocked. Watch as a delivery truck brings in fresh supplies to ensure you never run out of fuel.
2. Car Wash Services:
Clean and Shine: Dirty cars pull up for a wash, and it’s your job to make them sparkle. Use various tools and techniques to provide the best car wash service in the desert.
3. Comprehensive Maintenance:
Mechanic Shop: Change tires, fill gas in tires, and provide tuning services. Upgrade and renovate cars to keep them running smoothly.
Tuning and Repairs: Offer extensive car tuning options and repair services to satisfy your customers’ needs.
4. Station Management:
Garbage Collection: Keep your gas station clean by picking up garbage thrown by customers.
Renovations: Upgrade and renovate your gas station building to attract more customers. Paint the building, decorate walls, and enhance facilities.
Inventory Management: Purchase parts and manage inventory for your mechanic shop.
5. Operational Flexibility:
Open/Close Station: Use the gas station on/off option to close the station temporarily. This allows you to focus on cleaning, renovations, or any other tasks without interruptions.
Gameplay Overview:
Start with a basic setup and gradually expand your services. As cars come in, you'll need to:
Refill Fuel: Choose from gas, petrol, or oil based on the vehicle's needs.
Manage Supplies: Order fuel before you run out to keep the service going smoothly.
Provide Wash Services: Use a variety of cleaning tools to wash cars, ensuring customer satisfaction.
Offer Repairs: From tire changes to complete car tuning, provide top-tier mechanic services.
Upgrade Facilities: Renovate your gas station, adding new features and improving existing ones to handle more customers and provide better services.
Why You’ll Love It:
Realistic Simulation:
Immersive Experience: Detailed graphics and realistic gameplay mechanics bring the gas station environment to life.
Strategic Management: Balancing multiple tasks requires strategic thinking and efficient time management.
Endless Customization:
Personal Touch: Customize and upgrade every aspect of your gas station. From the type of fuel you offer to the look of your station, every choice is yours.
Expand and Grow: Start small and expand your services as you attract more customers and earn more money.
Engaging Challenges:
Customer Satisfaction: Keep customers happy with quick and efficient service. Happy customers mean repeat business and higher earnings.
Daily Tasks: Every day brings new challenges and tasks, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.
Download Gas Station Manager Simulator Today and Start Your Journey to Desert Business Success!

Navigating menopause can be challenging, but it doesn’t have to be painful! Her Hypnosis offers a natural, side-effect-free way to ease your symptoms (hot flashes, night sweats, insomnia, anxiety, mood swings, weight gain...) by harnessing the power of the mind-body connection.
LISTEN TO YOUR 15-MIN SESSION AT BEDTIME
Our Regulation Program is designed by expert in hypnosis, neuroscience and women's health. 
It includes 21-day cycles of 15-minute hypnosis sessions to listen to every night before bed. These deeply relaxing sessions help regulate your nervous and hormonal systems, reducing hot flashes, improving sleep, and calming your body and mind.
You’ll also have access to short Boosters sessions which amplify the benefits of the Program.
ENHANCE YOUR OVERALL WELL BEING
Her Hypnosis provides a holistic approach to menopause relief.
Beyond symptom management, these sessions guide you to cultivate a positive and grateful mindset, build resilience, and embrace the passing of time with confidence. Aging is a privilege - this program helps you recognize that and feel empowered in this transformative stage of life.
Start your journey to natural relief, renewed vitality, and inner peace today. With just 15 minutes a day, you can transform your experience of menopause and reconnect with your best self.
MAIN BENEFITS (AVAILABLE THROUGH SUBSCRIPTION):
* Reduce the intensity of symptoms
* Overcome limiting beliefs
* Allow a grateful and positive mindset
* Activate your deep resilience
* Regulate appetites and cravings
HOW IT WORKS:
* Subscribe to unlock your personalized 21-day hypnosis program.
* Answer a few questions, and access a tailored plan.
* Listen to 15-minute sessions every night at bedtime to reconnect your mind and body while absorbing positive suggestions.
* Boost the results with additional Booster sessions
PRICING AND SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
Her Hypnosis offers a subscription to access the full hypnosis program. The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period (each month or year) until you cancel. Canceling your subscription disables automatic renewal. However, you will still have access to all your subscription features for the remaining time of your then-current period. Note that deleting the app does not cancel your subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://herhypnosis.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://herhypnosis.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00028724:ios.description:
NordLocker is an encrypted cloud storage app that puts privacy first. Store your files in a securely encrypted cloud that provides maximum protection from data leakage.
Why NordLocker?
NordLocker was built by the team behind NordVPN, the world’s most popular VPN. As a company, we strive to build the best cybersecurity tools anyone could use. That’s why NordLocker has been recognized by the Cyber Security Awards as the Cloud-Based Product of the Year.
Our secure storage uses an end-to-end encryption algorithm to secure your files in the cloud. All data is encrypted with a unique key that gives you complete access control.
Encrypted at all times
Protect your precious files, upload them to the cloud storage, or sync them across your devices for easy access. And even when files are synced to a shared device, your data stays private. Because no one can see or access your data without your permission.
When it comes to sharing files, you can securely share any file or folder via NordLocker in just two steps. Share your files with however many people you like, and wait until they accept your invitation. NordLocker offers an option to share your files via a securely generated link that encrypts the file in transit. You always remain the owner of your files and can stop sharing it whenever you want.
Hassle-free security
Upload your files into NordLocker, and they’re encrypted instantly. Make NordLocker what you want it to be — media or other files storage for sensitive data.
Your data is yours only
What's yours is yours. That's why we believe using a cloud app should never be based on trust. Unlike mainstream cloud providers, we can never see your encryption keys or know what you store in your cloud. NordLocker is built on zero-knowledge architecture, meaning we know nothing about what you store in your cloud. Not only is this more secure, but it also gives you complete access control.
Download NordLocker and protect your digital assets now!

bluejetty:00162088:ios.description:
Vade Mecum 2026 completo e atualizado todos os dias: Constituição, códigos, leis especiais e súmulas, com marcações, áudio e busca instantânea. E mais de 1.000.000 de questões de concursos e OAB, cada uma ligada ao artigo da lei que ela cobra.
O JurisHand AI une um Vade Mecum sempre atualizado, um banco de questões conectado à lei seca e um tutor com inteligência artificial. Você estuda a lei e pratica no mesmo lugar.
VADE MECUM COMPLETO E ATUALIZADO
- Constituição, CC, CP, CPC, CPP, CLT, CTN e toda a legislação federal
- Legislação estadual para concursos
- Súmulas e jurisprudência do STF, STJ, TST e TSE
- Estatutos e leis especiais: OAB, ECA, LGPD, Improbidade, Drogas, Maria da Penha, Abuso de Autoridade
- Dicionário jurídico com mais de 30 mil termos
FEITO PARA ESTUDAR
- Marcações coloridas, anotações e pastas
- Leitura em áudio para estudar no deslocamento
- Modo escuro e ajuste de fonte
- Mais de mil leis federais salvas para consulta offline
- Sincronização entre iPhone, iPad e web
POR QUE TROCAR O VADE MECUM DE PAPEL
- Lei nova aparece no app em poucas horas, sem esperar a próxima edição
- Toque numa remissão e vá direto para a lei citada
- Busca instantânea, sem folhear índices
QUESTÕES E SIMULADOS
- Mais de 1.000.000 de questões das principais bancas: FGV, Cebraspe (CESPE), FCC, VUNESP e outras
- Filtros por carreira, órgão, banca, matéria e ano
- Errou? O artigo correspondente abre na mesma tela
- Simulados personalizados, caderno de erros e desafio diário
- Concurso Alvo: rotina e simulados adaptados ao seu cargo
TUTOR COM IA
- Explicação das questões com base na lei
- Tire dúvidas jurídicas em linguagem natural, peça resumos e correlações entre normas
- Busca por tema: encontre o artigo mesmo sem saber o número
PARA QUEM ESTUDA PARA
Carreiras policiais e Delegado, Tribunais (TJ, TRF, TRT, TRE), Magistratura e MP, Defensoria, Procuradorias, carreiras fiscais e administrativas, e Exame de Ordem.

bluejetty:00087805:ios.description:
Pantore Pay é capital de giro para auxiliar o seu estabelecimento!
Aplicativo revolucionário que permite a você emprestar capital de giro de forma rápida e fácil para financiar suas compras com qualquer fornecedor no Brasil. Diga adeus às preocupações financeiras e concentre-se no crescimento do seu negócio com a ajuda do Pantore Pay!
Características Principais:
1 - Linha de crédito e Capital de Giro Simples: Com o Pantore Pay, você pode solicitar empréstimos de capital de giro de forma rápida e sem complicações. Nada de papelada extensa ou longos processos bancários. Tudo é feito de maneira digital e eficiente!
2 - Financie Suas Compras: Agora, você pode fazer suas compras com qualquer fornecedor do Brasil sem se preocupar com o orçamento. O Pantore Pay permite que você tenha o dinheiro necessário para manter o estoque sempre abastecido e aproveitar oportunidades comerciais sem hesitação.
3 - Pagamento Flexível: Desfrute de um prazo de 7 dias para pagar o Pantore Pay. Isso significa que você terá tempo suficiente para gerar receitas e organizar suas finanças antes do vencimento, tornando o processo de pagamento muito mais tranquilo.
4 - Interface Intuitiva: O aplicativo possui uma interface amigável e intuitiva, garantindo que todos os proprietários de negócios, mesmo aqueles que não são especialistas em tecnologia, possam usá-lo sem dificuldades.
5 - Segurança de Dados: Priorizamos a segurança das suas informações. Todas as transações e dados financeiros são protegidos por criptografia avançada, garantindo total confidencialidade.
6 - Suporte ao Cliente: A equipe de suporte dedicada do Pantore Pay está sempre pronta para ajudar com qualquer dúvida ou problema que você possa enfrentar. Nossa missão é fornecer um atendimento ao cliente excepcional.
Não permita que a falta de capital de giro atrapalhe o crescimento e o sucesso do seu negócio. Baixe o Pantore Pay agora mesmo e experimente a liberdade financeira que você merece! Seja o mestre do seu próprio destino empresarial com o Pantore Pay ao seu lado.
Observação: As informações financeiras e os termos exatos podem estar sujeitos a alterações com base nas políticas da Pantore Pay. Verifique sempre os detalhes mais atualizados diretamente no aplicativo. Venha para PantorePay!

bluejetty:00131662:ios.name: Minn Kota Fishing
bluejetty:00131662:ios.summary:
PLAN YOUR TRIP. MANAGE YOUR SYSTEM. GET MORE FROM YOUR TIME ON THE WATER
The Minn Kota® Fishing App is the mobile extension of your integrated Minn Kota system. Use Minn Kota Maps to plan your fishing trip, manage waypoints, control compati
bluejetty:00131662:ios.description:
PLAN YOUR TRIP. MANAGE YOUR SYSTEM. GET MORE FROM YOUR TIME ON THE WATER
The Minn Kota® Fishing App is the mobile extension of your integrated Minn Kota system. Use Minn Kota Maps to plan your fishing trip, manage waypoints, control compatible products, keep your equipment up to date, and access support - all from one app.
EXPLORE AND PLAN WITH MINN KOTA MAPS
Plan before you launch and understand the water before you make your first cast. Minn Kota® Maps help you see depth, contours, structure, and other map detail so you can identify potential fishing areas and navigate with confidence. Explore detailed freshwater and coastal mapping, including trusted LakeMaster® data across supported freshwater coverage. Set waypoints and customize your map view, with available map detail and features varying by coverage and subscription. Advanced mapping offers features such as up-to-1-foot contours, enhanced aerial imagery, and shaded relief where available.
MANAGE YOUR WAYPOINTS
Create, customize, and manage waypoints right from your phone. Plan your next fishing trip, organize the places that matter, and transfer supported waypoint data between the Minn Kota® Fishing App and compatible fish finders.
ACCESS YOUR INTEGRATED MINN KOTA SYSTEM
The Minn Kota® Fishing App helps bring your integrated Minn Kota® system together in one mobile experience. Access supported controls for compatible Minn Kota® trolling motors and shallow water anchors. Adjust trolling motor speed and steering, access supported GPS navigation modes including Spot-Lock®, Advanced AutoPilot®, and Drift Mode, and deploy, retract, and adjust compatible Raptor® or Talon® shallow water anchors. You can also view compatible devices integrated across your Minn Kota® system from the app.
CAPTURE AND SHARE FISH FINDER CONTENT
Save and transfer supported screenshots from compatible fish finders to your phone, making it easier to save and share what you discover on the water. Supported fish finders may also allow transfer of screen recordings.
KEEP YOUR EQUIPMENT UP TO DATE
Download available software updates for supported Minn Kota® and integrated products through the app to help keep compatible equipment current and ready for your next trip.
GET HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Access product manuals, tutorial videos, FAQs, and other support resources from one place. Need more help? Request a callback directly through the app to connect with Minn Kota Technical Service.

bluejetty:00146150:ios.description:
"The problem with shared calendars isn't productivity. It's communication." — Ryan Brodie, Founder

bluejetty:00162234:ios.description:
Amore: The Meeting Point for Video Chat & Meet! Voice chat, smart matching, and sincere friendships start here.
Leave loneliness behind. Amore Video Chat & Meet is not just a friendship app; it is a vibrant platform where you can expand your social circle, build real friendships, and meet new people and build meaningful connections.
Thanks to our smart algorithm designed to find the perfect match for you among millions of users, you can find the person best suited to you and build the relationship you are looking for easier than ever before. Create your profile, select the traits that reflect who you are, and get the chance to match instantly.
You don’t have to settle for ordinary text messaging. To help you get to know people better and build connections, Amore offers the smoothest video chat and voice chat experience. This way, you don't just match; you get discovered for who you truly are.
Amore’s Key Features
Secure Video Chat
To get to know your matches better, you can have high-quality video chats. Amore prioritizes your privacy and ensures you only connect with people you interact with mutually.
Fun Voice Chat
Not ready to turn on your camera yet? No problem! Use the magic of your voice with our voice chat feature. Dive into deep conversations in private calls or break the ice with voice messages. Start conversations naturally.
Fast & Smart Matching
Amore offers advanced filtering options (age, location, interests). Meet people who meet your exact criteria without wasting time. Quickly match with candidates who understand you, share your hobbies, and people who share your interests.
Local Friendships
Meet someone from your own city to see them in real life, or expand your horizons by connecting with local users. Making friends from all over the world and discovering new cultures is now very easy.
Safe Experience
Your safety is our priority. Enjoy the peace of mind knowing you are communicating with real people thanks to verified user profiles. Amore is here for you to socialize in a respectful and reliable community.
Share Posts & Stories
Don't just settle for chatting express yourself! Share posts, upload stories, and share your interests, memories, or thoughts with other users. Social discovery is always active on this platform.
Safety & Moderation
The safety of the Amore community is our top priority. We provide a respectful and decent environment with our advanced reporting and blocking systems. We provide 24/7 moderation against content and behavior that does not comply with our community guidelines.
You can meet people nearby to arrange a coffee meet or interact with people from all over the world to explore different cultures. Whether you are looking for romance, excitement, or a sincere chat, it is all at your fingertips with Amore: Video Chat & Meet.
About Amore Subscriptions and Terms of Use:
- A Premium subscription is required for all Amore features.
- Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each period unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current purchasing period.
- Privacy Policy: https://amore.show/en/privacy-policy
Do you have questions or comments? Contact us: info@amore.show

Paper2Audio’s text to speech (TTS) reader tech
bluejetty:00153297:ios.description:
Paper2Audio is a free text to audio app that reads aloud your PDFs, ebooks, web articles, text documents, and plain text, turning complex reading into clear audio you can listen to anywhere. 
Paper2Audio’s text to speech (TTS) reader technology intelligently skips clutter like page numbers, footnotes, citations, and more. It summarizes figures, tables, and math so you can focus on what matters. Convert your documents and pdfs to audio to turn your commute, workout, or chores into productive learning time by listening to your documents hands-free.
Over 700,000 documents converted to audio!
Key features:
• Read PDFs, webpages, EPUBs, .docx, .txt, scanned documents and copy-pasted text
Turn your ebooks into audiobooks and your pdfs to audio to read text out loud
• High quality text to speech voices
Enjoy natural text to voice with engaging and realistic voices that make hours of listening engaging and easy to follow, including for people with visual impairments or learning challenges like dyslexia or ADHD.
• Reads documents aloud with summaries of visual elements
Summarizes equations, code, tables and figures in plain language instead of confusing symbol-by-symbol narration
• A smarter audio text reader that cuts junk text you don't want to hear (page numbers, references list, ads, etc.)
Our text reader skips the clutter and focuses only on the meaningful content
• Read along with the audio with Reader View 
Reformats your documents for easier readability on small screens and shows images, math, formatting, and word-level highlighting in sync with the audio.
• Highlighting and notes
Keep track of key text with highlights and add your own notes
• Familiar UI similar to a podcast or audiobook app
Jump right in with an intuitive interface you already know how to use
• Table of contents to select a section of your PDF or ebook
Navigate instantly to any section that interests you most without endless scrolling
• Read text aloud at your own speed with playback speed control from 0.5x to 4.0x in 0.05x increments 
Find your perfect listening pace whether you're a speed listener or prefer to savor every detail
• Scan and read documents aloud
Upload scanned PDFs to turn them into listenable audio.
• Screen reader compatible and dyslexia-friendly fonts
Pricing:
Paper2Audio is a free text to audio document reader (up to 56 hours of audio generation per week) with no ads or annoying stuff. Paper2Audio Plus, our paid tier for business users, has higher limits and allows for audio file exports.
Terms of use: https://www.paper2audio.com/terms-of-use
Privacy: https://www.paper2audio.com/privacy

bluejetty:00023751:ios.description:
Mirror your iPhone or iPad screen to any device in your local Wi-Fi or remote via Internet. Share your screen on a Smart TV, Mac, PC, Laptop, Gaming Console, Smartphone or Tablet.
The Screen Mirroring App can connect to any Web Browser and cast your screen with zero delay in HD quality. Screen Mirroring over DLS / Cable / Internet is supported by Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Edge and the newest Smart TVs.
This is the easiest and most powerful screen sharing tool. Share your photos, videos, games, websites, apps, presentations and documents with your friends and family, even to remote places.
* Supported devices: Any device with an integrated Web Browser, e.g. Samsung TV, LG TV, Panasonic TV, Hisense TV, Philips TV, Hitachi TV, Grundig TV, TCL TV.

* Latency is supreme (0 seconds) when you have good Wi-Fi network conditions.
* You don't need a companion App on your TV or receiving device.
* No hidden subscriptions or costs.
* Black screen issues: Some third party apps prevent screen mirroring. When you try to mirror them, you will just see a black screen on your TV, for example with Netflix and Disney+. This is a restriction chosen by Netflix and others, so we cannot fix it at the moment.
This app is brought to you by the developers of Video & TV Cast, the #1 video casting app in the world with more than 100.000.000 downloads across all platforms and devices.

bluejetty:00172617:ios.description:
Ford DiagNow provides diagnostic functionality in a convenient lightweight package enabling users to quickly address vehicle concerns without the need for a full diagnostic scan tool and laptop.
With the Ford DiagNow application you can: 
• Read and decode the Vehicle Identification Number into specific model information
• Read and clear Diagnostic Trouble Codes for all equipped vehicle electronic control modules
• Read live data parameters from the vehicle
• Perform live vehicle network monitor
• Perform key programming* 
• Read factory keyless entry code*
• View service bulletins and messages for Diagnostic Trouble Codes read from the vehicle
All this can be done on any 2010 or newer Ford, Lincoln, and Mercury vehicle
Requirements:
• User must have a valid Ford Dealer account or Ford Motorcraft account with a Ford DiagNow subscription
• Ford VCM Lite is the interface required to perform diagnostic functions with the vehicle
If you are a Ford/Lincoln dealership employee and would like more information, go to https://www.fordtechservice.dealerconnection.com/Rotunda/FordDiagNow
If you are NOT a Ford/Lincoln dealership employee and would like more information, go to www.motorcraftservice.com/Purchase/ViewDiagnosticsMobile 
*Currently functions on most 2010 Ford, Lincoln, and Mercury vehicles. Additional vehicles coming soon.

bluejetty:00132374:ios.description:
CREATE DATABASES IN SECONDS
iDatabase is a powerful and easy-to-use database app for iPhone and iPad. Create and manage your own databases without technical skills. Organize work or personal information, store everything in one place, and find what you need in seconds.
ORGANIZE YOUR RECORDS
Create Groups and Smart Groups directly in the record list to keep your data organized. Smart Groups automatically collect records that match your criteria and update as your data changes.
SEARCH ALL YOUR DATABASES
Find information across all your databases, even when they are not open. Search by name, word, number, or any other information and jump directly to the matching record.
FAST AND INTUITIVE
A clean, modern interface designed for iPhone and iPad. Create, edit, browse, and organize records with simple touch controls, full Dark Mode support, and smooth navigation.
SYNC WITH MAC, IPHONE AND IPAD
Keep your databases up to date across all your devices with iCloud. Changes are automatically synchronized between iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Store databases in iCloud, restore previous versions, and access your information even when you are offline.
READY-TO-USE TEMPLATES
Get started quickly with built-in templates for contacts, inventories, expenses, projects, recipes, and more. Customize existing templates or create your own databases from scratch.
FLEXIBLE DATA FIELDS
Use text, numbers, dates, images, links, email addresses, phone numbers, checkboxes, password fields, choices, and calculated fields. Customize each field and choose which fields appear in the record list.
SEARCH, SORT AND ORGANIZE
Search and sort records by any field. Use Groups and Smart Groups to organize your information automatically and keep large databases easy to manage.
APPLE INTELLIGENCE
Use Apple Intelligence Writing Tools to correct, rewrite, and compose text directly in your database fields.
SHARE AND IMPORT
Share databases, selected records, or individual entries with other apps. Import data from CSV files and add records from other iDatabase databases.
FLEXIBLE PURCHASE OPTIONS
iDatabase is available as a one-time purchase or as a monthly or annual subscription. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Privacy Policy: https://www.apimac.com/about/privacy/

bluejetty:00033364:ios.summary:

Stay connected with th
bluejetty:00033364:ios.description:
Play Moonvale – a detective adventure full of love, murder, and mystery!
Test your intuition, uncover hidden secrets and intrigues, and solve an unbelievable case. The goal? Find the culprit, your true love… or both!
Stay connected with the characters through lifelike messenger chats. Every message and every decision changes what others reveal, who trusts you, and how the criminal case unfolds. Moonvale is more than just a story – it’s your story!
• You are the key – Dive into a realistic blend of romance and crime investigation, packed with dark secrets and shocking twists.
• Investigate the crime – Collect clues, profile suspects, and connect the dots in a gripping case.
• Romance & suspicion – Date (or doubt) the people closest to the truth. Who will win your heart?
• Interactive story gameplay – Receive realistic messages, real calls, voice messages, and photos from mysterious characters.
• Your decisions matter – Explore different paths and build relationships. Every choice influences what others reveal.
• A new case in the Duskwood universe – From the popular detective story series with over 20 million downloads worldwide.
• Especially for Duskwood fans – Meet Jake, Jessy, Dan, Lilly, and the rest of your old friends again in Moonvale. They already miss you!
HOW IT BEGINS
Your phone lights up. A video call from an unknown number. 
A stranger’s smile warms the screen, but his eyes… they hold something deeper. You don’t know him, but he speaks like he’s known you forever. His words feel personal, like secrets meant only for you… and then the screen goes black. The call is over, but his last words still echo in your mind, sending shivers down your spine…
FROM THE CREATORS OF DUSKWOOD
Loved by millions of players worldwide, the team behind Duskwood brings a brand-new case set in the same universe. New to the series? Start here. Already a fan? Watch for familiar faces and a special side story made for Duskwood players.
AN INTERACTIVE STORY YOU’LL LOVE
Moonvale pulls you into a cinematic adventure where every clue, every choice, and every conversation could bring you closer to the truth. In this criminal case, you decide who to trust, who to love, and whether you catch the killer. Trust will be fragile, danger will be real, and the line between love and suspicion will blur with every step you take.

bluejetty:00173289:android.description:
Whisper of Shadow is a roguelike strategy idle game. In Whisper of Shadow, you will march through dangerous dungeons, face random events, summon heroes and fight against devils. 
In ancient times, gods promised to protect the human world. But humanity always seemed to find a way to drag the world into the abyss of corruption under the guise of noble pretenses...
The obsession with power and malevolent forces drove humanity to madness, engulfing homes in the flames of war, opening the gates of hell, and shattering the old order...
As the savior, you awaken in this dark world. Brace yourself to embark on a journey with heroes, uncover long-buried secrets, rescue humanity, and put a stop to this era of darkness!
*** The Pure Roguelike Dungeon Adventure ***
Whisper of Shadow provides everything you need for a roguelike dungeon adventure! Follow the storyline and march through the dangerous dungeon. Defeat the devil, find a way out and cliam your rewards! Remember, every decision you make during the adventure could bring you either rewards or curses. Be careful of what you wish for!
*** A Vast Open World of Darkness ***
From Magma Temple to Boreal Furnace, venture through the vast world of darkness. Experience a rich storyline and encounter hundreds of heroes. As the savior, you fight alongside with the heroes and save the day! Whisper of Shadow offers a huge amount of artistic and astonishing scenes & maps. Make sure to join in!
*** Use Your Wisdom ***
Summon, collect & grow with hundreds of heroes, forge your exclusive gear and create the perfect lineup! Customize your powerful squad through Whisper of Shadow's various build systems and ensure your great victory!
