bluejetty:00180950:ios.description:
Train simulator is one of the best train games on store. It can also be categorized among train racing games with realistic graphics and smooth train controls. Start driving different types of us and euro trains on curvy railway routes. Drive local train as a train driver and become trained engineer after installing this super cargo train racing simulator and then control variety of euro trains. Enjoy this super-fast train mania in this train racing simulator game. 
You might have dreamed to be an engine driver and enjoy train drive by driving different kinds of trains? I am sure it was dream of your childhood while studying school to be a train driver to know how the trains actually drive on railway tracks and stops on train platforms. Try this train simulation game and give life to your dreams of childhood. It is one of the best Indian train simulator games in which you would play as a real train railway driver. Let’s drive and be a best train driver in this realistic euro train simulator game. You have to be a professional engine driver in metro train racing game on railway route.
Get yourself ready to play best and Top Train game. Enjoy the thrill of driving euro trains on railway line and be a train tracker in this train driving game. Transport passengers and tourists on their destination platforms in minimum time by following all the guidelines. Euro train simulator is the extreme fun for kids and adults that engaged them for hours. Pick up the tourists and passengers and their cargo from one platform to another as this train can be used as a cargo train for tourists for carrying their luggage. Different types of train locomotives are available in this train simulation game e.g. diesel, electric trains and steam engines for ultimate fun and excitement
Have unlimited fun and assigned train tasks are not much easy, you have to use your professional skills to be an expert steam train driver, complete your main tasks of transporting tourists and race against the given time period. Accelerate the train, apply hydraulic brakes, steer across junctions and drive Indian train across natural and realistic sceneries as you go for picking up tourists while performing your train driving duty with full responsibility. 
Spent maximum time for earning in game cash in this euro train simulator game for purchasing other train engine which is more powerful, fast and efficient. There are multiple modes unlike other train driving games; you can drive train in desert safari, snowy dunes and in lush green country yard surroundings.
*** Features of Train Simulator - Euro Railway Track Driving ***
• Multiple modes
• Adventurous & exciting multiple challenging levels.
• Challenging routes
• Realistic Indian, euro and Pakistani train engines
• Realistic and smooth controls
• HD and Marvelous 3D Graphics
• Day Mode gameplay
• Easy and free to play
• Offline Game Play
• Amazing camera views to deliver you realistic train driving experience
•Explore the beautiful open world hilly mountainous environment, country yard and snowy environment
***How To Play***
Swipe the slider for accelerating the train
Swipe left and right to take turns across the railway junctions
Don’t waste your precious time on searching train games or train simulator or train racing games or train driving games or train games etc. etc. Just download this and enjoy extreme fun of driving train engines on deadly railway tracks of green countryside, deserts and on glaciers.

• Practice that adapts to you: di
bluejetty:00084691:ios.description:
Numbio (formerly FastMath) turns mental math into a fast, satisfying daily habit. Train arithmetic, master your times tables, and watch your calculation speed climb in just a few minutes a day.
WHY NUMBIO?
• Practice that adapts to you: difficulty scales from Easy to Extreme as you improve.
• Bite-sized sessions for any schedule: a 60-second speed test or a full training plan.
• Actually fun: turn drills into a game and keep your daily streak alive.
PRACTICE EVERYTHING
• Free core arithmetic: addition, subtraction, multiplication & division
• Times tables, digit sums, mixed expressions & chained operations*
• Word problems, equations, rule of three, fractions, GCD & LCM*
• Advanced operations: percentages, squares, square roots & modulo*
• Every number type: decimals, money, fractions, binary, Roman numerals & more*
• Build your own custom training plans: practice exactly what you want*
LEARN THE TRICKS
• Step-by-step mental-math tricks and shortcuts that make hard sums easy
• Practice any trick right away with a matching, ready-made drill*
• A personalized "For You" feed that suggests what to learn next*
PLAY & COMPETE
• Brain-teasing games: Number Hunt, Magic Square, Sudoku & Mini Sudoku
• Climb Game Center leaderboards and unlock dozens of achievements
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Build daily streaks and hit personal goals that keep you coming back
• Earn XP and level up through ten ranks, from Bronze to Diamond
• Watch your speed and accuracy climb with detailed stats and personal bests
• Set daily reminders so you never break your streak
ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Cross-device sync keeps your progress in step wherever you practice
• Jump in within seconds from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Family Sharing: share Numbio Pro with up to five family members
• Available in 29 languages
PERFECT FOR
Students building arithmetic confidence • Test-takers prepping for GMAT, GRE & entrance exams • Professionals staying sharp • Parents and kids learning times tables • Anyone who loves a good number puzzle
Join thousands of learners worldwide sharpening their mental math with Numbio.
Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you at hello@numbio.com.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Privacy Policy: https://www.numbio.com/privacy
* Requires a Numbio Pro subscription.

bluejetty:00122490:ios.summary:
"Banco24Horas app makes your life easier! With it you can quickly and easily find an ATM nearest you to make transactions, such as withdrawing money or checking your account balance. Check out all the features that the app offers you:
 Fi
bluejetty:00122490:ios.description:
"Banco24Horas app makes your life easier! With it you can quickly and easily find an ATM nearest you to make transactions, such as withdrawing money or checking your account balance. Check out all the features that the app offers you:
 Find the nearest Banco24Horas
 Browse the map using your current location to find the ATMs nearest to you available for use in real-time.
 Or, search for the desired address to find the nearest Banco24Horas ATMs.
 ATMs availability in real time.
 To make it easier for you to find a Banco24Horas, the map will display only the ATMs available for use at the exact time of your search.
 Filter search to refine result
 Use search filters to display only places where there are Banco24Horas ATMs that meet your needs on the map. You can filter by business type or by business hours.
 Locate ATMs accessible to impaired people.
 You can also filter your search to see only those Banco24Horas ATMs that are accessible to impaired people.
 Map routes to Banco24Horas
 Take a route by car or on foot to the commercial establishment where Banco24Horas is located. You can see the route right on the map and track your position as you approach the address, or you can open it in other navigation apps you have installed, such as Waze, Google Maps, and even Uber.
 Get to know what services your bank offers
 Check at any time what services your bank offers to you at Banco24Horas ATMs and create a list of your favorite banks for easy reference next time you need it.
 Share Banco24Horas location
 You can also share the location of Banco24Horas ATMs with anyone you want through other communication apps you have installed, such as WhatsApp, Messenger, e-mail app, and others.
 Include transaction reminders
 Add reminders for the app to warn you to remember withdrawing money or paying a bill that will come due. This keeps your financial life organized and up to date!
 Find Banco24Horas nearest to you and perform financial services transactions such as withdrawal, statement and balance directly at one of our ATMs. Download the app now and start using it!"

bluejetty:00065440:ios.summary: The W.P.B. Go App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay orga
bluejetty:00065440:ios.description:
The W.P.B. Go App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact West Point Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the W.P.B. Go App, you must be enrolled as an West Point Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

PRAYER TIMES & ATHAN

bluejetty:00144624:ios.description:
Stay consistent with your daily prayers. Everyday Muslim brings prayer times, Athan reminders, Qibla direction, Quran audio and prayer tracking together in an Islamic app without ads.
PRAYER TIMES & ATHAN
See prayer times for your location, plan with monthly schedules, and choose calculation and juristic settings. Configure reminders for individual prayers.
QIBLA & WIDGETS
Find your prayer direction with a compass and map. Keep prayer times and progress close with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets on supported devices.
QURAN & DAILY WORSHIP
Read and listen to the Quran, choose reciters and translations, save bookmarks, and use downloaded audio offline. Explore duas, dhikr, a tasbih counter and the Hijri calendar.
BUILD A PRAYER ROUTINE
Record prayers and fasts, review your progress, and manage missed prayers. Optional Prayer Lock helps you focus by shielding selected apps after you enable it and grant Screen Time access.
MORE DAILY TOOLS
Find nearby masjids and halal places, calculate Zakat, learn the 99 Names of Allah, and share spiritual notes with Khair Partners.
The app interface is available in English and French. Notifications, alarms and widgets depend on your device, iOS version and permissions.
Optional monthly and yearly subscriptions support the app's development.

bluejetty:00073614:ios.description:
Your pocket photo editor app for retouching photos, removing unwanted stuff from photos on the go and even more. It gives your photos a natural look while saving you valuable time.
An accidental object, even though it may look tiny and harmless, can completely ruin the entire composition of a photo and make it worthless. However, it’s not a pain if you have your favorite TouchRetouch at hand.
At ADVA Soft, we're always innovating. Our latest updates, including the Editing by text, Removing and Adding People to the photo, Natural face retouch, Erase AI feature, the background eraser and changer, and features like Meshes and AI edge-aware object removal, were designed with your feedback in mind.
ADVANTAGES:
• Remove objects and people, retouch faces and change backgrounds
• Keep natural, undetectable retouch results
• Get your photos ready to share in under 60 seconds
• No editing skills needed
WHAT MAGIC CAN YOU DO WITH TOUCHRETOUCH?
ERASE AI-POWERED OBJECT REMOVAL:
Automatically detect and remove background objects like street signs, trash cans, and stop lights with Erase AI
Effortlessly remove wires, power lines, and other linear objects
Eliminate foreground meshes for a cleaner background
Remove background people and shadows
Naturally erase pimples, acne, glare, tattoos, skin blemishes, and wrinkles
Clean up travel photos
Remove text from Instagram and Snapchat posts
Restore old photos
BACKGROUND REMOVAL & REPLACEMENT:
Erase backgrounds and replace them with your own or stock photos
Use the background editor to achieve a transparent background
Blur backgrounds
PEOPLE REMOVAL
A stranger wandering into your perfect shot? TouchRetouch works as a powerful person remover that lets you remove people from photo in seconds. Erase photobombers and clear away background crowds so nothing distracts from the moment.
NATURAL FACE RETOUCH
Get a professional face retouch that still looks like you — not like a filter.
Remove pimples, blemishes, and acne marks
Soften wrinkles and reduce under-eye bags
Naturally whiten and brighten your smile
OBJECT REMOVAL LIKE MAGIC
The app declutters your images in a matter of seconds . That could be people or other background details you may need to erase. Use automatic content removal with the Brush tool or, when the result is not that perfect, manual retouching with the Clone Stamp tool to repair a photo.
AUTOMATIC MESH DETECTION AND REMOVAL
If you think that "getting past the mesh netting" is quite a challenging task, you probably haven’t tried using TouchRetouch yet. The app offers a way to deal with the problem in two simple steps. Select the tool from the main menu and tap the Go button to have a mesh removed just like magic. 
HELPFUL TUTORIALS
Explore in-app tutorials to master TouchRetouch quickly. Little effort and experience are needed to become a pro in using TouchRetouch. The interface and layout are clear and intuitive enough to make you feel comfortable the very first time you use it.
Download TouchRetouch now to harness photo magic from your pocket.
TouchRetouch is brought to you by ADVA Soft — a team of like-minded professionals and enthusiastic innovators committed to designing intelligent yet simple apps that create magic in your photos and save you time. Visit our website at www.adva-soft.com to learn more about the company and the apps it develops.
For any assistance with TouchRetouch, contact ADVA Soft Support at touchretouch@adva-soft.com. We welcome all your inquiries, comments, and suggestions about the app.

bluejetty:00120040:ios.name: Dinosaur Games for Kids: Dino!
bluejetty:00120040:ios.summary:
Explore Dino Island and meet our friendly dinosaurs! Feed a hungry diplodocus, fly with a playful pterodactyl, and learn many interesting facts along the way!
Set off on an exciting journey with your new friend — Raccoon! Help dinos break
bluejetty:00120040:ios.description:
Explore Dino Island and meet our friendly dinosaurs! Feed a hungry diplodocus, fly with a playful pterodactyl, and learn many interesting facts along the way!
Set off on an exciting journey with your new friend — Raccoon! Help dinos break free from huge ice blocks, play interesting games, and learn new facts about these prehistoric creatures.
Discover the fun dino world:
- Play with 8 amazing dinosaurs
- Learn facts about these fascinating creatures 
- Delight your dinosaur friends with surprise gifts 
- Feed the dinosaurs their favorite treats 
- Engage in fun, educational games 
- Enjoy the colorful graphics and animations 
- Use easy and kid-friendly controls 
- Play offline with no ads!
Dinosaurs come in a variety of sizes and shapes: some no bigger than a chicken, others taller than a house. This app is a big hit with preschool kids who love playing games and want to know more about their favorite dinosaurs! Learning and memorizing facts becomes fun when coupled with exciting games.
Friendly dinosaurs are waiting for kids to play with them: 
- Roar along with the mighty T-rex! 
- Fly together with Pterodactyl 
- Catch fish with Spinosaurus 
- Climb to the top of a cliff with Dilophosaurus 
- Play a melody with Parasaurolophus 
- Help Triceratops protect its herd 
- Gather the most delicious leaves for Diplodocus 
- Collect some crystals together with Ankylosaurus 
Enjoy bright graphics, cool music and sounds, and learn a lot! The games are designed to improve memory, attention, and hand mobility of toddlers. 
Your child can play offline and spend long car rides in the amazing dino world! No-wifi games are also helpful when your kid has to spend a long time waiting, so make sure to keep your little one busy and entertained. Let them turn their screen time into time spent learning!
One app includes many games featuring lovable characters, fascinating plots, different game techniques, and fun activities. It also provides tips during gameplay that help children learn about dinosaurs by themselves.
Access 20+ educational apps for kids with an Amaya Plus subscription! Ignite your child's imagination and develop their essential skills with our game collection. Play offline, anytime, anywhere. Connect up to 3 devices for seamless fun. Join now and embark on an exciting learning journey for your little ones!
We love to make kids happy, and we also like to read your emails! If you need help, have questions, or want to say “hi,” please get in touch at info@amayasoft.com
Terms of Use: http://amayakids.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00016904:ios.description:
Know the future and hidden secrets about yourself and others with accurate palm readings and analysis. Read the Life line, Head line, Heart line, Success Line, Fate Line, Travel Line, and Marriage line. Know more about love life, quality of life, health, personality, married life, etc. for your loved ones. Totally Free fun app. Be the center of attention in any party or group of friends by reading their palms.
The ancient practice of Chiromancy can help you reveal a lot about your past, present, and future. Aren't we always eager to know what life has to offer? 
Well, now you can at least get a clue and work towards your goals accordingly.
Through the Palmistry app, you will get to know about:
- Love Life
The Heartline will help you know about your love life and also guide you in the same.
- Physical Strength | Quality of Life | Health
The Life line is a future teller and helps you know how you will be able to improve your quality of life and health.
- Personality
The Head line will tell you what kind of a person you are and whether it is bad or good for your life.
- Marriage Life
The Marriage line will tell you how your married life will be and how to make it better if you are married and facing problems by reading the palm lines.
- Career | Work Life | Struggle & Success 
Do you feel you put in all the effort you can in a certain task and yet don't succeed in your career or elsewhere? Let the Success line show you what is wrong.
- Destiny | Luck & Fame
The Fate line reveals what life has in store for you in general and whether it is about money or personal issues.
- Travel 
The Travel line can reveal a lot about your travel thoughts and motivate you to travel and make traveling plans for the future.
You simply need to follow the instructions on the screen, answer a few questions about your palm, and get detailed reading quickly.

bluejetty:00026934:ios.name: iCollect Everything: Inventory
bluejetty:00026934:ios.summary: iCollect Everything is the #1 app on the App Store for managing your collectibles or inventory, whether at home, business, work, or school. This is a Universal app and works on both iPhone and iPad and syncs directly with our Mac app. Scan
bluejetty:00026934:ios.description:
iCollect Everything is the #1 app on the App Store for managing your collectibles or inventory, whether at home, business, work, or school. This is a Universal app and works on both iPhone and iPad and syncs directly with our Mac app. Scan in or search for any item you own or want and add them to your lists. Full of incredible features! 
-- Used officially by the state of Tennessee: Over 2000+ school teachers in five different school districts use it to manage their classroom book libraries.
• Manage and inventory any of these collections:
- Movies
- Books
- Video Games
- Comic Books
- Music
- Toy Cars (Hot Wheels)
- Bricks (LEGO)
- Wine
- Coins
- Art
- Action Figures
- Currency
- Dolls (Barbie)
- Vinyl Figures (Funko)
- Board Games
- Alcohol
- Magazines
- Model Trains and Planes
- Puzzles
- Pins (Disney)
- Watches
- Sci-Fi (Star Wars / Star Trek)
- Stamps
- Trading Cards: Sports, including baseball, football, basketball, soccer, hockey, racing, boxing, cricket, MMA, and more.
- Trading Cards: Non-Sports for Pokemon, Disney Lorcana, Magic: The Gathering, Star Wars, GPK, Yu-Gi-Oh!, and more
- Customized Collections of ANY kind
- and so much more! (see screenshots for more details)
Note: Large collections require an in-app purchase to unlock unlimited storage. You will be prompted when you reach the limits of your selected collectible type.
• Create any Customized Collectable type you can think of:
- Collect Harry Potter stuff? You can create a collectible type for that!
- What about sewing patterns? You can do that too.
- Sports memorabilia and trading cards? Done.
- Disney and other pop culture products and toys? We can help you manage those too.
- Kitchen, garage, business products, etc.
- Vintage Coca-Cola, antiques, music equipment, school classroom inventory, shop tools, posters, anything really.... we can help you manage it with this app.
• Loaded with millions of items from around the world in our database
• AI Identification Scanning, great for items without barcodes
• Full barcode, ISBN, package scanning, and advanced machine learning image recognition, as well as database search
• Automatic estimated values on nearly all of our built-in collectible types
• Cloud Backup
• Sync across multiple devices, including iPad
• Supports input in any language and allows selections of any country and currency
• Filters, sorting, and importing
• See your full collection value
• Insure your collectibles
• Three different custom layouts
• Exporting
• Multi-level sorting
• Shake to Select
• Default Field Data
• Customize which fields are displayed
• Section Counts
• Collapsable Sections
• Share your collection with friends or on social media like Facebook and Twitter
• Format your Titles with A, An, or The removed
• Extra features like colored Themes and Dark Mode
• Every field is editable
• Store up to four pictures (or ten for Pro users) per item, including front, back, and inside images of items
• Personal details per item including Loaned, Purchase Price, Purchase Date, Date Added, Personal Rating, Last Watched, Storage Location, Opened, Notes, Estimated Value, and more
• Index bars and search for quick access in large collections
This app is a completely new collecting experience, written from the ground up for iOS 26, the latest devices like iPhone 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max, Air, iPad Pro, and full Universal iPhone/iPad support built-in and syncs directly to our Mac app. Our app was created with a cloud database backend designed specifically to allow each item to be stored with its own individual attributes.
We can import your collection from nearly anywhere: CLZ Collectorz, MyMovies, Delicious Library, BookBuddy, and much more. Just send us your import file and we'll get you rolling.
Data provided by Discogs, TMDB, Amazon, Google, eBay, and users like you.
TERMS OF USE and PRIVACY INFO: https://www.icollecteverything.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00079366:ios.description:
Alhamdulillah, since September 2016 Al-Furqaan Foundation through its publishing divisions, has published this amazing new translation of the Quran, THE CLEAR QURAN, OFFICIALLY APPROVED BY AL-AZHAR. This translation is one of the most eloquent attempts to masterfully and accurately capture the elegance and vigor of the Quran in the modern English language. Its clarity for an average reader is evident in the choice of easy to understand words and phrases that reflect the beauty, flow and power of the original text. Along with just enough footnotes to clarify complex and contextual meanings, and brief Surah introductions, THE CLEAR QURAN groups verses and titles them based on the theme of those verses (hence the word Thematic in the title), to provide internal coherence to readers – Muslims and non-Muslims alike. Thanks to the dedicated team of scholars, editors, and proof readers lead by Dr. Mustafa Khattab, we at Al-Furqaan Foundation believe that the copy of THE CLEAR QURAN is the finest translation of the Final Revelation in the English language available today. bluejetty:00092159:ios.description:
Vitafit App is a very user-friendly health application, let us keep healthy together.
The main functions
+ Support BLE scanning, connection, and data transmission
+ Support to create multiple members through sharing one body fat scale
+ Supports multi-dimensional tracking of multiple body composition data such as BMI, body fat , body water,protein, etc.
+ Support multiple social account login and data sharing
+ Support cloud data storage, along with GDPR standards
+ Support HealthKit to read or share body compostion measurement
+ Apple Watch companion: measure with the scale on your watch and view up to 30 days of records or up to 100 measurements; full body composition is on iPhone
Note: Sign in on iPhone first. The Watch app cannot register or sign in by itself. This app requires a compatible body analyzer scale. Body composition data is for fitness and body-shape reference only and is not a medical diagnosis.

bluejetty:00168082:ios.description:
Disfruta los mejores Bosquejos para Sermones con esta maravillosa aplicación que incluye más de 100 bosquejos totalmente offline.
Bosquejos de sermones para predicaciones cristianas. Predica y estudia la palabra de Dios con la ayuda de estos magníficos bosquejos que ponemos a tu disposición.
Comparte tu amor a Dios y disfruta de una vida más agradable en fe, alegría, paz y amor.
Bosquejos de sermones es una gran herramienta para la preparación de sermones y estudios bíblicos. Aplique las Escrituras a la vida y enseñanza cotidiana para las necesidades de la congregación y del oyente y estudios que amplían aspectos valiosos de la vida cristiana.
Los bosquejos de Sermones forman parte de las herramientas de todo predicador. Un bosquejo bíblico contiene toda la estructura de una predicación o sus puntos relevantes, ayuda al predicador a mantener un orden en su exposición y a no olvidar los puntos del sermón.
Presentar un sermón o una clase bíblica realmente edificante es una hazaña de las más meritorias, ya que el que lo hace contribuye al bienestar moral y espiritual de la humanidad y al progreso de la causa de Dios en la tierra.
Bosquejos de sermones y predicas para acercarse más a Dios y a usted mismo. Ideales para su iglesia o para uso personal
La predicación o sermón homilético, fue la principal forma de comunicar la fe utilizada por Cristo durante su ministerio terrenal, sus apóstoles continuaron utilizándola con grandes resultados, según ha quedado registrado en el libro de Hechos de los Apóstoles. 
Bosquejos de Sermones es una aplicación gratuita que te permite disfrutar de contenidos con reflexiones poderosas acerca de las Santas Escrituras y recursos variados para elaborar tus presentaciones, sermones y predicas en tu iglesia o en tu reunión de celula o en el hogar.
Además, podrás navegar a través de toda la sabiduría de la Palabra de Dios en un lenguaje simple y claro con sólo unos pocos clics.

bluejetty:00175164:ios.description:
Get ready for a greater experience from booking to boarding and beyond with the SingaporeAir app.
From user experience to personalised features, our app is designed to be fast, intuitive and a delight to use.
More features will be progressively added in future updates, but here are some key functions you can enjoy now: 
1. Explore, be inspired and get the latest deals on the go 
Where to next? Discover the latest fare deals to your favourite destinations. Planning your next destination has never been easier. 
2. Search, book and manage your flights
Search and book flights to your next getaway with Singapore Airlines or one of our many airline partners. You can now use your KrisFlyer miles, Apple Pay and Alipay to book your flights and preferred seats. Receive updates on your upcoming trips and pre-select your inflight meals and entertainment. After that, all you need to do is sit back and relax.
3. Skip the check-in queues 
To prepare for your trip, stay updated on the latest entry requirements with our travel advisory. Skip the queues at the airport, check in and download your boarding pass* on our app before departure. Select your seats and browse our digital menu to see what’s served onboard.
If you are departing from Singapore Changi Airport, generate your baggage tags on our app* during check-in and track the status of your baggage. Simply scan your mobile boarding pass at the check-in kiosks to print your baggage tags and proceed to the automated bag drop counters to deposit your checked bag. 
4. Manage your KrisFlyer account
Log in to your KrisFlyer account to keep track of your KrisFlyer miles balance and expiry, transaction statements and PPS value. PPS Club members can also connect with our customer support team via PPS Connect**. 
5. Experience the future of flying
Find out what’s playing on our award-winning KrisWorld inflight entertainment system. Curate playlists on your app and pick up right where you last left off between flights, or view your flight’s progress***. 
*Subject to regulatory requirements 
**This service is currently only available for registered PPS Club members with valid Singapore mobile numbers 
*** This feature is available on A350 and selected Boeing 777-300ER aircrafts 
Please also note that by downloading the SingaporeAir app, you agree to the terms and conditions, including the privacy policy, which can be found at http://www.singaporeair.com/en_UK/terms-conditions/ and http://www.singaporeair.com/en_UK/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00168145:ios.name: NWS Weather Report: NOAA Radar
bluejetty:00168145:ios.summary:
Most apps show you the forecast. Weather Report shows you the reasoning. Experience accurate forecasts powered by the National Weather Service (NOAA) — written by real meteorologists, not computer models.
 Forecasts You Can Trust
• Data so
bluejetty:00168145:ios.description:
Most apps show you the forecast. Weather Report shows you the reasoning. Experience accurate forecasts powered by the National Weather Service (NOAA) — written by real meteorologists, not computer models.
 Forecasts You Can Trust
• Data sourced directly from NOAA and NWS meteorologists
• When models fill in the gaps, they use NOAA's latest technology
• Local forecasts for every U.S. city and territory
• Daily and hourly updates made by real people, not AI
Human Insight
• Read NWS forecast discussions directly from meteorologists
• Understand the reasoning behind the forecast — not just the icons
Advanced Radar
• Live NOAA NEXRAD radar for rain, snow, and storms
• 48-hour radar forecasts from high-resolution weather models
• View reflectivity, velocity, correlation coefficient, and more
• Track storms with alert overlays
Alerts That Arrive First
• Push notifications for watches, warnings, and advisories
• Lock-screen and home-screen widgets for rapid updates
Expert Outlooks
• NOAA Storm Prediction Center severe-weather maps
• National Hurricane Center and Climate Prediction Center outlooks
• Plan ahead with long-range and seasonal trends
Detailed Weather Charts
• 15-minute precipitation forecasts for the next 12 hours
• Snow forecasts and maps powered by 2026 forecasting research from NOAA
• Hourly data: wind, dewpoint, UV index, air quality, visibility, and more
Widgets & Personalization
• Multiple home and lock screen widgets
• View the week's forecast, or the day's forecast from your home screen
• See current metrics like air quality and UV index on your lock screen
Apple Watch Support
• Companion Apple Watch app with alerts, hourly and daily forecasts
• Various complications to see the weather on your watch face
Supports every U.S. location — 50 states, DC, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U.S. Virgin Islands
Weather Report is not affiliated with NOAA, the National Weather Service, or any other government agencies. Data sources include public NWS and NOAA datasets (NEXRAD, SPC, CPC, NHC).
Terms & Conditions apply: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00160475:ios.summary:
The StrikeX Wallet makes buying, selling, swapping, transferring, and tracking your favourite crypto projects — slick, secure and simple. As it should be.
Crypto is easy, don’t make it complicated. 
We’re on a mission to evolve how people
bluejetty:00160475:ios.description:
The StrikeX Wallet makes buying, selling, swapping, transferring, and tracking your favourite crypto projects — slick, secure and simple. As it should be.
Crypto is easy, don’t make it complicated. 
We’re on a mission to evolve how people interact with cryptocurrency: no more boring designs, complicated procedures, or exorbitant hidden costs. Manage your portfolio with a simple and secure app that does what you need it to. Most importantly, unlike our competitors — we are committed to utilising revenue from our competitive transaction fees to update & improve our App periodically.
Track portfolio performance across multiple wallets
Crypto doesn’t have to be confusing. We understand how convoluted this space can be; therefore, the StrikeX Wallet offers easy-to-use features such as crypto-tracking, an overview balance across multiple wallets, visual charting, a general market overview, and detailed transaction history; allowing you to take control of your investments.
Easily go from Card to Crypto with our integrated on & off-ramp payments.
Buy & Sell an array of cryptocurrencies directly to your bank account by utilising our growing list of fiat gateway providers. StrikeX charges an additional 1% Fiat on-ramp & a 2% Fiat off-ramp fee in addition to our partner's fees. Unlike our competitors, we are committed to utilising revenue from our competitive transaction fees to update & improve our App periodically.
One Wallet, multiple blockchains.
The StrikeX Wallet is Multichain, meaning that you don’t need multiple wallets for different chains. Send, receive & hold cryptocurrencies on the Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain & Solana blockchains in ONE StrikeX Wallet. Stay tuned as we integrate more blockchains periodically, making the StrikeX Wallet the most versatile on the market.
WalletConnect
Connect to any Web3-injected website using our integration with WalletConnect. From DeFi exchanges to NFT marketplaces, connect your StrikeX Wallet easily through the WalletConnect portal.
Send assets with confidence
The days of copying and pasting long addresses are over. Save contacts to your address book and make transferring Crypto to people you know and trust — easier and safer.
Your Wallet, your keys — your crypto.
Unlike exchanges, the StrikeX Wallet is non-custodial — meaning that we never have access to your funds or personal information. You maintain complete control over your assets with your unique private key recovery phrase.
Stay safe and secured from prying eyes (and hands).
Your assets are protected by private facial biometric authentication technology and a secure 4-digit PIN that not only protects you from theft, but gives you hassle-free account access — instantly.

bluejetty:00045934:ios.description:
Welcome to Parking Mobility: the #1 app to report disabled parking abuse!
Report disabled parking abuse to your city in less than two minutes. When you see a vehicle parked illegally, simply launch Parking Mobility, take 3 photos and submit. We tell the city and they ticket the vehicle’s owner. You help improve accessibility in your community and support people with disabilities. The data you help us generate helps demonstrate the worldwide problem of accessible parking abuse and helps us provide the most effective program to end abuse in your community.
You can also share, find and suggest accessible parking locations anywhere in the world. Most cities do not know where their accessible parking is, so at first, you may find only a few spots on the map where you live. As you and your friends and neighbors use Parking Mobility, more spots will be show up and your community will become more easily accessible.
You can share the locations of accessible spots in less than 30 seconds, allowing others in your community to more easily find accessible parking. By tapping the map pin, you can quickly see the location’s details (# of spaces, ramp access details, accessibility, cost, etc.)
If you or someone you know uses accessible parking, Parking Mobility is what you’ve been waiting for.

bluejetty:00175386:ios.description:
Bluebikes is metro-Boston’s public bike share system. With thousands of bikes available 24/7 at hundreds of stations throughout Metro-Boston, Bluebikes is one of the most popular bike shares in the country.
Use the app to find your closest station and purchase a pass. Then unlock one of Bluebikes' safe, sturdy, easy to ride bikes, and get riding right away. When you’re done riding, simply return the bike to an available dock at any station in the network. The app will show you all station locations, with real-time bike and dock availability, and you can save your favorites for later reference. Tap a station pin or location and the app will show you the best route to get there.

Send and receive money globally, in time and without any fees.
Imagine a smaller world. Zero financial restrictions and all the possibilities. Your Pesa account gives you access to instant money transfers in life’s crucial moments.
Manage multiple currency wallets and save your money and time when you send money in 5 minutes or less, with no transaction fees and exchange rates that don’t bite.
Send & Receive Money
Set up your Pesa account in minutes and join thousands of users sending and receiving money internationally with ease, at zero cost and the absolute best exchange rates in the market.
Send money to Kenya, Ghana, the United Kingdom, the EU, Nigeria, India, the Philippines, and many more countries.
Zero fee Money transfers
Enjoy free money transfers from Canada, Nigeria and the UK to over 50 countries. Your international money transfers will be at no cost when you send with Pesa. Zero transfer fees and no hidden fees. Experience all the freedom when you send with Pesa.
Manage multiple currencies
Effortlessly hold and transfer funds in various currencies. Experience the convenience of seamlessly managing currencies at the best rates and sending money globally from anywhere in the world. With the flexibility of exchanging at the best rates and sending money globally, regardless of your location, our platform provides easy access to multi-currency transfers. You can send money from CAD (Canadian Dollar) to INR (Indian Rupee), NGN (Nigerian Naira), PHP (Philippines Peso), GBP (Great British Pounds), GHS (Ghanaian Cedi), KES (Kenyan Shilling), UGX (Ugandan Shilling), EUR (Euro) and many more.
Earn with Pesa
Take advantage of Pesa referral and start earning extra cash for getting people to #sendwithpesa. By inviting your friends to use Pesa for their cross border money transfers, you can earn unlimited cash. Join the thousands of satisfied users in Canada and the UK who are already enjoying the benefits of borderless payments with no fees on Pesa. Don't miss out on this opportunity to earn while helping your friends discover a more convenient and seamless way to send money globally. Download the app and share your unique link!
Seamlessly convert currencies
Join thousands of people experiencing the convenience of Pesa. Send money from Canada, the Uk and Nigeria to India, Ghana, France, Kenya, and more with ease and for free.
Dare to go further
Take the opportunity to explore the world and Pesa will be with you. Helping you stay connected to places you love with instant international money transfers.
**Here’s why you need a Pesa account**
- Live internationally and make transfers like a local
- Hold and manage multiple currencies in one account
- Never worry about hefty transfer fees or frustrating processes. Enjoy free transfers with every transaction when you send money abroad with Pesa.
- Seamlessly convert your currencies on the go
- Always safe. Always secure.
- Track your transactions. Stay updated with instant notifications on your transactions. If you ever need assistance, you can send a mail to support@pesa.co or use the in-app chat option.
Pesa LLC is registered and regularized in Canada by the Financial Transactions and Report Analysis Center of Canada as a Money Service Business. Rn: M20300281.
Pesa LLC is also registered in the United States as a Money Service Business with the United States Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN). Rn: 31000231722151.
Your transactions are secure and our facial verification and password encrypted platform, security and fraud monitoring tools keep your personal information safe.

Carv was born out of the idea that better skiers have more fun. Most of us want to improve, to ski harder terrain, and to feel more confident and controlled while doing it, whatever our level.
With Carv, you don’t have to choose between learning and skiing. Every run you ski powers your journey to better skiing, wherever you ski, whoever you want to ski with.
Improve your technique, and have more fun on snow.

Real-Time Coaching
The experience is fully tailored to you. Carv sets a focus area based on your goals and skill level, so you always know what to work on next. And you can choose the level of coaching that fits your day — from no audio, to tips on the chairlift, to real-time feedback on every turn.

Just clip on Carv and take it anywhere on the mountain for a seamless, personalized coaching experience that evolves with you.

“Great for beginners [...] and perfection-obsessed experts.” - Outside

bluejetty:00036899:ios.description:
“I want to start running but it is hard to start.. there is no much information.”
“Running alone feels more tired, I feel like give up more quickly.”
All this problem will be gone together with RunDay. 
[Why RunDay?]
▶ 100% Full-voice training
eling like you're running with your own trainer, although you're starting running for the first time, you can finish the 30 minutes running with RunDay trainer. 
▶ Various customized running plan 
RunDay provides 30 mins running for beginners (24 days course), interval training, Everyday 30 mins running, Free running (users customizing running), Hiking and challenge running. 
▶ Sound mixing system
You can concentrate in running with the suitable music for your running intensity. You can also listen to the music that you want through the music streaming application.
▶ Runday Watch app support!
Using the Runday Watch app on Apple Watch, Runday's training program provided on mobile alone without a mobile phone
You can proceed, and the exercise records of the Apple Watch can be reflected in the mobile Runday record menu.
▶ Smartwatch compatibility
You can share the workout data through the connection of Smartwatch
▶ Subscription Information
· Product: Runday All-Day Package (auto-renewable subscription) 
· Duration & Price: Monthly and annual plans available. The price is shown in your local currency on the purchase screen before you confirm, and may vary by country/region. 
· Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. · Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
· Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the same price. 
· Subscriptions may be managed, and auto-renewal may be turned off, by going to your Account Settings after purchase. 
· This product does not offer a free trial; payment is charged immediately upon purchase.
▶ Workout data of Apple Health app may reflected to RunDay through integration of Health app with RunDay.
▶ If you keep turn on GPS at the background, the battery lifespan might be reduced.
▶Access authority
1. Location authority of users : This authority is required to record running data using GPS and using location service at the background.
2. Authority to access Apple music, your music and video activity, and media library : This authority is require to listen to the music in Apple music, your music and video activity, and media library while you're running.
3. Authority access to send you notification : This authority is required to send motivation push message to friends while running.
4. Camera access allowance : Access to share your running info on SNS or use as profile photo by taking photo.
5. Gallery access allowance: Access to share your running info on SNS or use as profile photo by taking gallery.
6. Microphone acces : Microphone permission is required to record voice messages.
7. Voice Recognition Access : Permission is required to find slang for voice messages.
8. Physical activity authority: This is the authority required to measure the number of steps and awareness of movement.
9. Apple Health: Use HealthKit to exercise and exercise pathways.
▶ In order to use the run day service, the following information must be entered when registering as a member.
1. Run day account creation: email address, password
2. Community Use: Nickname
3. Challenge mode and marathon use: nickname date of birth, gender
After access permission, you can reset or revoke access as follows
After you agree to the access authority, you may withdraw or reset through the below way.
Settings > Select RunDay > Select agree or withdraw for access authority
Partnership and Advertising Inquiry: business@ttam.ai
▶ RunDay Terms and Conditions 
https://health.runday.co.kr/runday_standardterms_en.html
▶ RunDay Privacy Policy

bluejetty:00040698:ios.description:
We all care so much about our babies and would love to constantly deepen our bonds with them. Baby Translator offers you the opportunity to do just that with its amazing AI technology. Now you can easily find out the reason why your baby is crying. The amazing new baby monitor will help you realize how babies are amazing beings that have a very wide range of emotions that you just might not be privy to every little expression and sound they make. Babbles, cries, weird noises, everything the baby utters is an indication of a particular feeling. Your baby could be hungry or sleepy and their cries might be of annoyance or delight. Say goodbye to the times when your baby just kept on crying for hours on end with you not knowing what to do! With white and pink noise options you can set up the best atmosphere that promotes the best relaxation for your baby. Such is the effect of music and tones on the baby’s senses.
The Cry Analyzer will help you understand each sound that your little baby makes. This amazing array of options and features will undoubtedly make your house a much more comfortable place as you will respond to each of your baby’s need instantly. Modern research has really opened pathways into understanding what can be termed baby language and combining it with AI technology has produced this amazing app. Of course it goes without saying that Baby Translator will adapt to each individual baby and make it such that the best level of harmony between parent and child is achieved. You will have new levels of intimacy with your baby and finally get all those little things they’ve been trying to express.
Parenting will definitely be harder without the help of Baby Translator!

bluejetty:00137665:ios.description:
Never miss a beat with Health Partner! Check your heart rate, log your blood pressure, and record your oxygen saturation with your iPhone.
Easily take your heart rate by placing your finger on the camera. Measure your heart rate daily to track your history with our advanced HRV technology. This heart health app will educate and inform you on how to keep your heart strong and risk factors minimal. Take the guess work out of your health and get started today!
Health Partner provides educational content presented in various formats, including videos, articles, Health Tests and Tips,and Meditation. to help you relax and unwind from your stressful day. The app is the ideal companion for your everyday rituals like meditation, yoga, and bedtime.
Health Disclaimer:
· This application is created for health awareness and stress relief purposes.
· It is crucial to avoid utilizing this application for diagnosing, preventing, or treating any medical conditions. This app is not a replacement for specialized medical equipment or professional medical advice.
· Kindly note that this app's functionality is confined to heart rate measurement and does not encompass the monitoring of blood pressure or blood oxygen levels.
· Should you have any health-related concerns, it is always recommended to seek guidance from a certified medical professional before making decisions or adhering to any advice.
Key Features:
· Health Plans Across Various Formats: Access an extensive library of educational content presented in various formats, including videos, articles, and podcasts. These plans cover a wide range of health-related topics, ensuring a well-rounded understanding of different aspects of wellness.
· Health Tests and Tips: Engage in health assessments and receive personalized tips based on your test results. These insights will assist in understanding your current health status and provide guidance for improvement.
· Fitness Courses: Explore a multitude of fitness courses catering to different levels and interests. From beginner workouts to specialized training, there's something for everyone, empowering users to achieve their fitness goals.
· Meditation: Unwind and improve your mental health with guided meditation sessions , aiding relaxation and stress reduction.
· Heart Rate Monitoring: Utilize heart rate measurement features to track and analyze your cardiovascular health during exercise or at rest. Monitor your heart health in real-time to ensure a balanced and safe workout routine.
Subscription Options: Weekly/ Monthly/ Yearly
1. Upon purchase confirmation, payment will be deducted from your iTunes Account.
2. Post-purchase, you can handle subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
3. Failure to disable auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the current period concludes will result in automatic subscription renewal.
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of use:
Terms of Use: https://ahealthpartner.netlify.app/#terms
Privacy Policy: https://ahealthpartner.netlify.app/#privacy

bluejetty:00075138:ios.description:
X-Stitch Plus is the best way to inventory and track all your cross stitch stash. This easy-to-use app was designed by cross stitchers for cross stitchers. Track all your projects from wish list to finished using the Journal feature. Load up to 5 photos per project. Use the inventory to track all your threads, charts, linens and embellishments. Tens of thousands of threads are pre-loaded so you don't have to type in details. Mill Hill beads are also pre-loaded so you can quickly add them to your inventory. Keep multiple photos for your charts and embellishments. Use the fabric calculator to easily determine fabric dimensions in inches and centimeters. The shopping cart helps ensure you remember exactly what you need when you're at the shop. And of course, these modules are interlinked so you can quickly share info between them, e.g., quickly create a Journal entry from one of your charts. Want to share? X-Stitch Plus supports sharing via Facebook, Twitter, E-Mail, Text and more. Another key benefit of X-Stitch Plus is all your data is stored in the cloud. View and update your data from any of your devices and they're all in sync. You can even access data from the original X-Stitch app. No need to reenter data. Check out the best cross stitch inventory app today with a 7-day free trial!
Subscription Information

Privacy Policy: https://xstitchapp.com/?page_id=10

bluejetty:00096314:ios.summary:
Royal Chef: Cooking Game – Your Ultimate Cooking Fever Journey
Get ready to experience the thrill of the kitchen like never before in Royal Chef: Cooking Game, a casual mobile game designed for every food lover and time management game ent
bluejetty:00096314:ios.description:
Royal Chef: Cooking Game – Your Ultimate Cooking Fever Journey
Get ready to experience the thrill of the kitchen like never before in Royal Chef: Cooking Game, a casual mobile game designed for every food lover and time management game enthusiast out there! Step into the shoes of a star chef and immerse yourself in the madness of the crazy kitchen, where the pressure is high, the orders keep coming, and the customers are hungry for more!
Whether you're a fan of cooking mania, diner dash, cake mania, or kitchen scramble, this cooking simulator is packed with addictive gameplay that challenges you to make food, serve dishes, and run your own restaurant empire.
Cook, Serve & Conquer in the Ultimate Restaurant Game
Welcome to the world where your restaurant story begins! From flipping juicy burgers, baking great pizza, to preparing delicious desserts and authentic global dishes like Chinese noodles or Indian curry – Royal Chef gives you the chance to become the world’s top culinary master.
Master every station in your crazy kitchen – from the stove to the fryer, from the pizza oven to the sushi counter. Use real-world appliances like coffee machines, rice cookers, popcorn makers, and more as you build and upgrade your kitchen.
Key Features That Will Make You Hungry for More:
Addictive time management gameplay with fast-paced levels and endless fun
Over 1000 levels of cooking challenges and restaurant missions
Thousands of recipes to cook from every cuisine imaginable
Hundreds of kitchen upgrades: ovens, fryers, drink dispensers, and décor
Customize your restaurant interior to attract more customers
Decorate with themes, unlock chef outfits, and upgrade your menu
Serve goodies like cookies, cupcakes, and side dishes to win customer loyalty
Use powerful boosters to beat hard levels and maximize your tips
Compete in cooking tournaments and seasonal events to earn exclusive rewards
Build your family-style café, a fine-dining restaurant, or a fast-food diner – it’s your story!
Join the Cooking Fever Craze
Royal Chef isn’t just a game – it’s a passion! Each level tests your ability to multitask, satisfy demanding customers, and manage your time like a pro. As you progress, you’ll unlock new restaurants, expand your kitchen, and enhance your skills.
Feel the cooking fever as you rush to complete each diner dash before the customers lose patience. Stay focused, keep cooking, and prove that you have what it takes to be a master chef in the most exciting restaurant game available on mobile.
Millions of Players Can’t Get Enough:
“Best cooking game I've ever played. Challenging and fun!”
“It’s like Cooking Fever meets Diner Dash – but better!”
“I love the endless dishes and global cuisine variety.”
Royal Chef has become a top-rated cooking game thanks to its rich graphics, intuitive controls, and exciting gameplay loop. Whether you have a few minutes to play or want to binge through dozens of levels, there’s always something fresh on the menu.
Download Now and Start Cooking Like a Royalty
Don’t miss your chance to jump into the crazy kitchen and live your best life as a Royal Chef! With addictive time management mechanics, creative cooking, and loads of content, it’s the perfect game to spice up your day.
Are you ready to cook, serve, and rise through the culinary ranks? The heat is on – and your restaurant story is about to begin. Tap “Install” now and become the cooking legend the world is waiting for!

bluejetty:00069495:ios.description:
Use on iPhone, iPad and Mac. 
If you're in need of a drummer, keyboard player, bass, guitarist, more singers in your ensemble, etc... Worship Backing Tracks® has you covered with HD multitrack music with vocals! Subscribe Now!
W.B.T. is an easy-to-use multitrack music app. It's great for churches with limited musician and equipment options. This app caters to those who are looking to raise the standard of excellence in the art of musical celebration. It is a serendipitous fusion of sound and quality; which is the perfect combo for a great musical worship experience. 
Features: 
- Tap & Hold a section during playback to instantly crossfade to it. This is useful for when your lead singer suddenly changes the song arrangement live. 
- Rearrange songs ahead of time. Then the song will auto play in the arrangement you set. Tap the info button on the song page (in playlists only)
- Auto-Play song to song in playlist. (Auto-Play on/of switch on playlist page)
- Section Jumping and Looping
- Rearrange a song in live worship (i.e. flowing from verse to bridge with the tap of a button)
- Key Change Options
- Tempo Change Options
- Adjust the volume of individual Instruments, vocals and other tracks live.
- Ability to go from acoustic version to full band via the mixer. Solo and Mute tracks to fit the feel of any moment. Convert a full song into an altar call or prayer moment by muting vocals, drums and adjusting volumes.
- Create and Save Playlists: Songs automatically play in order within a playlist. 
- Share playlists/song lists with your team. 
- Add lyrics to songs. Tap the info button on the song page and type lyrics at the times you want them to show up. Once done, the song lyrics will show in the lyrics page during playback on the main song page. 
- - Share lyrics file with your other devices so you don’t have to retype them again. 
- - Paste full song lyrics and just scroll lyrics during playback. (If you don’t desire to set lyrics by time)
*Subscription*
$39.99/month (All Songs) - Unlimited access to every current and added song, having a professional band and ensemble sound for under $10/week.
$400/year (Yearly) - It’s like getting 2 months FREE when you subscribe yearly! Costs 2 months less than subscribing monthly for a year. Perfect for consistent, enhanced worship experiences all year.
This subscription will renew automatically every month unless automatic renewal is turned off at least 24hrs before subscription period ends. Payment will be charged to your AppStore account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription may be managed and auto renewal can be turned off by going to your account settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Privacy Policy & Terms Of Use
http://www.xmeinc.com/new/worship-privacy.html

bluejetty:00126855:ios.description:
Brili Routines is a visual planner and timekeeper that helps manage and gamify your tasks, designed to be the perfect organizer for the ADHD / ADD community.
Brili is based on the latest ADHD research and incorporates best practices from Cognitive Behavioural Therapy. Build well-designed routines that fit your unique way of living with ADHD to set out on your next adventure.
Create, schedule, manage, and complete your routines with Brili in an gamified and structured way that allows for the flexibility and fun you need to move through your daily tasks with ease.
With Brili, routines are brought to life as well-paced playlists. Consistent notifications nudge you to stay on track with your timed and scheduled routines. The calendar allows you to view your day and week, and customizable awards motivate you to grow over time. The Brili technique helps you manage your ADHD symptoms, avoid procrastination, keep your concentration and stick to a daily plan.
The app helps with the visualization of time to keep you on the quest at hand and up to date with your schedule. Brili’s unique visual clock automatically calculates the time left to complete all of your tasks, so you can better concentrate on what you are working on now.
Many individuals with ADHD have seen incredible benefits from Brili beyond just health and structure. Benefits may include improved mood, less compulsive behavior and a better ability to concentrate with fewer distractions.
Build and schedule these into your day:
- Morning routines
- Work routines
- Self-care routines
- Pomodoro routines
- Bedtime routines
- Mindfulness routines
- Exercise routines
- Cleaning routines
- Calming routines
- Study routines
- Meal planning routines
Maximize on these features in Brili:
- On-demand routines
- Routine creator
- Dynamic timekeeper
- Visual clock
- Info Boost
- Focused task cards
- Task notes
- Notifications
- Acoustic / visual notifications
- Calendar view
- Achievements
- Customizable rewards
- Routine history
- Weekly calendar
Upgrade in these areas with Brili:
- ADHD symptom management
- Reducing anxiety
- Sticking to a schedule
- Building and tracking healthy habits
- Maintaining attention
- Interpersonal relationships
- Personal hygiene
- Personal nutrition
- Self motivation
- Overall focus and concentration
- Goal setting and achieving
- Task transitioning
- Time blindness
- Organization
Start strong with our pre-made templates, curated by ADHD and routine experts.
Structure takes time to get right, but when you can plan and execute it with ease, it helps you stay focused and remain in the moment. Distractions are a huge challenge, so having a helpful companion with a simple yet flexible design just might save you from losing interest in that next habit, hobby, business idea or art project.
Brili exists because of the ADHD community's incredible support, so we built the app for you, based on your recommendations and suggestions. If you had been living undiagnosed for a long time, we know you are on the search for tools to help in your quest for better time management. For those of you who have been living with a diagnosis since early on, you may feel like you have exhausted every option, but Brili might just change that as a powerful tool in your toolbox.

bluejetty:00114342:ios.description:
Start your creative journey with confidence. Whether you're picking up a brush for the first time, returning to art after years away, or simply looking for a relaxing way to unwind, ArtCoach helps you build real skills through simple lessons, encouraging practice, and AI guidance that makes every step feel easy.
Learn Faster, Create Better in Just 10 Minutes a Day
ArtCoach helps you turn art into a simple, rewarding daily habit. Whether you want to fill a sketchbook, paint a canvas, or just unwind with a brush in hand — use it to make art you're proud of, relax after a long day, or guide your child as they create their first masterpiece. Each lesson is fun, approachable, and designed to give you a real sense of progress without pressure. You only need a few minutes a day to feel improvement.
Your Personal AI Art Coach
Upload your work and get warm, beginner-friendly feedback—fast.
The AI coach celebrates what you're doing well, gently shows you your next step, and makes sure you always know where to go from here. Struggling with proportions, shading, or color? Your coach will guide you through it. It feels like having a creative friend who always knows what to say — supportive, encouraging, and right there with you every time you create.
Beginner-Friendly Lessons for Everyday Life
• Quick step-by-step projects you can finish in one sitting
• Relaxing practice sessions that help adults destress and find their flow
• Simple exercises designed for complete beginners with no prior experience
• Creative ideas for canvas art, sketchbooks, home decor, and personal projects
• Small daily routines that build real skill naturally over time
What You Will Learn
ArtCoach covers everything a beginner needs to get started and keep growing. From your very first brushstroke to building confidence with color and detail, every lesson is structured to feel achievable and fun.
• Master the fundamentals: lines, shapes, perspective, and proportions
• Explore color mixing, blending, and layering techniques
• Learn shading and light to bring depth to your work
• Practice brushwork and texture for expressive, confident strokes
• Build a creative routine that fits naturally into your day
Perfect for Adults and Kids Alike
ArtCoach is designed to work for everyone. Adults use it to rediscover creativity, reduce stress, and finally learn the art skills they always wanted. Parents use it to share a creative moment with their kids. Whether you are 8 or 80, ArtCoach meets you where you are and helps you move forward at your own pace.
Smart Tools for Your Creative Routine
• Color palette suggestions that make your work pop and prevent muddy mixes
• Practical tips for composition, shading, layering, and proportions
• Easy drawing and painting project ideas for all skill levels
• AI feedback that keeps you improving with every single session
Small Effort, Real Progress
ArtCoach makes it easy to grow your art skills no matter your schedule. Create art you love, explore relaxing creative moments, or help your child gain confidence in drawing and painting. You will see your skills develop a little more each day — and feel the satisfaction of making something genuinely your own.
Start your creative journey today and enjoy the progress you can feel.

bluejetty:00182456:ios.description:
Since the death of our Old Godfather, the Family has been missing a strong leader, one that can unite all the mafia gangs. You must find and recruit talented individuals from all corners of the underworld society, ranging from thieves and mercenaries to athletes and businessmen, to strengthen your crew. Fight, dominate and become the criminal mastermind who can take over the whole underworld!
◎Take Over the Underworld◎
Players will need to take on the law and battle other players to control the cities they reside in. Businesses will be up for grabs. Citizens seeking a better life will look to you as their savior. You will entice models and celebrities to join your life of crime with your dashing looks and mysterious charisma!
◎Lots of Thugs to Choose From◎
There are many different types of thugs within the game. Bruisers, Hitmen, Bikers and Mortar Cars are all at your disposal! Each type of thugs have their own stats. You will need to upgrade your loyal minions and choose the formations of your crews wisely. There will be times when you need to be aggressively offensive, times when you need to be overly defensive, and then there will be times when you need to have stealth on your side!
◎Tons of Faction Events◎
Once you have joined a Faction, you will be able to take part in numerous weekly and seasonal events. Want to take over the local government together? Want to clean up the streets of any unworthy punks who want to criticize your reign of terror? Stay tuned for various cool competitions!
◎Customizable Strategies◎
Every player will be able to develop their criminal empire differently. There are different skills, stats, characters and upgradable content within the game, which require your attention to strategy to individualize your army with fully-fledged mechanics.
◎Different Styles of Fighting◎
This game offers various types of battles. Sometimes you will need to choose your special characters to tackle harder opponents. At other times you will have to organize massive Crews to invade the turfs of other players.
◎Worldwide Online Tournaments◎
You won’t be alone in this pursuit to live a life of a Mafia Boss! You will compete with players from all over the world to reach the top of your criminal career. Will you join forces with them to form a Faction, or meddle in their operations to take them down? Who will become the next godfather? Your actions will determine your fate!
Subscription Rules:
1. Subscription Validity: 31 days (from the day of purchase until the 31st day at 11:59:59 p.m.).
2. Once subscribed, the following can be claimed daily: 500 Gold, 3-Hr Speed-Up*1, 1-Hr Speed-Up*3, 15-Min Speed-Up*7, 1-Min Speed-Up*15, 600K Diamonds*1, 1.5M Arms*1, 1.5M Cargo*1, 1.5M Metal*1, 500K Cash*3.
3. During the subscription period, you can enjoy the following features: an additional Construction Queue, a special Name Tag and Chat Bubble, double rewards from Mystery Crate, collectively complete Faction and Family Tasks, and collectively claim Daily Tasks.
4. New subscription fees will be automatically deducted once the subscription validity ends. If you wish to unsubscribe, you will need to do it manually.
5. Your iTunes account will be charged after you confirm your subscription.
6. Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless canceled at least 24 hours before your current subscription ends.
7. Your account will receive the purchase and price confirmation within 24 hours prior to the end of your current subscription period.
8. After subscribing, you can end the subscription service you purchased in your Account Settings.

- Use the live chat feature or email us for 24/7 support.

bluejetty:00114698:ios.description:
Style & Secret: Where Fashion Meets Mystery
Unwind screws, unlock secrets, and design your destiny! 
Welcome to Style & Secret, a captivating world where fashion, romance, and mystery collide. Every puzzle you solve and every outfit you choose brings you one step closer to uncovering the heroine’s hidden story — a journey of heartbreak, ambition, and rebirth.
In this unique 3D puzzle-dress-up adventure, you’ll follow her transformation from ordinary to extraordinary. From moments of love and betrayal to triumphs in career and self-discovery, every chapter unfolds through your hands. The choices you make — how you style her, how you play — will shape her fate and reveal secrets she never knew existed.
Game Features
Unique Gameplay Fusion – A brand-new combination of satisfying screw-removal puzzles and stylish makeover gameplay. Twist, turn, and solve 3D puzzles to unlock fashion scenes and dramatic story moments.
Glamorous Dress-Up & Makeovers – From chic streetwear to haute couture, collect stunning outfits, hairstyles, and accessories. Create your own lookbook of dreams and define the heroine’s evolution with every style.
Immersive Storyline – Dive into a tale of love, betrayal, and courage. Every makeover changes the narrative — and your decisions unlock multiple endings. Will she chase love, fame, or freedom? You decide.
Wardrobe & Collection System – Every outfit you earn is saved in your personal album. Revisit your favorite styles, experiment with colors, and build a dazzling archive of your journey.
Scene Challenges & Style Battles – Dress for interviews, dates, galas, and red carpets. The perfect outfit can change how others see her — and how she sees herself.
Relaxing Yet Addictive Puzzles – Simple to play, cleverly designed, endlessly satisfying. Unwind after a long day with 3D screw challenges that reward both skill and creativity.
Why You’ll Love It
Whether you’re passionate about romantic stories, clever puzzles, or stunning fashion, Style & Secret has everything you crave. Feel the spark of transformation, the joy of creativity, and the thrill of uncovering hidden truths.
Every screw you turn reveals beauty. Every outfit you design tells a story. And every secret you uncover brings you closer to her true self.
Relax, play, and discover the mystery behind her style.

bluejetty:00028683:ios.name: Learn with Sesame Street
bluejetty:00028683:ios.summary:
Kids practice social-emotional and academic skills with beloved Sesame Street friends. Help your child take on the challenges they face every day with skills they’ll use for life! 
Created with Begin’s research-based curriculum and Sesame
bluejetty:00028683:ios.description:
Kids practice social-emotional and academic skills with beloved Sesame Street friends. Help your child take on the challenges they face every day with skills they’ll use for life! 
Created with Begin’s research-based curriculum and Sesame Workshop’s tried and true approach, Learn with Sesame Street helps kids build skills for school and life. Perfect for ages 2-5!
Key Features: 
- 12 exclusive classes featuring Elmo & friends, created by Begin
- 18 videos from Sesame Workshop
- 17 fun, interactive stories and games, plus catchy original songs 
- Face It, Place It: Two-part interactive game that helps kids explore expressions and how they relate to emotions. 
- Your favorite Sesame Street characters in every activity 
- Safe, replayable, and ad-free: developmentally appropriate activities are easy for kids to play independently 
- Designed by learning experts to build foundational skills
- Addresses everyday challenges like bedtime routines, trying new things, sharing, and more
- One-time purchase also unlocks the Grown-Up Guide, with classes and tips for parents & caregivers (accessible online)
Tools for Navigating Challenges
Help kids develop tools and strategies for navigating everyday challenges, new experiences, and big feelings around relevant topics: trying new things, navigating social spaces, bedtime, sharing, conflict resolution, empathy, kindness, and more. 
Foundations for School and Life Skills
Fosters social-emotional experiences that build foundations for academic and personal growth, like problem-solving, resilience-building, impulse control, and flexibility, while providing opportunities for skill practice in 123s, ABCs, colors, shapes, and more. 
Build Confidence with “I Did It!” Moments
With fun activities they can play independently, plus opportunities to celebrate learning wins with their favorite Sesame Street friends, kids build the confidence they need to take knowledge into the world. It’s growth kids are proud of, and parents can see! 
Learn with Sesame Street Friends
Classes, interactive stories and songs give kids an opportunity to explore emotions fully and safely with their favorite Sesame Street friends: Elmo, Big Bird, Cookie Monster, Bert, Ernie, Grover, and more! 
About Begin
Begin is the award-winning early learning company offering children the best start possible through digital, physical, and experiential learning programs. With play-based products including HOMER, KidPass, codeSpark Academy, and Little Passports, Begin builds the skills that matter most to help kids achieve their fullest potential in school and life. Begin is backed by the most recognized names in early childhood development, including LEGO Ventures, Sesame Workshop, and Gymboree Play & Music. For more information about Begin and its suite of integrated programs, visit www.beginlearning.com. 
About Sesame Workshop 
Sesame Workshop is the nonprofit educational organization behind Sesame Street, the pioneering television show that has been reaching and teaching children since 1969. Today, Sesame Workshop is an innovative force for change, with a mission to help kids everywhere grow smarter, stronger, and kinder. We’re present in more than 150 countries, serving vulnerable children through a wide range of media, formal education, and philanthropically funded social impact programs, each grounded in rigorous research and tailored to the needs and cultures of the communities we serve. For more information, please visit www.sesameworkshop.org.
Sign Up & Program Details
Download the app for access to free + premium content for a one-time fee of $39.99.

bluejetty:00091843:ios.description:

Expertly Crafted Questions:

Realistic Simulations:
Step into the exam environment with realistic simulations. Practice under timed conditions to sharpen your time management and build the confidence you need to perform on the real exam day.
Detailed Explanations:
Every question comes with a detailed explanation that walks through why each answer is correct or incorrect. You reinforce the reasoning behind executive decisions, not just the answer key, so the core concepts stay with you.
Focused Study Plans:
Shape your preparation around your schedule and your goals. Whether you want targeted reviews of weaker areas or full-length exam simulations, the app adapts to your study preferences for an efficient, personalized learning experience.
Track Your Progress:
See exactly how you are doing with clear analytics. Monitor your performance over time, spot the areas that need more attention, and watch your scores improve as the exam gets closer.
Stay Updated:
Exam content evolves, and your study material should keep pace. The app is updated regularly to stay aligned with changes to the NE-BC exam, so what you review stays relevant.
In-Depth Content Coverage:
Every part of the exam blueprint is explored thoroughly, from the leadership and management responsibilities of a nurse executive to the operational side of running nursing services, so you get a complete understanding of the material rather than a quick overview.
Interactive Learning Tools:
Study with tools that keep you engaged. Visual aids, mnemonics and interactive scenarios turn dense leadership concepts into material you can actually recall under pressure.
Achieve Confidence and Success:
With NE-BC Mastery Exam Prep 2027 you are not merely preparing for an exam - you are preparing for the next step in your career. Pass the NE-BC exam with confidence, join the ranks of Nurse Executive-Board Certified leaders, and make a bigger impact in your organization.
