bluejetty:00019015:ios.name: Cristiano Ronaldo: Kick'n'Run
bluejetty:00019015:ios.summary: How would you like to be in the shoes of Cristiano Ronaldo – one of the world’s top football players? See how it feels to Kick and Run like CR7 in this unique game of skill and precision! Connect to Facebook, strive to get the highest score
bluejetty:00019015:ios.description:
How would you like to be in the shoes of Cristiano Ronaldo – one of the world’s top football players? See how it feels to Kick and Run like CR7 in this unique game of skill and precision! Connect to Facebook, strive to get the highest scores and you might even find yourself competing against none other than the real Cristiano Ronaldo!
1v1 Matches
Compete against real soccer and football fan players from all over the world in one versus one games for great prizes! Climb the ladder and face tougher opponents in the brand new game mode!
Tournaments
Team up with your friends from anywhere in the world and compete in becoming the leading team in the ever-exciting tournaments. Prove yourself in being the most valuable asset in your team by scoring the most points and make a name for yourself.
Run and score
While it’s fun to be a team player, any real world record holding striker knows that when it comes to scoring that winning goal, it’s all about his shooting skills and winner instinct. So take charge and run as fast as you can, while making sure you’re positioning yourself in the right spot for that killer kick!
Avoid attacking players
It’s not all about being able to run and shoot the football towards the goal, if you can’t avoid those tricky tackles from the rival defenders. Be quick and decisive when moving out of the way of the incoming attacks, while keeping your eyes on the goal and jump high as Ronaldo if needed! 
Take advantage of special power-ups
Smash through obstacles and gather loads of points with the help of special items that can be picked up along the way. This will help you advance in the leaderboards and, ultimately, achieve worldwide recognition.
Look good on the field  If you’re a real fan of Cristiano Ronaldo, you know that he likes to look good in any occasion, not less so when running and showing off his skills as a star striker at the Euro Cup 2021. There is an awesome selection of football apparel and boots to choose from, so you’ll look as sharp as the man himself!
As always, we’d love to hear your feedback so make sure to review and rate our app, so we know how to constantly improve!
PLEASE NOTE! Kick’n’Run is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00066350:ios.description:
Swipe Brick Breaker loved by 10 million users, start now!
A game that you will become addicted to without realizing it while using your wits and control to smash bricks!
[Features of Swipe Brick Breaker]
Even if you turn off the game, you can play indefinitely unless it's game over!
You can play comfortably without Wi-Fi!
Enjoy the game faster and more fun with Speed Mode and Power Mode!
Blow dozens of balls with just a touch to smash bricks and challenge your high score!
[How to Swipe Brick Breaker]
1. Swipe the ball to destroy the bricks.
2. When the ball collides, the durability of the bricks decreases, and when the durability reaches 0, the bricks are destroyed.
3. The number of balls increases when you win the green circle.
4. When the bricks come down to the bottom line, the game is over.

Swipe Brick Breaker is a free game.

bluejetty:00105110:ios:1.name: My Talking Tom 2: Pet Game
bluejetty:00105110:ios:1.summary: Offline pet game: care for virtual cat Tom, play mini-games, explore worlds.
bluejetty:00105110:ios:1.description:
The superstar virtual cat is going on the ultimate pet adventure, and with you, it's going to be more fun than ever! Your favorite funny friend is ready to dazzle you with his new wardrobe, amazing skills, and special features.
What You Can Do:
- Learn New Skills: Teach Tom cool tricks and skills like playing drums, basketball, and boxing. He'll be the most talented cat around!
- Taste the Latest Snacks: Discover and feed Tom various delicious and funny snacks. From ice cream to sushi, Tom loves it all! Do you dare to give him a hot chili pepper?
- Stay Clean: Help Tom stay fresh and clean with fun activities like bathing and brushing his teeth. Keep him squeaky clean!
- Pop to the Toilet: Yes, even Tom needs bathroom breaks, and it's as funny as it sounds! Help him out and make sure he's comfy.
- Explore New Worlds: Travel with Tom to exciting new places and discover hidden surprises. Fly to different islands with special flight tokens!
- Collect Clothes, Furniture, and Special Memories: Customize Tom's look with crazy outfits and decorate his home with funky furniture.
- Gacha Goodies: Unlock awesome rewards and surprises by doing different activities. Get cool outfits, delicious snacks, and more!
Extra Fun Activities:
- Play on Giant Swing and Trampoline: Let Tom swing high and jump around for some extra laughs.
- Cook Smoothies: Blend up delicious and wacky smoothies for Tom to enjoy.
- Heal Booboos: Take care of Tom when he gets hurt and make sure he's back to his playful self in no time.
- Mini Games and Puzzles: Challenge yourself with entertaining mini-games and puzzles that keep you hooked for hours.
- Keep Playing: See how Talking Tom's backyard changes into a Candy Kingdom, Pirate Island, Underwater Home, and other magical worlds, where you can dive into the endless fun with Tom and his pet friends.
This virtual pet game is packed with adventure, laughter, and unforgettable moments! Make sure you capture them all!
From Outfit7, creators of the hit games My Talking Angela, My Talking Angela 2 and My Talking Tom Friends.

- Alternative options to access all functionalities of the app without making any in-app purchases using real money.

bluejetty:00083533:ios.description:
Access your accounts anytime, anywhere with the First Service Credit Union mobile app. You can quickly check your balances, deposit checks, transfer money between accounts, make loan payments, and send/receive money with Zelle. If you're not a member, download the app and apply today.
Plus, you can earn $250 by signing up for direct deposit!*
• Apply for membership
• Set up direct deposit
• Open new checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, and certificates of deposit (CDs)
• Apply for a loan 
• Check balances and account history
• Activate and manage debit and credit cards
• Set up and edit alerts based on account, loan, or card activity
• Transfer money between accounts
• Make loan payments
• Deposit checks
• Send and receive money with Zelle
• Locate First Service branches, shared branches, and surcharge-free ATMs
• View and download eStatements 
*First Qualifying Direct Deposit must be received into the member’s account within 60 days successful enrollment. First Service will deposit $50 after the first month in which a total of $1,000 or more in Qualifying Direct Deposits is received; $75 will be deposited after the second month in which a total of $1,000 or more in Qualifying Direct Deposits is received; $125 will be deposited after the third month in which a total of $1,000 or more in Qualifying Direct Deposits is received. Qualifying Direct Deposits are defined as deposits from an enrolled member’s employer, payroll provider, benefits provider, pension, or the government (such as Social Security) via ACH deposit. External ACH transfers not from employers, verification or trial deposits from financial institutions, peer-to-peer transfers from services such as PayPal, Cash App, or Venmo, mobile check deposits, cash loads or deposits, and any deposit which First Service deems to not be legitimate are not Qualifying Direct Deposits. An ACH direct deposit made available early with Early Payday does not count toward the bonus requirements until it posts to your account and is no longer pending (e.g. the pay date scheduled by your payer). Limit $250 in bonus payouts per member. Certain restrictions may apply.

bluejetty:00043599:ios.description:
DMV Permit Practice Test Prep: Your Ultimate DMV Test Companion!
DMV Permit Practice Test Prep is an essential app for anyone preparing for their DMV permit test or driver's permit test across all 50 states. Whether you’re studying for a DMV written test in New York, Florida, Texas, or any other state, this app provides tailored practice to match each state’s requirements. With over 8,000 practice questions, real-time feedback, and a variety of study tools, you’ll be fully prepared to pass your DMV permit test and get your driver’s permit.
Key Features:
1. State-Specific Practice Tests: Our app covers all 50 states, from California DMV to New York, Florida, Texas, and beyond. We provide practice tests designed to meet the specific requirements of each state, ensuring that your study materials align with the real exam. And the questions or tests are regularly updated.
2. More than 8,000 Practice Questions: Gain access to more than 8,000 high-quality questions, covering key topics such as traffic laws, road signs, and driving safety. Whether you're preparing for a DMV practice test or a state-specific learner’s permit exam, our questions are designed to help you succeed.
3. Mistake Tracker: Automatically track your errors and focus on the areas that need improvement. This feature helps you reinforce your weak points and increases your chances of passing the DMV written test on your first try.
4. Favorites & Bookmarking: Save your most challenging questions and quickly revisit them for extra practice. This feature allows you to concentrate on the areas where you need the most work and review them until you’re confident.
5. Traffic Signs Practice: Prepare specifically for the traffic signs section of your permit test DMV with a dedicated section for road signs. Learn to recognize and understand important signs you’ll encounter during your exam.
6. Custom Practice Mode: Tailor your practice sessions with custom sets of questions. Whether you're focusing on specific state exams or general DMV test preparation, you can adjust your practice mode to suit your needs.
7. Real-Time Feedback & Progress Tracking: Receive immediate feedback on your answers and track your progress with detailed score reports. See where you’re excelling and where you need to improve, helping you prioritize your study areas.
8. User-Friendly Interface: The app’s simple and intuitive design ensures smooth navigation for an enhanced learning experience, whether you're practicing at home or on the go.
Perfect For:
1. DMV Test Takers: If you’re preparing for the DMV written test or driver permit test, this app is your ideal study companion.
2. Self-Learners: Practice anytime, anywhere. Take tests and review material at your convenience, whether you’re at home or on the move.
3. Retest Preparation: If you’ve failed a previous test, use our practice permit test feature to review your mistakes and improve your score for the next attempt.
Download Now and start your DMV test prep journey. With the right tools and focused practice, you’ll pass your permit test DMV with confidence!
Privacy Protection:
Your privacy matters. DMV Permit Practice Test Prep is designed strictly for educational purposes, and we do not collect sensitive personal information.
Privacy Policy: https://home.easydmv.cc/privacy-policy.html
Subscription Details:
1. If you subscribe through Apple, payment will be charged to your App Store account at the time of purchase. 
2. Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
3. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal settings in your App Store account.

تحدي الملوك هي لعبه حربية استراتيجية MMORPG مليئة بالتحدي والإثارة! حصّن قلعتك وشكّل جيشًا قويًا وانضم لعالم الأساطير ومعارك الـ PvP الملحمية في لعبة عربية مثيرة! و مجتمع عربي كبير

العب بشجاعة مع أصدقائك في معارك ملحمية، ولا تفوت فرصة الفخر بقوّتك وتحالفك أمام ممالك أخرى! تأهّب للقتال واستعد للتحدي بلعبة حربية استراتيجية عربية تُعتمد على الذكاء والتخطيط.
جنّد جنرالاتك وشكّل فريقًا لا يُقهَر! اختر بين الشخصيات المشهورة عالميًّا وقادة التاريخ لتكوين تشكيلة قوية من الجنرالات. احشد جيشًا يمثّل قوّتك وتميزك في ساحة المعركة.

bluejetty:00035580:ios.description:
Authenticator Aрр
Authenticator Aрр is a two-factor authentication utility to enhance the security of your online accounts. It is easy to set up, with no login required - simply scan a QR code to add your accounts. Google account verification and data import
Authenticator App is a powerful application that supports Google account verification and the ability to import data from Google Authenticator.
By downloading 2FA Authenticator App, you are downloading security for yourself!
Authenticator app is compatible with more than thousands websites and services including; Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator App, Reddit Authenticator, Facebook Authenticator, The Microsoft Authenticate Aрр, Paypal Authenticator, Amazon Authenticator, Dropbox Authenticator, Twilio Authy, Authy, MS Authenticator App, Authentication App, Discord Authenticator, Twitter Authenticator, Authenticator App Autenticador, Steam Authenticator, Snapchat Authenticator and thousands more.
Multi Factor Authenticator (MFA) & two factor authentication (2FA) provides a second layer of security. 
2FA Authenticator also allows you to quickly and easily protect your accounts by adding 2-factor authentication (2FA). 
Our Premium Function Passcode will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to sites with secure.
Key Features:
- Bank-Grade Encryption: Rest easy knowing that all your data stored in the Authenticator app is protected by state-of-the-art encryption.
- Secure 2FA and MFA Tokens: Store and generate both two-factor and multi-factor authentication tokens (2FA & MFA) with ease.
- Effortless Setup: Seamlessly add tokens by scanning QR codes or entering them manually.
- Enhanced Security: Benefit from end-to-end encryption for all stored codes, ensuring your data remains confidential.
- Biometric Unlock: Access your tokens quickly and securely with Passcode.
- Peace of Mind Backups: Safeguard your tokens with encrypted backups to iCloud.
- Seamless Device Transitions: Easily restore your codes when switching or replacing devices.
- Cross-Device Sync: Keep your codes synchronized securely across all your Apple devices.
- Wide Compatibility: Enjoy compatibility with iPhone and iPad.
- Convenient Widgets: Access your codes directly from your home screen with handy widgets.
- Offline Functionality: No internet? No problem! Our app works offline without sacrificing security.
- Import Existing Tokens: Bring your existing tokens into the app effortlessly.
- **TOTP Support:** Fully support for time-based one-time passwords (TOTP).
- Extensive Service Support: Compatible with a vast array of popular services, including Facebook, Google, Amazon, Coinbase, Microsoft, Instagram, Roblox, and thousands more.

Key Features of the My Ma
bluejetty:00021627:ios.description:
Connecting You to Your World of Work Has Never Been Easier
The My Manpower App puts job search and assignment management at your fingertips—whether you're looking for your next opportunity or already on assignment.
Key Features of the My Manpower App:
For Job Seekers:
•Easy Access: Log in with your email or social accounts and create a job search profile.
•Effortless Job Search: Explore a broad job database across industries like Call Center & Customer Service, Architecture and Engineering, Transportation, Manufacturing, Admin and Warehouse. Use filters to search by location, hours, etc.
•Ongoing Guidance: Receive personalized job recommendations, smart nudges and recommended next steps to guide your journey.
•Streamlined Applications: Apply with ease, track your progress and get alerts—all in one place.
•Build Your Profile & Resume: Create a professional profile and generate a resume directly in the app to boost your chances.
•Find a Branch: Locate nearby Manpower offices for in-person support.
For Associates:
•Real-Time Access: View assignment details, onboarding tools and pay stubs anytime, anywhere.
•Simplified Management: Manage your profile, resume, documents and preferences with a user-friendly interface.
•Secure Document Storage: Upload, store and/or delete tax forms and other employment documents easily and securely.
•Support & Resources: Access benefits, help tools, a resource library and career advancement options to support your success.
At Manpower, we know jobs. With over 75 years of experience connecting employers with skilled workers, we understand the challenges of the job hunt. That’s why we’re committed to delivering an enhanced experience for both job seekers and associates. In our latest release, we’ve expanded job search functionality globally and introduced new tools to help you build your career with confidence. Your next opportunity is just a tap away.

bluejetty:00017410:ios.name: Watcht for Trakt
bluejetty:00017410:ios.summary:
Watcht is a Movie and TV Show Information & Tracking App powered by Trakt.tv.
You can browse information without a Trakt account, however you will need one to sync and update your watch history, watch list, and ratings etc. Using a Trakt a
bluejetty:00017410:ios.description:
Watcht is a Movie and TV Show Information & Tracking App powered by Trakt.tv.
You can browse information without a Trakt account, however you will need one to sync and update your watch history, watch list, and ratings etc. Using a Trakt account means that all your history is available on all your devices with Trakt access, including available on Trakt.tv on the web.
Some things of note that you can do:
• Explore lists of Trending, Popular etc. Movies and TV Shows.
• Search for Movies, TV Shows, Episodes, Lists and People.
• Access Movie and TV Show information, ratings, and comments.
• Keep a Watch List of Movies and TV Shows to watch.
• Mark Movies and TV Shows as watched.
• Check in to Movies and TV Show episodes.
• Schedule a Check in reminder for Movies.
• Keep track of which episodes to watch next.
• View your Movie and TV Show history.
• Comment on Movies, TV Shows, Seasons, Episodes, and Lists.
• Create, edit, view and manage Custom Lists of Movies, TV Shows & People.
• Access a calendar of Movie and Episode release/air dates.
• Get notified about upcoming Episodes in your Calendar.
• View a list of recommended Movies and TV Shows.
• Choose from Dark, Pure Black, Light, or Original Themes, including system Dark Mode support.
• Choose from a few alternative App Icons colours.
• Import some information from IMDb.
• Basic Trakt API translation support for Movies and Shows. 
Please note that Watcht allows you to view information, however you can not actually watch the Movies or TV Show episodes within the app.
Have any feedback, suggestions, or features you think are missing, or found a bug?
Get in touch with email: watchtapp@gmail.com or on Twitter: @watchtapp.
Watcht is free to use, and doesn't contain any ads, however if you enjoy the app, consider contributing an amount to say thanks via the Contribute section in the Settings.
Note: Some icons provided by icons8.com.

bluejetty:00082642:ios.description:
Post Apo Tycoon: Rebuild the fallout!
Enter the world of Post Apo Tycoon, where you will revive a post-apocalyptic fallout landscape after a nuclear explosion. Take on the challenge of exploring, building, and transforming the landscape back into a thriving ecosystem. Get out of your nuclear silo to fill in the grain silo and rebuild the world!
Game Features:
- Explore an Extensive World: Discover a vast map filled with black fields and hidden treasures just waiting for your exploration. Every inch offers new resources and opportunities for your rebuilding efforts, including abandoned silos that can be repurposed to support your new society.
- Uncover the Lost Story: As you explore the wasteland, discover hidden diaries left behind by the witnesses of the world before. Each diary reveals fragments of the past, allowing you to piece together the story of what led to the apocalypse.
- Construct and Upgrade: Build a variety of structures, improvements, and roads to lay the foundation for a thriving society. Unlock different buildings to customize your city and improve its functionality!
- Restore the Ecosystem: Restore the devastated environment to its original state. Work on revitalizing the ecosystem, rejuvenating nature, and purifying the air in a world that desperately needs hope.
- Creative Freedom: Enjoy a relaxing experience without any threats or enemies. Concentrate solely on your creative vision and strategic planning, allowing your imagination to run wild.
- Engaging Gameplay Mechanics: Experience a rewarding sense of accomplishment as you build intricate city systems. Unlock new buildings and upgrades as you develop and expand your community.
- No Time Pressure: Play at your own pace with no deadlines or time constraints. Take the time you need to strategize and build the society of your dreams without the stress.
Your Goals:
1. Explore the Full Map: Discover every hidden corner and resource in this world.
2. Maximize Your City Level: Upgrade your city to its highest potential and show off your achievements.
3. Top the Leaderboard: Compete against other players and strive to be the best in this post-apocalyptic rebuilding adventure!
Join the adventure in Post Apo Tycoon and take on the challenge of restoring a world in need. Rebuild, revitalize, and create a thriving society from the ashes!
This app has received an IGRS rating of 3+.
Download now and begin your journey!

bluejetty:00168066:ios.description:
Synthesis Tutor is an AI-powered math tutor for kids ages 5-11. Personalized, step-by-step lessons adapt to your child's level across place value, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and fractions, and make daily practice something kids actually ask to do.
Key Features:
• Interactive Digital Tutor: Step-by-step guidance that is better than a conversation with the world's best teacher.
• Multi-Sensory Learning: Digital manipulatives for hands-on understanding.
• Progress Tracking: Monitor your child's improvement in both accuracy and speed.
• Engaging Gameplay: Math practice so fun, kids forget they're learning!
• Adaptive Flashcards: Our smart system adjusts difficulty in real-time based on your child's performance.
Perfect for:
• Elementary school students
• Children struggling with math anxiety
• Advanced learners seeking a challenge
• Neurodivergent and neuro-atypical students, including ADHD and Autism (ASD)
• Parents looking for an effective at-home math solution
Math Topics Covered:
• Addition & Subtraction
• Multiplication & Division
• Fractions
• Word Problems
• Place Value & Number Sense
• And more!
Why Choose Synthesis Tutor?
1. Personalized Learning: Our app adapts to your child's pace and learning style.
2. Builds Confidence: Celebrates progress and encourages persistence.
3. Develops Critical Thinking: Teaches problem-solving strategies, not just memorization.
4. Parent-Approved: Designed to be both educational and entertaining.
Kids and Families Love Synthesis Tutor!
"The A.I is brilliant, the comments are perfectly pitched for ages 7+. My daughter liked 'her' and on the first session, I had to get her to stop at an hour and a half otherwise, she would have just kept going." - Parent of Emily (8)
"There are times in homeschooling when you can see it click with your child. With Synthesis, I get to see that almost every time. Even better, I am starting to see them applying strategies they learn in Synthesis to other topics." - Parent of Maggie (12) and Mike (9) 
"One of my son's passions was always math, but lately he was less interested because he said his math class was too easy and boring. Synthesis gave him a challenge he needed and he's loving math again!" - Parent of Nathan (7) 
Download Synthesis Tutor today and watch your child's math skills soar! Turn screen time into learning time with an app so engaging, you might need to set limits on math practice.
Experience the journey yourself with our free flashcards lesson focused on multiplication. For full access to our extensive math library, grab a subscription anytime and unlock the complete learning experience.
Privacy Policy: https://www.synthesis.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.synthesis.com/terms

bluejetty:00179154:ios.summary:
Snap a transfer slip or a receipt and Wallet Story records the transaction for you. Track every wallet, card and debt, plan the months ahead, and share a book with your family - in 25 languages, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
LOG IT IN SECONDS
-
bluejetty:00179154:ios.description:
Snap a transfer slip or a receipt and Wallet Story records the transaction for you. Track every wallet, card and debt, plan the months ahead, and share a book with your family - in 25 languages, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
LOG IT IN SECONDS
- Slip and receipt reading: take a photo and the amount, date, shop and items are filled in for you.
- Voice entry: say "coffee 4.50 and lunch 12" and both entries are ready to save.
- Add from Siri and Shortcuts, Control Center and Lock Screen widgets.
- Recurring and scheduled transactions, and templates for the ones you repeat.
- Categories with sub-categories, tags, people and photo attachments.
EVERY ACCOUNT IN ONE PLACE
- Bank accounts, cash, e-wallets and credit cards, with statement and due-date reminders.
- Debts and money owed to you, including installment plans.
- Multiple currencies, with transfers between them.
- Import bank statements and CSV or Excel files.
PLAN AHEAD
- Budgets by day, month, quarter or year, overall or per category, plus special budgets for a trip or a project.
- Cash-flow forecast: see your balance in the coming months and get a warning before it runs low.
- Savings goals, a long-term savings and retirement planner, and savings circles.
- A Financial Health score.
GROW YOUR WEALTH
- Track land, a house or a car for your true net worth.
- Stocks and funds, with dividends and returns.
SHARE IT, OR RUN A BUSINESS
- Shared books: keep one book with your partner or family, updated live on every phone.
- Business books: quotations, invoices, receipts, credit notes and purchase bills as PDF, with customers, products and payroll.
CLEAR REPORTS
- Daily, weekly, monthly and yearly summaries, charts and a money-flow diagram.
- A calendar view of where your money went.
- Ask questions about your money in plain language.
YOUR DATA, EVERYWHERE
- Sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and Windows.
- Backups you can protect with a password.
- 25 languages and a large icon library.
FREE, PRO AND SUBSCRIPTION
Wallet Story is free to download, with unlimited transactions and bank accounts, and 300 free AI reads of slips, receipts and voice entries.
- Wallet Story PRO (one-time purchase) removes the free limits (for example 10 debts, 5 credit cards and 3 recurring transactions) and unlocks advanced reports and budgets, export to Excel and Google Sheets, password-protected backups, themes, more home screen widgets and sharing your own book.
- The subscription (monthly or yearly) adds unlimited AI reading, unlimited photos and files, the AI Financial Coach, AI analysis of your spending and investments, and a monthly AI report.
- The All Icons Pack and extra account books are separate one-time purchases.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://walletstory.app/terms
Privacy policy: https://walletstory.app/privacy

bluejetty:00153886:ios.description:
Cappuccina Make LASAGNA
In this thrilling kitchen adventure, test your culinary skills and survival instincts as you attempt to craft the perfect lasagna while avoiding Ballerina Cappuccina's watchful eye!
Gather ingredients and follow the recipe step by step, but beware - Ballerina Cappuccina moves swiftly toward you whenever you look away. Keep her in your field of vision to freeze her in place, or risk being caught before your masterpiece is complete!
Navigate through multiple challenging levels, each requiring quick thinking and strategic movements. Can you complete your delicious lasagna without being spotted by the ever-vigilant Ballerina Cappuccina ? Cook, dodge, and survive in this unique kitchen horror experience!
Perfect for fans of suspenseful gameplay with a quirky culinary twist. Keep your eyes peeled and your pasta ready!

bluejetty:00041318:ios.description:

Farsight is the leading venue for full public projects involving the science and the application of remote viewing. Stranger than science fiction. This is real. 
To access all features and content you can subscribe to FARSIGHT TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.

Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.

Privacy Policy: https://www.farsightprime.com/privacy

bluejetty:00018910:ios.description:
BEYBLADE BURST RIVALS is the official fast-paced match-3 puzzle battle game based on the hit boy’s action property, BEYBLADE BURST, which follows the adventures of Valt Aoi and the rest of the gang as they strive to become the world’s greatest Bladers.
Choose your favorite character and follow them on their quest to become a Master Blader as they enter BEYBLADE BURST tournaments, use rare and powerful Beys with the help of your loyal Avatars and participate in epic battles.
Collect an arsenal of Beys and upgrade them, unlocking special Bey techniques that provide a decisive edge for the ultimate battle. Which ones will you master?
Use strategy to defeat your opponents and strive for Ring Out Finishes, Survivor Finishes, and epic Burst Finishes!
Do you have what it takes to become the best Blader in the world? Grab your Bey and LET IT RIP!
FAST-PACED MATCH 3 BEYBLADE BURST BATTLES:
• Match tiles to power up and unleash epic Bey Techniques in battle!
• Use your favorite Bey Techniques from the TV series like Rush Launch, Counter Break, Quake Launch and more!
• Switch your Beys between rounds to perfect your strategy!
BATTLE HEAD-TO-HEAD WITH YOUR FAVORITE BLADERS, BEYS & AVATARS FROM THE BEYBLADE BURST TV SERIES:
• Collect and use all your favorite Beys in battle including Victory Valtryek, Storm Spryzen, Raging Roktavor, Xeno Xcalius, Lost Lúinor and more!
• Battle all your favorite characters including Valt, Rantaro, Daigo, Ken, Wakiya, Xander, Zac, Shu, Lui and more!
• Activate your devoted Avatars, charge up, sit back and watch their explosive affects across the board
• Challenge the best Bladers!
COLLECT THE RAREST AVATARS, BLADERS & BEYS:
• Discover rare and epic loot by opening Bey Boxes!
• Collect, level up and manage your Avatars, Bladers and Beys and use their powers strategically in battle!
• The more powerful the Blader or Bey, the better their stats, powers and abilities will be!
• New Bladers and Beys are added all the time!
BUILD YOUR ARSENAL OF RARE BEYS:
• Build your arsenal of rare Beys and battle with them in the Beystadium!
• Collect 5-star Beys to unlock new Bey Techniques!
• Earn experience and level up your Beys to unlock their true potential!
BECOME THE BEST BLADER IN THE WORLD:
• Compete in tournaments in awesome locations like Mountaintop, Seaside, and the National Stadium!
• Train your arsenal of Beys by battling in Quick Play!
• Compete in special weekly tournaments for epic rewards!
• Defeat the greatest Bladers and earn your place in history!
Follow us to get the latest NEWS and UPDATES:
Twitter- @Beyblade_Rivals
Instagram- @beybladeburstrivals
Discord Invite Link- https://discord.gg/M92MT2J

apple-macos:6831738474.name: messenger G — for teams
apple-macos:6831738474.description:
messenger G is a messenger for the people inside one company. They chat, call each other, assign tasks, read company news and look up colleagues in the staff directory.
GETTING STARTED
An organization applies right in the app with the "Connect your company" button on the first screen. Once the request is approved, the company gets its own server and its own company code.
Only the company creates accounts. An employee gets an invitation at their work email, fills in a request, and an administrator approves it.
There are no passwords. On the "Your company" screen you enter the company code (or open the invitation link), then your work email and the one-time code we send there.
CHATS
Direct chats, groups and announcement channels. Replies with quotes, reactions, mentions, pinned messages and forwarding. You can send voice messages, stickers, photos, videos and files up to 500 MB.
• "Delivered" and "Read" statuses, a typing indicator, drafts.
• Folders, archive, auto-delete for messages. Notifications can be muted.
• Search across chats and messages.
• Within an hour you can edit your own message or mark it as deleted. Chat members can still open its content.
• Send photos, videos, files and links from other apps to a chat with the "Share" menu.
SECRET CHATS
One-to-one or group. End-to-end encryption uses the MLS protocol (OpenMLS library). Messages are encrypted on the device, and neither the server nor administrators can read them.
A secret chat lives on one device only. Forwarding from it is disabled, and there's a self-destruct timer. You can check your contact's keys with a security code or a QR code.
CALLS
One-to-one voice and video. Audio and video are encrypted, and call keys are bound to the keys of both devices. The call screen shows a code. Compare it by voice: if it's the same for both of you, nobody is in the middle.
TASKS
An optional module that the company administrator turns on. Assign work to colleagues with an assignee, observers, a due date, reminders and repeats. You can also create a task straight from a chat message, and the task keeps a link to it.
• Multi-stage approval: approvers sign off on the task or its result.
• Inbox holds all your open tasks except snoozed ones.
• Snooze a task until a time you pick. It comes back sooner if the due date arrives, someone comments or your decision is needed.
• Comments with files and mentions, plus a history of changes.
• Managers see the tasks of the people who report to them.
NEWS FEED
Posts with text and photos, polls, reactions and comments. Announcements can be pinned, and there's post moderation.
PEOPLE
A staff directory by department with position, email, phone, manager and who's online.
SECURITY
• Every new sign-in is reported to all your devices. A new device has to be confirmed from one you already trust.
• Lock the app with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID.
• Push notifications contain no message text and no names.
• Report messages and posts, block a contact, or delete your account in Settings.
Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. There's also a web version, without secret chats and calls. Regular chats, groups, channels and the feed are stored on your company's server (each company gets a separate one). They're protected by TLS in transit and disk encryption on the server, but they aren't end-to-end encrypted.

apple-macos:6836755083.description:
Enough with complicated virtual keyboard apps.
Just looking for beautiful keys to show on your screen?
That’s why we made Simple Keyboard.
Easy to connect. Lovely to look at. Because we’d rather you spend your time playing than learning another app.
Getting started is simple: choose one MIDI input.
The app remembers your input and display settings, so the next time you open it, everything feels familiar.
When you want to focus on your playing, switch to Performance Mode.
Settings and buttons disappear, leaving only the keys. Whether you’re following the notes you play or showing your performance to someone else, the music stays in view.
You’ll be looking at these keys for a while, so we took care of the little things.
Soft reflections, the movement of each key, the shadows that change as you play. Details that make the display feel natural and comfortable.
Of course, everyone has their own idea of beautiful.
Make it yours, from pressed-key colors to keyboard size, proportions and lettering. Set it up the way you like, and let the app remember.
Putting a keyboard on your screen should be this simple.
So you can focus on playing.
Simple Keyboard.
This app visualizes MIDI input. It does not produce sound.

apple-itunes:6816359860.name: Sill – Mac Streaming
apple-itunes:6816359860.description:
Sill puts your Mac on your iPhone and iPad. Pick any window, or the whole desktop, and use it with touch, a trackpad, a keyboard or Apple Pencil. Your apps keep running on your Mac. Sill shows them and sends back what you do.
Sill needs the free Sill for Mac on the Mac you want to use. Get it at getsill.app. It runs on a Mac with macOS 14 or later.
Get started
• Open Sill for Mac and allow Screen Recording and Accessibility.
• Open Sill on your iPhone or iPad. Your Mac shows up. Tap it. The first time, scan the code your Mac shows.
• Pick a window from the Apps list, or tap Desktop to see the whole screen.
• The first time, a short tour shows you the controls.
Made for touch
• Tap to click. Touch and hold to right-click. Drag to scroll.
• Apple Pencil works as a mouse, with hover on iPad models that support it.
• Hold your device upright for a laptop layout: the picture on top, a trackpad and a row of keys below. On iPhone, turn on Larger Picture to give a window’s picture more of the screen.
• On iPhone Duo, open it flat and your Mac fills the inner display. Half open, it’s a laptop: the picture above the fold, a trackpad and keys below. Closed, Sill runs on the cover display.
• Type with the on-screen keyboard, or on a hardware keyboard as soon as you connect, with shortcuts and Esc. A trackpad or a mouse scrolls the window under the pointer.
• Copy text on your Mac and paste it on your iPhone or iPad. To paste on your Mac what you copied on your device, tap Paste in Sill: it goes where your Mac’s cursor is.
• Swipe and pinch with three fingers for Mission Control, App Exposé, Spaces, Apps and Show Desktop.
• Use the menus of the app you’re in: tap Menus in the bar, or on iPad with iPadOS 26 or later, use the menu bar at the top of the screen.
• Switch windows from live thumbnails in the bar. Touch and hold one to close, minimize or go full screen. Drag it to reorder.
• When the mouse moves on your Mac, its pointer shows on your iPhone or iPad too.
• Aa makes text larger or smaller.
Smooth and sharp
• Up to 120 frames per second on displays that support it.
• Set quality, resolution and frame rate from your iPhone or iPad.
• Hear sound from your Mac in step with the picture, a beta feature that is on unless you turn off Send Audio in Sill’s settings, on your Mac or your iPhone or iPad. Mute it on any device in Sill’s settings.
Your Mac, your network
• Connect over Wi-Fi, or over a USB cable.
• Mac nearby but on another network? Turn on Direct Wireless Connection on the Mac and connect straight to it.
• Pair each device with your Mac once by scanning a code. Over a USB cable it pairs by itself. By default your Mac lets in only the devices you paired, and every connection is encrypted.
• Away from home, reach your Mac through your own VPN. Sill starts at a quality a slower connection can carry, tells you when the connection can’t keep up, and moves back to your home network by itself when you get home.
Private
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Sill has no servers and collects no data. The picture and what you type go between your devices and your Mac, and to no one else.
• Sill is free and open source (Apache 2.0): https://github.com/Saffsanity/sill
Good to know
• Sill shows one window, or the whole desktop, at a time.
• Sill for Mac comes from getsill.app, not the Mac App Store.

apple-macos:6827867733.name: Speak Korean: Phrases & Travel
apple-macos:6827867733.description:
You learn to speak Korean the way you make a friend: one text at a time.
Jiwoo lives in Seoul and texts you every day. Then you go out and use your travel phrases with the people there — at a market, a café, a ballgame.
Before each chat, three new words. Say them out loud and the app shows what it heard. Nothing stops you; you just hear yourself get closer.
On day 15 you finally meet Jiwoo. 우리 말 놓을까요? From then on, you talk like friends.
Seoul Mal means 서울말: the Korean of Seoul, the standard Korean of the news and TV dramas. 말 (mal) is simply speech — the words you say.
• Every line in a natural Korean voice, as often as you like
• See what it heard: speech recognition on your device, nothing sent anywhere
• Read every line in romanization and as it sounds: 감사합니다 [감사함니다] gam·sa·ham·ni·da
• Tap any word for its meaning, its sound and the lines it is in
• "You can now say" cards keep every phrase you have learned
• Hangul, sounds, numbers, words and rules gather in your library
• Review your phrases on Apple Watch
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, with your progress on iCloud
Day one is free, and so is one new conversation every day. Seoul Pass opens every line — yearly with a free trial, monthly, or once for life — or take new lines in packs.
